The biblical text in Daniel speaks of knowledge increasing in the final days, a concept that resonates with the current technological acceleration. This moment calls for wisdom and foresight, not just...

This comes as the UK seeks exemptions from the EU's 'Made in Europe' plan. The report also notes a lighthearted remark about Liverpool being the 33rd county of Ireland...

Once a year, they hold a debate in the House of Commons chamber. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这将是首相首次使用北十号进行海外访问，同时总理将在都柏林与欧盟财长会面。早上好。周一，在卡迪夫与苏格兰民族党和格莱德·西姆鲁领导人举行的峰会上，新芬党主席玛丽·卢·麦克唐纳开玩笑说利物浦是爱尔兰的第 33 个县。安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 基本上是一名利物浦人。他出生在利物浦，并支持一支利物浦足球队，尽管他在利物浦和曼彻斯特之间的一个村庄卡尔切斯长大，这使他足够成为曼城的市长。他也有爱尔兰血统，所以今天早上他在曼彻斯特北10号接待爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁时，气氛应该会非常融洽。这是伯纳姆第一次利用北十号来主持海外访问，这应该有助于他努力使北十号成为一个适当的政府权力基地，而不仅仅是一个分支机构。对北十号进行历史性访问之际，总理在利物浦接待了加拿大总理马克·卡尼，在牛津接待了北约秘书长马克·鲁特，几天后他将注意力集中在全国各地的城镇上。继续阅读...

title.en: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
title.zh: 马克龙称俄罗斯针对欧洲的混合攻击正在加剧

summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron has stated that Russia's hybrid attacks against Europe, including France, have intensified. He has ordered the government to develop a plan to protect critical infrastructure and defense industry sites, indicating that France will not leave these attacks without a response.
summary.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示，俄罗斯针对欧洲（包括法国）的混合攻击已加剧。他已下令政府制定一项保护关键基础设施和国防工业部门的计划，并表明法国不会对这些攻击置之不理。

body.en:
French President Emmanuel Macron has warned that the threat of hybrid attacks by Russia against Europe and France has intensified.

In a news conference at the Elysee Palace, Macron said he had ordered a plan to protect critical infrastructure and defence industry sites in the face of this threat.

He said France had been targeted by Russian hybrid attacks in the past few weeks which would not be left "without a response".

A growing number of European leaders have warned that Russia may be preparing attacks to test their commitment to supporting Ukraine.

Hybrid warfare or hybrid attacks are loose terms which tend to describe non-military methods, for example cyberattacks, sabotage or misinformation, designed to exert pressure and destabilise an adversary.

These are quite often employed using proxies, but Russia always denies involvement in such attacks despite growing evidence to the contrary.

The French president was speaking to journalists after meeting party leaders to discuss the security impact of the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

Macron mentioned last month's drone attack on Leipzig airport in Germany , blamed on Russia, and remarks by Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk suggesting Russia was planning drone and missile strikes against Poland and other countries on Nato's eastern flank.

"In recent weeks, the Russian hybrid threat against Europeans and against France has intensified," he said.

"The intent is to intimidate us and break our effort to support Ukraine. The result will be the exact opposite. We are not intimidated because we know that our security today and tomorrow is at stake in Ukraine."

On Thursday Tusk told Polish MPs that Russian plans included strikes by drones and missiles on countries supporting Ukraine. He said there was a "real risk" of such strikes on the territory of Nato countries, with Moscow then claiming that they were "accidental", in an attempt to split the alliance.

Last Sunday, a Russian drone hit a passenger train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through along the same line.

Ukraine said all the passengers had been evacuated just minutes before the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine.

There have also been a number of suspicious fires at defence facilities from Italy to Estonia, with some of the affected countries blaming Russia .

Russian President Vladimir Putin has repeatedly said Russia does not plan to attack Europe, but Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov warned European nations against sending troops to Ukraine, which would be seen by Russia as a declaration of war.

"If Europe attacks Russia, it will be a completely different war, and it will be very short," he said.

Meanwhile on...
body.zh: 法国总统马克龙警告称，俄罗斯对欧洲和法国发动混合攻击的威胁已经加剧。 在爱丽舍宫举行的新闻发布会上，马克龙表示，面对这一威胁，他已下令制定一项计划，保护关键基础设施和国防工业场所。 他表示，过去几周，法国成为俄罗斯混合攻击的目标，俄罗斯不会“不做出回应”。 越来越多的欧洲领导人警告称，俄罗斯可能正在准备发动袭击，以测试他们支持乌克兰的承诺。 混合战争或混合攻击是宽松的术语，往往描述非军事方法，例如网络攻击、破坏或错误信息，旨在向对手施加压力并破坏其稳定。 这些攻击通常是通过代理来进行的，但俄罗斯始终否认参与此类攻击，尽管越来越多的证据表明事实并非如此。 法国总统在与党领导人会面讨论中东和乌克兰战争对安全的影响后对记者发表讲话。 马克龙提到了上个月德国莱比锡机场发生的无人机袭击事件，该袭击归咎于俄罗斯，以及波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克的言论，暗示俄罗斯正计划对波兰和北约东翼的其他国家进行无人机和导弹袭击。 “最近几周，俄罗斯对欧洲和法国的混合威胁有所加剧，”他说。 “其目的是恐吓我们，破坏我们支持乌克兰的努力。结果将完全相反。我们不会被吓倒，因为我们知道乌克兰今天和明天的安全都受到威胁。” 周四图斯克告诉波兰议员，俄罗斯的计划包括使用无人机和导弹对支持乌克兰的国家进行袭击。他表示，在北约国家领土上进行此类袭击存在“真正的风险”，莫斯科随后声称这些袭击是“意外的”，试图分裂该联盟。 上周日，在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊和欧洲高级安全官员沿着同一条线路通过后不久，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列客运列车。 乌克兰表示，就在雅霍丁发生罢工几分钟前，所有乘客已被疏散，这次罢工击中了火车的引擎。 从意大利到爱沙尼亚的国防设施也发生了多起可疑火灾，一些受影响的国家指责俄罗斯。 俄罗斯总统普京多次表示，俄罗斯不打算袭击欧洲，但外交部长拉夫罗夫警告欧洲国家不要向乌克兰派遣军队，这将被俄罗斯视为宣战。 “如果欧洲攻击俄罗斯，那将是一场完全不同的战争，而且时间会非常短，”他说。 与此同时...

reflection.en: The escalating threat of hybrid warfare, as described by President Macron, presents a complex challenge. It tempts nations to respond with similar tactics, potentially deepening cycles of conflict. The ancient wisdom to 'not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' calls for a response rooted in resilience and strategic defense, rather than...
reflection.zh: 正如马克龙总统所描述的，混合战争威胁的加剧带来了严峻的挑战。它诱使各国采取类似的策略进行回应，可能加剧冲突的循环。古老的智慧‘不可被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶’，呼吁以韧性和战略防御为基础来回应，而非被动攻击，旨在缓和而非激化局势。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: At least 17 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
title.zh: 载有爆炸物的车辆撞入巴基斯坦清真寺，至少17人死亡

summary.en: At least 17 people were killed and 73 injured when a vehicle packed with explosives rammed into a mosque in Kohat, Pakistan. Among the dead were seven police officers and a four-year-old child. Gunmen also attacked a nearby police facility.
summary.zh: 据巴基斯坦新闻社报道，一辆装满爆炸物的车辆在巴基斯坦西北部城市科哈特冲入一座清真寺，造成至少17人死亡，73人受伤。遇难者中包括七名警察和一名四岁儿童。枪手还袭击了附近的一个警察设施。

body.en:
At least 17 people have been killed and 73 others wounded after a vehicle laden with explosives rammed into a mosque in north-western Pakistan, according to Pakistan's news agency.

Seven police officers and a four-year-old child are among those killed in the attack, which also involved gunmen opening fire within a police facility in the city of Kohat in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, the Associated Press of Pakistan (APP) reported.

Video found by BBC Verify shows the site covered in rubble and people tending to casualties.

Pakistan's President Asif Ali Zardari expressed "his best wishes for the swift recovery of those injured in the explosion" in a statement.

The blast is reported to have occurred around 13:15 local time (08:15 GMT) while Friday prayers were taking place.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa police Insp Gen Zulfikar Hameed described it as a "suicide attack", according to news agency Reuters, which also reported that police had confirmed all seven attackers had been killed in the explosion and the gun battle that followed.

A police spokesperson said the seven armed militants attempted to infiltrate the police facility following the blast, according to the APP.

Militancy in Pakistan's border areas has risen sharply in recent months, with armed groups targeting the military and police.

Islamabad says militants use Afghanistan as a safe haven to train and plan attacks in Pakistan. Afghanistan's Taliban government denies the accusation and says militant groups are a domestic problem for Pakistan.
body.zh: 据巴基斯坦通讯社报道，一辆满载炸药的车辆冲进巴基斯坦西北部一座清真寺，造成至少 17 人死亡、73 人受伤。 据巴基斯坦美联社（APP）报道，袭击中包括七名警察和一名四岁儿童，枪手还向开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省科哈特市的一处警察设施内开枪。 BBC verify 发现的视频显示，该地点被瓦砾覆盖，人们正在处理伤员。 巴基斯坦总统阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里在一份声明中表达了“他对爆炸中受伤人员迅速康复的最良好祝愿”。 据报道，爆炸发生在当地时间 13:15 左右（格林威治标准时间 08:15），当时正在进行周五祈祷。 据路透社报道，开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省警察督察佐勒菲卡尔·哈米德称这是一次“自杀式袭击”，该社还报道说，警方已确认所有七名袭击者在爆炸和随后的枪战中丧生。 据APP报道，警方发言人表示，爆炸发生后，七名武装分子试图潜入警察设施。 近几个月来，巴基斯坦边境地区的武装活动急剧增加，武装团体针对军队和警察。 伊斯兰堡表示，武装分子利用阿富汗作为训练和策划袭击巴基斯坦的安全港。阿富汗塔利班政府否认这一指控，并表示激进组织是巴基斯坦的国内问题。

reflection.en: The horrific attack in Kohat, Pakistan, where a vehicle laden with explosives struck a mosque, killing innocent people including a child, is a stark reminder of the destructive cycles of violence. In the face of such evil, the call to overcome it with good, rather than retaliating in kind, remains a profound challenge and a divine imperative. May Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 巴基斯坦科哈特发生的这起可怕袭击事件，一辆载有爆炸物的车辆撞入清真寺，造成包括儿童在内的无辜生命丧生，这是暴力循环毁灭性的严峻提醒。面对这样的邪恶，不以恶报恶、反而以善胜恶的呼召，仍然是一个深刻的挑战和神圣的命令。愿雅伟赐予哀伤者平安与安慰，并赐予所有寻求打破这些循环的人智慧。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Ever more Israelis moving to and investing in Cyprus
title.zh: 越来越多的以色列人移居塞浦路斯并投资于塞浦路斯

summary.en: Over the past three years, a growing number of Israelis have been buying property and investing in Cyprus, with many choosing to relocate permanently. This trend is largely driven by the volatile situation and prolonged insecurity in Israel, particularly following the events of October 7, 2023, leading many to view...
summary.zh: 在过去的三年里，越来越多的以色列人在塞浦路斯购买房产并进行投资，许多人选择永久移居。这一趋势主要是由以色列动荡的局势和持续的不安全感所驱动，尤其是在2023年10月7日事件之后，许多人将塞浦路斯视为“B计划”。这种涌入已经开始影响塞浦路斯经济，并引起了当地民众的反应。

body.en:
Over the past three years, more and more Israelis have been purchasing property and investing in Cyprus, with many moving to the island permanently. How has this changed the Cypriot economy and how are locals responding?

The volatile situation in Israel and the prolonged sense of insecurity following the October 7, 2023 attacks and the wars that followed have prompted a growing number of Israelis to turn to the Republic of Cyprus .

For many, the nearby island is evolving from a holiday and investment destination into a place to settle permanently — and, in some cases, a "Plan B" in the event of a deterioration of the situation in Israel.

That is precisely how several Israelis who spoke to DW on condition of anonymity described their decision.

"I want to have a Plan B in case the situation in Israel gets more difficult," said one Israeli who recently bought a home in a large residential development in Cyprus's Limassol district.

Another pointed to Cyprus's proximity and familiarity: "It's a 40-minute flight, the same landscape, the same climate. It's like being in Israel without actually being there."

A third linked his move to business, saying that many Israeli companies have transferred some of their operations to Cyprus, making it easier for them to do business with EU countries.

According to estimates cited by Israeli media , at least 3,000 Israeli families now live permanently in Cyprus, with their number increasing by several hundred each year.

Israeli media reports also speak of tens of thousands of Israelis who have purchased property on the island. The newspaper Israel Hayom has reported that around 20,000 Israelis own property in Cyprus without living there year-round.

Figures from the Cyprus Land Registry presented to parliament show that between 2021 and 2024, a total of 3,851 property transfers and sale contracts involving Israeli buyers were recorded in the coastal districts of Larnaca, Paphos and Limassol alone.

But Israeli interest in Cyprus extends beyond apartments and holiday homes to land, tourism developments and major investment projects.

One of the most prominent examples is the Israeli hotel group Fattal, whose investments in Cyprus are estimated to run into hundreds of millions of euros and include hotels in Limassol, Paphos and Larnaca.

In Larnaca, investors with Israeli interests are also behind the redevelopment of the historic Palm Beach hotel, an investment of more than €110 million ($126 million), as well as the roughly €40 million Aqua Residences project, which foresees the construction of two 15-story towers along the seafront.

In the Limassol district, an Israeli investor is planning to revive Trozena, a village that has been abandoned for decades, by restoring around 60 homes and developing tourism...
body.zh: 过去三年来，越来越多的以色列人在塞浦路斯购买房产和投资，其中许多人永久移居该岛。这如何改变了塞浦路斯的经济？当地人有何反应？ 以色列局势的动荡以及 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击和随后的战争造成的长期不安全感促使越来越多的以色列人转向塞浦路斯共和国。 对于许多人来说，附近的岛屿正在从度假和投资目的地演变为永久定居地，在某些情况下，这是以色列局势恶化时的“B 计划”。 几位不愿透露姓名的以色列人正是这样描述他们的决定的。 “我希望有一个备用计划，以防以色列的局势变得更加困难，”一位最近在塞浦路斯利马索尔区的一个大型住宅开发区买了房子的以色列人说。 另一位则指出塞浦路斯的邻近性和熟悉性：“只需 40 分钟的飞行，同样的风景，同样的气候。就像身处以色列，但实际上却身在其间。” 第三个人将他的搬迁与商业联系起来，称许多以色列公司已将部分业务转移到塞浦路斯，使他们更容易与欧盟国家开展业务。 据以色列媒体估计，目前至少有3000个以色列家庭永久居住在塞浦路斯，并且这个数字每年都在增加数百个。 以色列媒体报道还提到数以万计的以色列人在岛上购买了房产。 Israel Hayom 报纸报道称，约有 20,000 名以色列人在塞浦路斯拥有房产，但并不常年居住在那里。 塞浦路斯土地登记处向议会提交的数据显示，2021年至2024年期间，仅在拉纳卡、帕福斯和利马索尔沿海地区就记录了总共3,851份涉及以色列买家的财产转让和销售合同。 但以色列对塞浦路斯的兴趣不仅限于公寓和度假屋，还包括土地、旅游开发和重大投资项目。 最突出的例子之一是以色列酒店集团 Fattal，其在塞浦路斯的投资估计达数亿欧元，其中包括利马索尔、帕福斯和拉纳卡的酒店。 在拉纳卡，具有以色列利益的投资者也支持历史悠久的棕榈滩酒店的重建，投资超过 1.1 亿欧元（1.26 亿美元），以及约 4000 万欧元的 Aqua Residences 项目，该项目预计将在海滨建造两座 15 层塔楼。 在利马索尔地区，一位以色列投资者正计划通过修复约 60 所房屋并发展旅游业，重振特罗泽纳 (Trozena) 这个已废弃数十年的村庄……

reflection.en: The movement of Israelis to Cyprus, seeking stability and a new home amidst conflict, echoes the ancient biblical call to welcome the stranger. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us to love the foreigner, for we ourselves were once foreigners in Egypt. This principle calls for compassion and hospitality towards those displaced or seeking refuge, recognizing our...
reflection.zh: 以色列人为了在冲突中寻求稳定和新家园而移居塞浦路斯，这呼应了圣经中欢迎陌生人的古老呼召。申命记10:19提醒我们当爱寄居的，因为我们曾在埃及地也作过寄居的。这一原则呼吁对那些流离失所或寻求庇护的人们怀有同情心和好客之心，认识到我们共同的人性和过去脆弱的经历。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Diana book sparks royal row between King Charles and Earl Spencer - The Latest
title.zh: 戴安娜传记引发查尔斯国王与斯宾塞伯爵间的王室争执

summary.en: Buckingham Palace has issued a rare and strong rebuttal to claims made in Earl Spencer’s memoir Swan Song. The book claims that Charles told Spencer days after Diana’s death and during a heated row over funeral arrangements: ‘Rest assured, we’ll forget her soon enough.’
summary.zh: 白金汉宫罕见且强硬地反驳了斯宾塞伯爵回忆录《天鹅之歌》中的说法。该书声称，在戴安娜去世后几天，查尔斯在一次关于葬礼安排的激烈争吵中告诉斯宾塞：“请放心，我们很快就会忘记她。”

body.en: Buckingham Palace has issued a rare, and strong, rebuttal to claims made in Earl Spencer’s memoir Swan Song. The book claims that King Charles told Spencer days after Diana’s death and during a heated row over funeral arrangements: ‘Rest assured, we’ll forget her soon enough.’ Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s senior national news editor, Aaron Sharp
body.zh: 白金汉宫罕见地对斯宾塞伯爵的回忆录《绝唱》中的说法进行了强烈反驳。该书称，戴安娜王妃去世几天后，在一场关于葬礼安排的激烈争吵中，查尔斯国王告诉斯宾塞：“放心，我们很快就会忘记她。”露西·霍夫与《卫报》的高级国家新闻编辑亚伦·夏普交谈

reflection.en: The public airing of private grief and familial disputes, particularly involving royal figures, raises questions about the conduct and compassion expected of leaders. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' While this situation is not one of overt oppression, it...
reflection.zh: 公开宣扬私人悲伤和家庭纠纷，尤其涉及王室成员，引发了人们对领导者应有的品格和同情心的疑问。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压者脱离欺压者的手。”虽然这种情况并非明显的压迫，但它触及了对哀悼者应有的尊严和尊重，以及有影响力者应承担的责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

The inclusion of candidates with alleged underworld ties and those promoting baseless health claims suggests a troubling disregard for integrity and truth in the pursuit of political power. reflection.zh: 当国家品格衰退时，这会体现在政党所做的选择以及他们所提拔的个人身上。将有黑社会背景的候选人以及散布毫无根据的健康说法的候选人纳入其中，表明在追求政治权力时，对诚信和真理存在令人担忧的漠视。这反映了一个更广泛的社会挑战，即道德标准受到损害，影响了治理的根本结构。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.

The perpetrator was active in networks known for the sadistic exploitation of young and vulnerable people, coercing them into creating...

The district court found that Chai, 18, was active in online networks notorious for their sadistic extortion of young and vulnerable people, coercing them to create sexually explicit material or engage in acts of violence – and for the youth of those involved. In Australia, support is available at Beyond Blue on 1300 22 4636, Lifeline on 13 11 14, and at MensLine on 1300 789 978. reflection.en: The digital world, while connecting us, can also become a breeding ground for exploitation. This case tragically illustrates how vulnerable individuals can be targeted and abused through online networks. reflection.zh: 数字世界在连接我们的同时，也可能成为剥削的温床。此案悲惨地说明了如何通过网络社群针对和虐待弱势个体。这呼吁我们为那些沉默者发声，并倡导保护易受伤害者，确保他们不被遗忘或忽视。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Canada and EU: A look at the bloc's special relationships
title.zh: 加拿大与欧盟：一窥欧盟的特殊关系

summary.en: Despite geographical distance, Canada and the EU are strengthening political ties, with discussions of associate membership. This closer relationship is motivated by shared values and a desire for a united front in addressing global challenges, particularly in relation to the US administration's trade policies.
summary.zh: 尽管地理上相距遥远，加拿大和欧盟正在加强政治联系，并讨论准成员国的可能性。这种更紧密的关系是由共同的价值观以及在应对全球挑战（尤其是在美国政府的贸易政策方面）时寻求统一战线的愿望所驱动的。

body.en:
Though Canada may be some distance from Europe geographically, closer political ties are in the cards. With talk of an associate membership, DW takes a look at other arrangements the EU has with particular countries.

Canada and the EU "see the world with the same eyes," according to European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen .

"Our commitment to the rule of law, and our unyielding defense of human dignity, individual freedom and democracy share the same deep roots, the same unwavering dedication,"  Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney  said.

In that spirit, and with both parties grasping for an effective way to deal with Donald Trump and his tariffs , von der Leyen floated the idea that Canada could become the European Union's first associate member on Thursday.

Given the concept of associate membership does not yet exist, it's difficult to determine exactly what that would mean. Germany proposed a similar arrangement for Ukraine earlier this year, only for Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reject the idea on the grounds that the country wants full membership.

Though not officially recognized as associates, there are plenty of countries that have strong ties or agreements with the bloc. DW looks at some of them and how they work.

Under this model, the ‘European Free Trade Association (EFTA)' countries are part of the EU's internal market, so people, goods and services can move freely in the Schengen area. The three countries also follow many EU rules in areas like tourism, environment and education.

But there are some key distinctions. The countries have no part in the decision-making process, bar some input into policy preparation, such as participation in expert groups. They are also not in the customs union, do not use the Euro and are not bound by the EU's common trade policy or justice laws. Iceland held a referendum on whether to go for full membership last month, but the government's push to do so failed and they remain an EFTA country.

While it borders four EU member states (Germany, Italy, France and Austria), Switzerland has never been a full member. Instead, more than 120 bilateral deals have been agreed upon by the EU and Switzerland over the last 50 years. These relate to areas such as trade, transport, security and education. A new package of deals was finalized last year, 20 years after they were last agreed.

More than 1.5 million EU citizens live and work in Switzerland, while 466,200 Swiss have gone the other way. That is possible as Switzerland is also part of the Schengen area , allowing for free movement of people across borders.

Switzerland makes financial contributions to a number of EU member states that joined after expansion in 2004, mostly in the east of Europe, but it has no EU voting rights and...
body.zh: 尽管加拿大在地理上距离欧洲可能有一段距离，但更密切的政治联系是有可能的。在谈及准成员资格时，德国之声考察了欧盟与特定国家之间的其他安排。 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 表示，加拿大和欧盟“用同样的眼睛看世界”。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示：“我们对法治的承诺，以及我们对人类尊严、个人自由和民主的坚定捍卫，有着同样深厚的根源和同样坚定不移的奉献精神。” 本着这种精神，在双方都在寻求一种有效的方式来应对唐纳德·特朗普及其关税的情况下，冯德莱恩于周四提出了加拿大可以成为欧盟第一个准成员的想法。 鉴于准会员资格的概念尚不存在，因此很难确定这到底意味着什么。德国今年早些时候向乌克兰提出了类似的安排，但弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基以该国希望成为正式成员国为由拒绝了这一想法。 尽管没有被官方承认为伙伴国，但仍有许多国家与欧盟有着密切的联系或协议。德国之声研究了其中的一些以及它们的工作原理。 在这种模式下，“欧洲自由贸易联盟（EFTA）”国家是欧盟内部市场的一部分，因此人员、商品和服务可以在申根区内自由流动。这三个国家在旅游、环境和教育等领域也遵守许多欧盟规则。 但也有一些关键的区别。这些国家不参与决策过程，禁止对政策制定提供一些投入，例如参加专家组。它们也不属于关税同盟，不使用欧元，并且不受欧盟共同贸易政策或司法法的约束。冰岛上个月就是否加入欧洲自由贸易联盟举行了全民公投，但政府的努力失败了，他们仍然是欧洲自由贸易联盟国家。 虽然瑞士与四个欧盟成员国（德国、意大利、法国和奥地利）接壤，但它从未成为正式成员国。相反，过去 50 年来，欧盟和瑞士达成了 120 多项双边协议。这些涉及贸易、运输、安全和教育等领域。一系列新的交易于去年敲定，距上次达成一致已过去 20 年。 超过 150 万欧盟公民在瑞士生活和工作，而 466,200 名瑞士人却选择了另一条路。这是可能的，因为瑞士也是申根区的一部分，允许人员跨境自由流动。 瑞士向 2004 年扩张后加入的一些欧盟成员国提供财政捐助，其中大部分位于东欧，但它没有欧盟投票权，而且……

reflection.en: The desire for closer political ties between Canada and the EU, rooted in shared commitments to the rule of law and human dignity, reflects a yearning for cooperation and mutual support in a complex world. This pursuit of common ground, as expressed by leaders like Ursula von der Leyen and Mark Carney, echoes the beatitude for peacemakers, reminding us that...
reflection.zh: 加拿大和欧盟之间对更紧密政治关系的渴望，源于对法治和人类尊严的共同承诺，这反映了在一个复杂世界中对合作和相互支持的追求。这种寻求共同点的努力，正如冯德莱恩和马克·卡尼等领导人所表达的那样，呼应了使人和睦者有福的教导，提醒我们建立桥梁和促进理解是一项神圣的呼召。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
title.zh: 尼日利亚拘留期间数十名涉嫌非法矿工死亡

summary.en: Dozens of individuals accused of illegal mining in north-central Nigeria have died while in the custody of the Nigerian Security and Civil Defence Corps. While authorities attributed the deaths to disease, intelligence reports and relatives suggest overcrowding and poor ventilation in the detention facility led to...
summary.zh: 在尼日利亚中北部，数十名被指控非法采矿的人员在尼日利亚安全与民防部队拘留期间死亡。当局将死亡归因于疾病，但情报报告和家属则认为拘留设施内的过度拥挤和通风不良导致了窒息。

body.en:
Thirty-seven people accused of illegal mining in north-central Nigeria have died in custody, local officials said.

Police have set up an investigation into the deaths, which the Nigerian Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) blamed on an apparent disease outbreak.

However, an intelligence report shared with the AFP news agency suggested the group died because of overcrowding and poor ventilation inside the detention facility in Niger state.

"We believe they suffocated because there was no ventilation," the father of one of those detained told the BBC.

His son described how detainees began collapsing in the heat of the overcrowded and poorly ventilated cell, his father said.

He said the detainees repeatedly knocked on the door for help but nobody opened it.

After news of the deaths spread, angry miners and relatives started attacking public institutions and public transport buses, using stones and sticks before they were dispersed by police who fired tear gas, according to local residents.

State governor Mohammed Umaru Bago called the deaths "sad and tragic" during a press conference on Thursday.

He declared three days of mourning and postponed the start of campaigning for elections scheduled for January.

Officials had arrested the group of young men on Tuesday for suspected illegal mining near Borgu, in the mineral-rich state of Niger. The region is known for small-scale gold mining.

Two days later, 37 people detained as part of the suspected unlawful operation were found dead inside the detention centre run by the NSCDC, a paramilitary agency responsible for protecting critical infrastructure and tackling crimes including illegal mining. It also assists police with internal security operations.

The NSCDC told the BBC that illegal mining was widespread in Niger state, where artisanal miners often operate in open fields.

Its spokesperson, Babawale Afolabi, said more than 50 people were arrested during an operation earlier this week. They had not been charged because profiling and documentation were still under way before the deaths, he said.

The NSCDC had earlier said the detainees were possibly victims of a diphtheria outbreak, a serious bacterial infection that can be fatal.

But the agency's national headquarters later said the cause had not been established and would require medical and laboratory tests.

"The NSCDC wishes to clarify that reports attributing the deaths to any specific disease remain subject to medical and laboratory confirmation," it added in a statement.

Dalhatu told the BBC that security officers had been pursuing suspected illegal miners in the community for several days before making arrests.

He said relatives went to the NSCDC office seeking their release but were repeatedly told to return later....
body.zh: 当地官员称，尼日利亚中北部被指控非法采矿的 37 人已在拘留期间死亡。 警方已对死亡事件展开调查，尼日利亚安全和民防部队（NSCDC）将死亡归咎于明显的疾病爆发。 然而，法新社分享的一份情报报告显示，这群人因尼日尔州拘留设施内过度拥挤和通风不良而死亡。 其中一名被拘留者的父亲告诉英国广播公司：“我们相信他们是因为没有通风而窒息的。” 他的父亲说，他的儿子描述了被拘留者如何在过度拥挤且通风不良的牢房中因炎热而崩溃。 他说，被拘留者多次敲门寻求帮助，但没有人打开。 据当地居民称，死亡消息传开后，愤怒的矿工和亲属开始使用石块和棍棒袭击公共机构和公共交通巴士，然后被发射催泪瓦斯的警察驱散。 该州州长穆罕默德·乌马鲁·巴戈在周四的新闻发布会上称这些死亡事件“令人悲伤和悲惨”。 他宣布哀悼三天，并推迟了原定于一月举行的选举竞选活动的开始。 官员周二逮捕了这群年轻人，原因是他们涉嫌在矿产资源丰富的尼日尔州博尔古附近非法采矿。该地区以小规模金矿开采而闻名。 两天后，因涉嫌非法行动而被拘留的 37 人被发现死在 NSCDC 管理的拘留中心内。NSCDC 是一个准军事机构，负责保护关键基础设施并打击包括非法采矿在内的犯罪行为。它还协助警察进行内部安全行动。 NSCDC 告诉 BBC，非法采矿在尼日尔州十分普遍，手工采矿者经常在露天矿场作业。 其发言人巴巴瓦勒·阿福拉比 (Babawale Afolabi) 表示，在本周早些时候的一次行动中，有 50 多人被捕。他说，他们没有受到指控，因为死亡前的分析和记录工作仍在进行中。 国家疾病预防控制中心早些时候表示，这些被拘留者可能是白喉爆发的受害者，白喉是一种可能致命的严重细菌感染。 但该机构的国家总部后来表示，原因尚未确定，需要进行医学和实验室测试。 “国家疾病预防控制中心希望澄清，将死亡归因于任何特定疾病的报告仍需经过医学和实验室确认，”它在一份声明中补充道。 达尔哈图告诉英国广播公司，安全人员在社区内追捕涉嫌非法采矿者数天，然后才进行逮捕。 他说，亲属前往国家疾病预防控制中心办公室寻求释放，但一再被告知稍后再回来……

reflection.en: The news from Nigeria is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of those in detention. Matthew 25:40 calls us to see Christ in the least among us, including prisoners. When overcrowding and poor conditions lead to such tragic loss of life, it challenges us to consider our responsibility towards those held in custody, ensuring they are treated with dignity...
reflection.zh: 尼日利亚的这则新闻令人警醒，它提醒我们被拘留者的脆弱处境。《马太福音》25:40 呼吁我们在最小的弟兄身上看见基督。当过度拥挤和恶劣的条件导致如此悲惨的生命损失时，这促使我们反思对被羁押者的责任，确保他们得到尊严和基本人道的对待。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Ronaldo named in first Portugal squad since World Cup - at age of 41
title.zh: C罗入选葡萄牙队名单，时年41岁

summary.en: Cristiano Ronaldo has been included in the first squad selected by new Portugal coach Jorge Jesus, ending speculation about the 41-year-old's potential retirement from international football. He is part of a 25-man group for upcoming Nations League games.
summary.zh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多（Cristiano Ronaldo）入选了新任葡萄牙队教练若热·热苏斯（Jorge Jesus）选拔的首期阵容，结束了这位41岁球员可能退出国家队的猜测。他将参加即将到来的国家联赛比赛，是25人名单中的一员。

body.en:
Cristiano Ronaldo has been named in the first squad selected by new Portugal coach Jorge Jesus, ending speculation the 41-year-old could retire from international football.

Ronaldo refused to confirm whether he would continue to play for his country after Portugal's World Cup round-of-16 defeat by eventual winners Spain in July.

But the Al-Nassr forward is part of a 25-man group chosen for Portugal's four Nations League games between 24 September and 4 October.

Jesus has replaced Roberto Martinez, who stepped down as Portugal coach after their World Cup exit.

The 72-year-old was Ronaldo's club boss last season, when the pair helped Al-Nassr win the Saudi Pro League for the first time in seven years.

The former Manchester United Real Madrid forward, who announced that this summer's World Cup would be his last, was in tears after Portugal's World Cup exit.

When asked if he would keep playing for his country, he said: "I will meet the family and take decisions with a calm head."

This sparked speculation he could follow his great rival Lionel Messi and retire from international football.

Ronaldo will turn 42 before next summer's Nations League finals and will be 43 by Euro 2028.

The oldest player in the history of the Euros is Ronaldo's former Portugal team-mate Pepe, who was 41 and 130 days for his last game at Euro 2024.

Manchester United pair Diogo Dalot and Bruno Fernandes are also in the squad, along with Ruben Dias (Manchester City) and Pedro Neto (Chelsea).

Portugal are at home to Wales on 24 September (19:45 BST) and away to Norway three days later. They then play in Denmark on 1 October and return home to host Norway on 4 October.
body.zh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多 (Cristiano Ronaldo) 入选葡萄牙新任主帅豪尔赫·热苏斯 (Jorge Jesus) 挑选的第一阵容，结束了这位 41 岁球员可能从国际足坛退役的猜测。 7月份葡萄牙在世界杯16强中输给最终冠军西班牙后，罗纳尔多拒绝确认他是否会继续为国家队效力。 但这位阿尔纳赛尔前锋是被选中参加葡萄牙 9 月 24 日至 10 月 4 日期间四场国家联赛比赛的 25 人小组的一员。 热苏斯接替了罗伯托·马丁内斯，后者在世界杯出局后辞去了葡萄牙队主教练的职务。 这位72岁的老人上赛季是罗纳尔多的俱乐部主帅，当时两人帮助阿尔纳赛尔七年来首次赢得了沙特职业联赛冠军。 这位前曼联皇家马德里前锋宣布今年夏天的世界杯将是他的最后一届世界杯，在葡萄牙队退出世界杯后，他流下了眼泪。 当被问及是否会继续为国家队效力时，他说：“我会与家人见面，冷静地做出决定。” 这引发了人们的猜测，他可能会追随他的劲敌梅西，从国际足坛退役。 在明年夏天的国家联赛决赛之前，C罗将年满 42 岁，到 2028 年欧洲杯将年满 43 岁。 欧洲杯历史上最年长的球员是C罗的前葡萄牙队友佩佩，他在2024年欧洲杯的最后一场比赛中已经是41天零130天了。 曼联队的迪奥戈·达洛特和布鲁诺·费尔南德斯也在名单中，此外还有鲁本·迪亚斯（曼城）和佩德罗·内托（切尔西）。 葡萄牙将于 9 月 24 日（英国夏令时 19:45）主场迎战威尔士，三天后客场迎战挪威。然后他们于 10 月 1 日在丹麦比赛，并于 10 月 4 日回国迎战挪威。

reflection.en: At 41, Cristiano Ronaldo's inclusion in the Portuguese squad marks a remarkable continuation of his international career. This moment speaks to the natural rhythms of life and career, reminding us that there is indeed 'a time for everything under the heavens.' His sustained presence invites reflection on dedication, the passage of time, and the unique...
reflection.zh: 41岁的克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多入选葡萄牙队名单，标志着他国际职业生涯的非凡延续。这一时刻体现了生命和职业生涯的自然节奏，提醒我们“天下万物皆有定时”。他持续的出现，邀请人们反思奉献、时光流逝以及他目前所处的独特人生阶段。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: India: Are food safety rules too much to swallow?
title.zh: 印度：食品安全规定是否过于严苛？

summary.en: Recent raids on luxury hotels and a broader crackdown on food companies in India have reignited discussions about the country's food safety standards and how effectively they are being enforced.
summary.zh: 近期对印度豪华酒店的突击搜查以及对食品公司的广泛整顿，重新引发了关于该国食品安全标准及其执行有效性的讨论。

body.en:
Recent raids at India's luxury hotels and a wider crackdown on its food companies have renewed the debate about food safety standards and their enforcement in the country.

Over the past few months, inspectors from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) raided kitchens at five-star hotels in New Delhi's Aerocity, including the JW Marriott and Andaz.

The inspectors reported "several serious food safety and hygiene deficiencies" at the Andaz, including "improper segregation of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, pest activity, poor sanitation, inadequate food handler hygiene and improper storage practices."

During their visit to the JW Marriott property, inspectors observed "serious hygiene and sanitation deficiencies," including "unclean utensils and food-contact surfaces, visible particulate matter in the drinking water" and "inadequate pest control." 

Both hotels said they were cooperating fully with regulators and reviewing or implementing corrective measures while reaffirming their commitment to food safety, hygiene and guest well-being.

The FSSAI crackdown is not limited to premium restaurants. The regulator has also issued more than 150 notices since July to leading food and beverage companies, primarily over misleading advertisements, health claims and labeling. The concerns highlighted by the recent raids are reflected in the FSSAI's testing data.

In 2023-24 and 2024-25, authorities tested about 170,000 food samples each year, with roughly 1 in 5 found to be non-conforming. In 2025-26, the testing showed only a slight improvement: Out of 223,808 samples, 40,023 failed to meet safety or labeling standards , according to provisional data given to Parliament in July. "Non-conforming" includes adulterated, substandard, contaminated and misbranded food.

Sunil Ghadiok, a veteran hotelier with more than 45 years in the industry and founder of Enserve Hospitality and Management Services, said the "lapses" did not reflect the industry as a whole.

"Lapses occur because food safety depends on execution at the operational level. The bigger concern is not the existence of standards, but the commitment to overall hygiene and food safety," Ghadiok told DW. He said inspections needed to become more regular and go where the risk is.

"A complaint or a high-profile inspection should not be what brings food safety back into focus."

FSSAI's Hygiene Rating Scheme for restaurants is voluntary. Businesses can apply for a rating, but they are not required to participate. Food-safety enforcement can therefore become highly visible when something goes wrong, while routine scrutiny is less apparent.

Yash Bhanage, founder and COO of Hunger Inc Hospitality, which runs The Bombay Canteen, O Pedro and Bombay Sweet Shop, said food...
body.zh: 最近对印度豪华酒店的突击搜查以及对食品公司的更广泛打击，重新引发了有关该国食品安全标准及其执行情况的争论。 过去几个月，印度食品安全和标准局 (FSSAI) 的检查员突击检查了新德里 Aerocity 的五星级酒店的厨房，其中包括 JW 万豪酒店和安达兹酒店。 检查人员报告了安达兹酒店存在“一些严重的食品安全和卫生缺陷”，包括“素食和非素食食品隔离不当、害虫活动、卫生条件差、食品处理人员卫生条件不足以及储存不当”。 在视察 JW 万豪酒店期间，检查人员发现了“严重的卫生和环境卫生缺陷”，包括“不干净的器具和食物接触表面、饮用水中可见的颗粒物”和“害虫控制不充分”。 两家酒店均表示，他们正在与监管机构充分合作，审查或实施纠正措施，同时重申对食品安全、卫生和客人福祉的承诺。 FSSAI 的打击行动不仅限于高级餐厅。自 7 月以来，监管机构还向领先的食品和饮料公司发出了 150 多份通知，主要针对误导性广告、健康声明和标签。 FSSAI 的测试数据反映了最近突袭行动所凸显的担忧。 2023-24 和 2024-25 年度，当局每年检测约 170,000 个食品样本，其中约五分之一被发现不合格。 2025-26 年，测试结果仅略有改善：根据 7 月份向议会提供的临时数据，在 223,808 个样本中，有 40,023 个样本未达到安全或标签标准。 “不合格”包括掺假、不合格、受污染和贴错标签的食品。 苏尼尔·加迪奥克 (Sunil Ghadiok) 是一位在该行业拥有超过 45 年经验的资深酒店经营者，也是 Enserve Hospitality and Management Services 的创始人，他表示，这些“失误”并不能反映整个行业的情况。 加迪奥克告诉德国之声：“之所以会出现失误，是因为食品安全取决于操作层面的执行。更令人担忧的不是标准的存在，而是对整体卫生和食品安全的承诺。”他表示，检查需要变得更加定期，并检查存在风险的地方。 “投诉或高调的检查不应让食品安全重新成为人们关注的焦点。” FSSAI 的餐馆卫生评级计划是自愿性的。企业可以申请评级，但不需要参与。因此，当出现问题时，食品安全执法就会变得非常明显，而例行审查则不太明显。 Hunger Inc Hospitality 的创始人兼首席运营官 Yash Bhanage 表示，该公司经营着 The Bombay Canteen、O Pedro 和 Bombay Sweet Shop。

reflection.en: The news from India about food safety inspections in luxury hotels brings to mind the call to 'act justly.' Ensuring that food is safe and hygiene standards are met is a fundamental aspect of justice, protecting the well-being of consumers. This requires diligent oversight and accountability from both regulators and businesses.
reflection.zh: 印度关于豪华酒店食品安全检查的新闻，让人联想到‘秉公行义’的呼召。确保食品安全和卫生标准达标，是保护消费者福祉的基本公正原则。这需要监管机构和企业双方的勤勉监督和问责。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Ireland's RTÉ to boycott Eurovision over Israel inclusion for second year
title.zh: 爱尔兰RTÉ因以色列参赛连续第二年抵制欧洲歌唱大赛

summary.en: Irish public broadcaster RTÉ announced it will not send an act to or broadcast the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, for the second consecutive year, due to the ongoing conflict and loss of life in Gaza.
summary.zh: 爱尔兰公共广播公司RTÉ宣布，由于加沙持续的冲突和生命损失，该公司将连续第二年不派代表参加或转播2027年欧洲歌唱大赛。

body.en:
Ireland will not participate in or broadcast next year's Eurovision Song Contest, public broadcaster RTÉ said, citing the "ongoing loss of lives in Gaza".

The country, which also snubbed the 2026 competition over Israel's participation, will join the Netherlands in skipping the world's biggest live televised music event , which has been hit by a string of withdrawals and controversies in recent years.

"RTÉ will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, nor will RTÉ broadcast the competition," the broadcaster said on Thursday.

"RTÉ feels that Ireland's participation cannot be justified given the appalling and ongoing loss of lives in Gaza and the humanitarian crisis there which continues to put the lives of so many civilians at risk," the statement said.

RTÉ quoted Eurovision Song Contest director Martin Green as saying that the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), which organises the event, regretted but respected RTÉ's decision.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"They remain a valued part of our family and will be missed," RTÉ reported Green as saying.

Earlier this month, the EBU said it was excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition.

Israel, which has been at war in Gaza since 2023, came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion .

However, the Dutch broadcaster said the exclusion of countries in conflict from hosting was not "sufficient", adding that Eurovision could "no longer be considered neutral" given the divisions over the Gaza conflict.

Since its launch in 1955, Eurovision has become the ultimate pop platform, catapulting Swedish icons ABBA to worldwide fame and boosting the likes of Celine Dion, Cliff Richard and Olivia Newton-John.

Next year's event will take place on 15 May in Burgas, Bulgaria's Black Sea city.

This year's competition drew 131 million viewers, down 35 million from the year before, after five countries boycotted it over Israel's participation .

The Netherlands, Iceland, Spain, Ireland and Slovenia all pulled out of the 2026 contest, with the latter three refusing to broadcast the show at all.

SBS, an associate member of EBU and Australia's official broadcaster of the competition, has confirmed it will broadcast Eurovision in 2027.

SBS participated in the 2026 edition, despite calls for Australia to boycott the competition .

"Our position remains that, as a public broadcaster, making a decision to be involved based on the inclusion or exclusion of any country would undermine SBS's editorial independence and impartiality," an SBS spokesperson said in December...
body.zh: 公共广播公司 RTÉ 表示，爱尔兰将不会参加或转播明年的欧洲歌唱大赛，理由是“加沙正在发生人员伤亡”。 该国还因以色列的参赛而冷落了2026年的比赛，并将与荷兰一起缺席这项世界上最大的现场电视音乐盛会，该盛会近年来受到一系列退出和争议的打击。 该广播公司周四表示：“RTÉ 将不会参加 2027 年欧洲歌唱大赛，也不会转播比赛。” 声明称：“RTÉ认为，鉴于加沙地区令人震惊的持续生命损失以及那里的人道主义危机继续使许多平民的生命处于危险之中，爱尔兰的参与是不合理的。” RTÉ援引欧洲歌唱大赛总监马丁·格林的话说，组织此次活动的欧洲广播联盟（EBU）对此表示遗憾，但尊重RTÉ的决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据《RTÉ》报道，格林表示：“他们仍然是我们家庭的重要组成部分，我们会想念他们。” 本月早些时候，欧洲联盟表示，将排除任何卷入武装冲突的国家主办比赛。 自 2023 年以来加沙一直处于战争状态的以色列在 2025 年和 2026 年都差点赢得比赛，最终两次获得第二名。 然而，这家荷兰广播公司表示，将冲突国家排除在主办之外还“不够”，并补充说，鉴于加沙冲突的分歧，欧洲电视网“不再被视为中立”。 自 1955 年推出以来，欧洲歌唱大赛已成为终极流行音乐平台，使瑞典偶像 ABBA 享誉全球，并培养了席琳·迪翁、克里夫·理查德和奥利维亚·牛顿·约翰等人。 明年的活动将于 5 月 15 日在保加利亚黑海城市布尔加斯举行。 今年的比赛吸引了 1.31 亿观众，比上年减少了 3500 万，此前有五个国家因以色列参赛而抵制比赛。 荷兰、冰岛、西班牙、爱尔兰和斯洛文尼亚都退出了 2026 年的比赛，后三个国家根本拒绝转播该节目。 SBS 是 EBU 的准会员，也是澳大利亚比赛的官方转播商，已确认将在 2027 年转播欧洲电视网。 尽管有人呼吁澳大利亚抵制比赛，SBS 还是参加了 2026 年的比赛。 SBS 发言人去年 12 月表示：“我们的立场仍然是，作为一家公共广播公司，根据纳入或排除任何国家做出参与决定将损害 SBS 的编辑独立性和公正性。”

reflection.en: RTÉ's decision to boycott the Eurovision Song Contest, citing the ongoing loss of life in Gaza, highlights a broadcaster's moral stance. This action reflects a principle of prioritizing conscience and humanitarian concerns over participation in a widely watched cultural event. It echoes the sentiment of obeying a higher moral calling, even when it means...
reflection.zh: RTÉ决定抵制欧洲歌唱大赛，并以加沙持续的生命损失为由，凸显了广播公司的道德立场。此举体现了在参与备受瞩目的文化活动时，将良知和人道主义关切置于优先地位的原则。这呼应了即使意味着退出一个平台，也要服从更高道德召唤的精神。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: The bigger story behind Donald Trump's Kennedy Center clash
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普肯尼迪中心之争背后的更大故事

summary.en: The US president's efforts to leave his mark on America's institutions are proving deeply divisive, with a federal judge ordering that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the Kennedy Center without at least 30 days' notice, following comments made by Trump about the building needing to be "ripped down".
summary.zh: 美国总统试图在美国的机构上留下自己的印记，这正变得极具争议。一位联邦法官下令，特朗普政府在至少提前30天通知的情况下，不得更改或拆除肯尼迪中心，此前特朗普曾发表过关于该建筑需要被“拆毁”的言论。

body.en:
The saga of the Kennedy Center continues as a United States federal judge has warned that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the storied performing arts centre without at least 30 days' notice.

Judge Christopher Copper issued the order after receiving a submission comprising comments made by Donald Trump this week that the historic Washington DC building would have to be "ripped down". He was later photographed looking at what appears to be a rendition of the centre being demolished.

The administration has been in a long-standing clash over the 1960's building , named in tribute to the assassinated president John F Kennedy. In December, a Trump-appointed board of trustees voted to add his name to the building, a move subsequently blocked by the courts.

"I think that the Trump administration should certainly have recognition. Because frankly, if we don't do that, it's going to close. It'll end up being ripped down," Trump told reporters on Thursday.

A threatened shutdown of the centre is now in place, with Matt Floca, the Kennedy Center's Trump-backed executive director, saying the building has been temporarily closed to assess safety risks in areas "exhibiting severe structural deterioration."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Democrat Joyce Beatty has responded by claiming in court filings the closure "is a recipe for defendants extending their shutdown forever and closing the Kennedy Center for the next two years — the very thing this court said they could not do without its permission."

Trump installed himself as chairman of the centre soon after taking office for the second time last year, ousting 18 board members appointed by former president Joe Biden and inserting his own allies to key positions.

The new board dissolved the centre's Social Impact Division and rolled back diversity-focused programming. Dozens of high-profile artists, productions, and long-running residency groups pulled out in protest. Ticket sales dropped to their lowest levels since the pandemic.

The Washington Post recently reported that the centre would only collect US$124 million ($174 million) of the US$220 million ($309 million) it had projected for the period between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026, leaving a "roughly $23 million deficit" after substantial spending cuts.

The building was damaged in a storm earlier this month, with a "roughly four-by-five foot" section of plaster falling from the ceiling in the Grand Foyer. It is reported to be in dire need of repairs.

body.zh: 肯尼迪中心的传奇仍在继续，美国联邦法官警告称，特朗普政府不得在至少提前 30 天通知的情况下改变或拆除这座著名的表演艺术中心。 法官克里斯托弗·科珀 (Christopher Copper) 在收到唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 本周发表的评论后发布了该命令，该评论称华盛顿特区的历史建筑必须“拆除”。后来他被拍到正在观看似乎是被拆除的中心的再现。 这座 1960 年代的建筑是为了纪念被暗杀的总统约翰·F·肯尼迪而命名的，政府之间一直存在长期冲突。去年12月，特朗普任命的董事会投票决定将他的名字添加到大楼中，但此举随后被法院阻止。 “我认为特朗普政府当然应该得到认可。因为坦率地说，如果我们不这样做，它就会关闭。它最终会被推倒，”特朗普周四告诉记者。 特朗普支持的肯尼迪中心执行董事马特·弗洛卡(Matt Floca)表示，该建筑已暂时关闭，以评估“结构严重恶化”地区的安全风险。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 民主党人乔伊斯·比蒂对此作出回应，在法庭文件中声称，关闭“是被告永久延长关闭时间并在未来两年关闭肯尼迪中心的良方——法院表示，未经其许可，他们不能这样做。” 特朗普去年第二次就任该中心主席后不久，就罢免了前总统乔·拜登任命的 18 名董事会成员，并让自己的盟友担任关键职位。 新董事会解散了该中心的社会影响部门，并取消了以多元化为重点的项目。数十名知名艺术家、作品和长期驻留团体退出以示抗议。门票销量跌至大流行以来的最低水平。 《华盛顿邮报》最近报道称，该中心预计在 2025 年 10 月 1 日至 2026 年 9 月 30 日期间筹集的资金为 2.2 亿美元（3.09 亿美元），而该中心将仅收取 1.24 亿美元（1.74 亿美元），在大幅削减支出后留下“约 2300 万美元的赤字”。 该建筑在本月早些时候的一场暴风雨中受损，大厅天花板上有一块“大约四乘五英尺”的灰泥掉落。据报道，该处急需维修。 六月，根据库珀法官的命令，工作人员将特朗普的名字从大楼外抹掉，该命令确认只有国会有权改变其...

reflection.en: The Kennedy Center, a national performing arts center, is caught in a political tug-of-war. President Trump's desire to reshape or even demolish it, as reported, raises questions about the stewardship of public institutions. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers...
reflection.zh: 肯尼迪中心，一个国家表演艺术中心，正陷入政治拉锯战。据报道，特朗普总统希望重塑甚至拆除它，这引发了关于公共机构管理的问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这一原则也延伸到为公众利益负责任地照管和保护文化地标。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Aztec manuscript returns to Mexico after two centuries, on loan
title.zh: 阿兹特克手稿在法国展出两个世纪后归还墨西哥

summary.en: The Azcatitlan Codex, a significant 16th-century Aztec manuscript detailing the history of the Aztec capital from its founding to its fall, has returned to Mexico for the first time since 1840. The artifact, on loan from France's Bibliotheque Nationale, is now on display in Mexico City.
summary.zh: 阿兹特克人手稿《阿兹卡蒂特兰法典》是一份重要的16世纪手稿，记录了阿兹特克首都从建立到陷落的历史，现已在1840年后首次返回墨西哥。该文物目前正在墨西哥城展出，是法国国家图书馆的借展品。

body.en:
For years, Mexico has demanded the return of a treasured manuscript. Now the Aztec relic is back home from France — but on loan.

The Azcatitlan Codex, a rare and prized manuscript that recounts the history of the Aztecs in vibrant pictograms, has returned to Mexico for the first time since 1840. It went on display in Mexico City on Thursday.

The codex is a 16th-century artifact and regarded as one of the most important visual records of Aztec history. It records the founding of the Aztec capital to its fall after the subsequent arrival of Spanish conquistadores.

It arrived in Mexico on loan from France's Bibliotheque Nationale, where it has been since 1898. The temporary loan is occurring as the two nations celebrate 200 years of diplomatic ties. 

As two folios from the document went on display inside a glass case at the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexican Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco said the exhibition was about "reuniting a population with its (collective) memory."

The pictograms "represent our history, the written voice of our ancestors, and the deep root of our identity," he said, speaking at the inauguration.

Members of an indigenous group reacted ecstatically to the display. "They hid our history from us, they stole it!" Emilia Mendoza of the Hnahnu community said at the opening exhibition.

"This is a battle won, a first step toward the restitution of these books that reside in other countries," she said.

Made up of Mesoamerican pictograms with European writing, the codex is divided into three parts.

It traces the Mexica's migration from Aztlan — the mythical birthplace of the Aztec civilization — to the founding of Tenochtitlan. That's the capital of the Aztec empire and is present day Mexico City.

The document also depicts the succession of the city's rulers, the arrival of the Spanish and the subsequent evangelization, according to Mexico's National Institute of Anthropology and History.

All of this has been rendered in the codex in vibrant reds, blues, greens and yellows, depicting warriors in feathered headdresses and showcasing ritual acts in pyramid temples.

More than five centuries have now passed since Tenochtitlan fell to Hernan Cortes, the leader of the invading Spanish forces. As most histories of invasion go, Cortes and his allies looted and razed the city after conquest, ushering in three centuries of Spanish domination.

"These codices are extremely important to us because they continue to give us identity and value as human beings during these very special times we are experiencing," said ​Maria Eugenia Castaneda, representative of the Mexica peoples. "They elevate our morale, our customs, our culture, and our sense of who we are."

body.zh: 多年来，墨西哥一直要求归还一份珍贵的手稿。现在，阿兹特克人的遗物已从法国回到祖国，但是以租借的方式。 《阿兹卡蒂特兰抄本》是一份珍贵的稀有手稿，以生动的象形文字讲述了阿兹特克人的历史，自 1840 年以来首次回到墨西哥。该抄本于周四在墨西哥城展出。 该手抄本是一件 16 世纪的文物，被视为阿兹特克历史最重要的视觉记录之一。它记录了阿兹特克首都的建立到随后西班牙征服者到来后的灭亡。 它是从法国国家图书馆借来的，自 1898 年起一直存放在墨西哥。这次临时借阅是在两国庆祝建交 200 周年之际进行的。 当该文件的两页在国家人类学博物馆的玻璃柜内展出时，墨西哥外交部长罗伯托·贝拉斯科表示，这次展览是为了“让人们与其（集体）记忆重新结合起来”。 他在就职典礼上发表讲话时说，这些象形文字“代表了我们的历史、我们祖先的书面声音以及我们身份的根深蒂固”。 土著群体的成员对这次展示欣喜若狂。 “他们向我们隐瞒了我们的历史，他们偷走了它！” Hnahnu 社区的艾米莉亚·门多萨 (Emilia Mendoza) 在开幕式上说道。 “这是一场胜利的战斗，是归还这些存放在其他国家的书籍的第一步，”她说。 该手抄本由中美洲象形文字和欧洲文字组成，分为三个部分。 它追溯了墨西加人从阿兹特兰（阿兹特克文明的神话发源地）的迁徙，直至特诺奇蒂特兰的建立。那是阿兹特克帝国的首都，也是现在的墨西哥城。 据墨西哥国家人类学和历史研究所称，该文件还描述了该城市统治者的继任、西班牙人的到来以及随后的福音传播。 所有这些都在手抄本中以鲜艳的红色、蓝色、绿色和黄色呈现，描绘了戴着羽毛头饰的战士，并展示了金字塔寺庙中的仪式行为。 自从特诺奇蒂特兰被入侵的西班牙军队领导人埃尔南·科尔特斯攻陷以来，已经过去了五个多世纪。正如大多数入侵历史一样，科尔特斯和他的盟友在征服后洗劫并夷平了这座城市，开启了西班牙长达三个世纪的统治。 墨西加人民代表玛丽亚·尤金尼亚·卡斯塔尼达 (Maria Eugenia Castaneda) 表示：“这些抄本对我们极其重要，因为在我们正在经历的这些非常特殊的时期，它们继续赋予我们作为人类的身份和价值。” “它们提升了我们的士气、我们的习俗、我们的文化以及我们的自我意识。” 根据墨西哥历史学家的说法，土著...

reflection.en: After centuries away, the Azcatitlan Codex has returned to Mexico, a testament to the enduring value of cultural heritage. This ancient manuscript, detailing the rise and fall of a great civilization, reminds us that our history and treasures are ultimately gifts from Yahweh, to be cherished and stewarded with gratitude.
reflection.zh: 在远离故土数个世纪后，《阿兹卡蒂特兰法典》已返回墨西哥，这证明了文化遗产的持久价值。这本古老的手稿记录了一个伟大文明的兴衰，提醒我们，我们的历史和宝藏最终都来自雅伟的恩赐，应当怀着感恩之心去珍视和管理。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Russia's election winner is all but decided. But this vote still matters to Putin
title.zh: 普京的选举结果已成定局，但这次投票仍很重要

summary.en: Polls have opened in Russia's parliamentary elections. Despite a predictable outcome, the vote is significant for Vladimir Putin as it is the first since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, a conflict that has resulted in hundreds of thousands of deaths.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯议会选举已开始投票。尽管结果可预见，但这次选举对弗拉基米尔·普京来说意义重大，因为这是自2022年2月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来首次举行的选举，这场冲突已造成数十万人死亡。

body.en:
The United Russia party — fiercely loyal to the country's president, Vladimir Putin — will again be the big winner.

But that doesn't mean the vote to determine who sits in the Russian parliament, known as the Duma, isn't important to the president.

It is, because it's the first since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The conflict has since killed hundreds of thousands of people.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Putin has ruled Russia since 1999 and his United Russia party has dominated Russian politics since the early 2000s.

Criticism of the war on Ukraine is banned in Russia, and only parties that support Putin and the Kremlin's dragging military campaign have been registered to run. Russia has also organised voting in occupied Ukraine.

Nikolai Petrov is a Russian political analyst and served as an adviser to the Kremlin in the early 1990s.

"Not so much are these elections about composition of the state Duma, it’s more or less predefined," he said.

"It’s about keeping the image that society is consolidated around the Kremlin."

Voting is taking place in Crimea, annexed by Russia in 2014, as well as Russian-controlled parts of Ukraine's Donbas, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions in another attempt to try and legitimise the occupation.

In Russia itself, Ukraine's strikes on oil and gas facilities, as well as online retailers' warehouses , have brought the conflict home.

The economy is under increasing strain, and discontent is quietly rising. But there are few options for voters seeking change.

Yabloko, the vocally pro-ceasefire party that had gained popularity through social media, was banned from running by the Supreme Court.

Some individual Yabloko candidates are contesting seats at great personal risk — several have been detained by police. But they're determined to have their voices heard.

"It is very important for us now to tell people that they have an opportunity to vote for peace right now, to express their political position and say that we choose peace, that we choose a life free from fear, that we want our interests to be taken into account, and that we want Russia to prosper, develop and be at peace with everyone," she said.

Polls suggest growing support for peace talks, but the Kremlin is expected to use the election results to claim the vast majority of voters still back the president and, therefore, his war.

Much has been made of veterans of the conflict running as candidates, like Vladislav Golovin, who the Kremlin has been keen to promote.

"I am working not just for myself, but for the guys I couldn't protect or save," he said.

body.zh: 极度忠诚于俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的统一俄罗斯党将再次成为大赢家。 但这并不意味着决定俄罗斯议会（即杜马）席位的投票对总统来说并不重要。 之所以如此，是因为这是自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来的第一次冲突。自那以后，这场冲突已造成数十万人死亡。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 普京自 1999 年以来一直统治俄罗斯，他的统一俄罗斯党自 2000 年代初以来一直主导俄罗斯政坛。 俄罗斯禁止批评乌克兰战争，只有支持普京和克里姆林宫拖延军事行动的政党才能登记参选。俄罗斯还在被占领的乌克兰组织了投票。 尼古拉·彼得罗夫 (Nikolai Petrov) 是一位俄罗斯政治分析家，曾于 20 世纪 90 年代初担任克里姆林宫顾问。 “这些选举与国家杜马的组成无关，它或多或少是预先确定的，”他说。 “这是为了保持社会在克里姆林宫周围得到巩固的形象。” 2014年被俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚以及乌克兰顿巴斯、扎波罗热和赫尔松地区俄罗斯控制的部分地区正在举行投票，这是又一次试图使占领合法化的尝试。 在俄罗斯本土，乌克兰对石油和天然气设施以及在线零售商仓库的袭击已将冲突带回国内。 经济压力日益加大，不满情绪也在悄然上升。但寻求变革的选民几乎没有选择。 通过社交媒体而声名鹊起的支持停火政党“亚布洛科”(Yabloko) 被最高法院禁止参选。 一些亚布洛科候选人冒着巨大的个人风险竞选席位——其中几人已被警方拘留。但他们决心让自己的声音被听到。 她说：“现在对我们来说非常重要的是告诉人们，他们现在有机会投票支持和平，表达他们的政治立场，并说我们选择和平，我们选择没有恐惧的生活，我们希望我们的利益得到考虑，我们希望俄罗斯繁荣、发展并与所有人和平相处。” 民意调查显示，对和平谈判的支持不断增加，但预计克里姆林宫将利用选举结果来声称绝大多数选民仍然支持总统，从而支持他的战争。 许多参加过冲突的退伍军人作为候选人参选，比如克里姆林宫一直热衷提拔的弗拉迪斯拉夫·戈洛文(Vladislav Golovin)。 “我不仅为自己工作，而且为那些我无法保护或拯救的人工作，”他说。 然而后果...

reflection.en: These elections occur in the shadow of a brutal war that has claimed countless lives. The cycle of violence, where aggression often begets further aggression, is a profound human tragedy. Romans 12:21 calls us to resist this destructive pattern, urging us to overcome evil not by mirroring it, but by choosing good, even when it is difficult.
reflection.zh: 此次选举在残酷战争的阴影下进行，这场战争已夺走无数生命。暴力循环，即侵略常常引发进一步的侵略，是一种深刻的人类悲剧。罗马书12:21呼吁我们抵制这种破坏性的模式，敦促我们不要以恶报恶，而是要以善胜恶，即使这很困难。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: 'I am learning': HYROX athlete apologises and withdraws after viral defecation incident
title.zh: “我正在学习”：HYROX运动员在排便事件走红后道歉并退赛

summary.en: Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized and withdrawn from the HYROX race in Beijing after footage of her defecating during the event went viral internationally. She stated, 'I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维特日克（Joanna Wietrzyk）在比赛中排便的视频在国际上走红后，已道歉并从北京的HYROX比赛中退赛。她表示：“我想就比赛期间发生的事情，向中国人民、我的参赛选手、观众以及HYROX组织者致以诚挚的歉意。”

body.en:
The Australian athlete at the centre of the HYROX defecation controversy has apologised and retroactively withdrawn from the race after footage of the incident went viral internationally.

Social media footage showed Australian athlete Joanna Wietrzyk, who holds the women's HYROX solo pro world record, competing at exercise stations with faeces on her legs during a race in Beijing over the weekend.

In a statement posted to Instagram on Thursday night, Wietrzyk apologised for her decision to continue competing.

"I want to offer my sincere apology to the people of China, my fellow competitors, the spectators and the HYROX organizers for what happened during the race in Beijing," she wrote.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I felt completely fit and healthy at the start of the race, with no reason to expect any illness. Looking back, I regret the decision to not have stepped off the track.

"I recognize that I should have made a different choice. I take responsibility for my decision to continue and am deeply sorry for the discomfort and disruption it caused."

Wietrzyk also announced that she would forfeit the points she earned as the competition winner.

"I am learning from this experience and will carry those lessons with me, including remembering that there is more to life than racing and knowing when it is right to step away," she said.

"On reflection, I have decided to retroactively withdraw from the race and forfeit the points I earned."

Ending her statement, Wietrzyk said: "Thank you to those standing by me, both as an athlete and as a person, during this time, and to everyone who has reached out with kindness and support.

"It means more to me than I can properly express right now. I will be taking some time to recover, reflect and look after myself and my family away from the noise."

HYROX is a fitness and endurance race that combines 8km of running with exercises such as rowing, sled pushes and wall balls, carried out in indoor exhibition halls.

Wietrzyk initially shared a selfie on her Instagram story after the race, which showed her lying down with an intravenous line in her arm. It was captioned: "Go hard or go home they say ... a win is a win".

Multiple media outlets also reported that Wietrzyk's major sponsor, Puma, was distancing itself from the athlete after their collaborative line appeared to be quietly removed from the sportswear giant's website a day ago.

The page has since been restored online, with a Puma spokesperson telling CBC News that some landing pages were "unintentionally taken offline".

body.zh: 在该事件的视频在国际上疯传后，处于 HYROX 排便争议中心的澳大利亚运动员已道歉并追溯退出比赛。 社交媒体视频显示，周末在北京举行的一场比赛中，保持着女子 HYROX 单人职业世界纪录的澳大利亚运动员乔安娜·维茨克 (Joanna Wietrzyk) 在训练站进行比赛，腿上沾满粪便。 周四晚上，维茨克在 Instagram 上发布了一份声明，为自己继续参赛的决定道歉。 她写道：“我想就北京比赛期间发生的事情向中国人民、我的竞争对手、观众和 HYROX 组织者表示诚挚的歉意。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “比赛开始时我感觉完全健康，没有理由预期会生病。回想起来，我很遗憾没有离开赛道的决定。 “我认识到我应该做出不同的选择。我对我继续的决定负责，并对由此造成的不适和干扰深表歉意。” Wietrzyk 还宣布她将放弃作为比赛获胜者获得的积分。 她说：“我正在从这次经历中学习，并将随身携带这些教训，包括记住生活不仅仅是比赛，而且知道什么时候离开是正确的。” “经过深思熟虑，我决定追溯退出比赛，并放弃我获得的积分。” 维茨克在结束发言时表示：“感谢在这段时间里站在我身边的人，无论是作为一名运动员还是作为一个人，以及所有伸出善意和支持的人。 “这对我来说意义重大，我现在无法正确表达。我将花一些时间来恢复、反思并照顾自己和家人，远离噪音。” HYROX 是一项健身耐力赛，将 8 公里跑步与划船、推雪橇和墙球等练习结合起来，在室内展厅进行。 比赛结束后，Wietrzyk 最初在她的 Instagram 故事上分享了一张自拍照，照片中她躺着，手臂上插着静脉注射线。标题是：“他们说，要么努力，要么回家……胜利就是胜利”。 多家媒体还报道称，维茨克的主要赞助商彪马正在与这位运动员保持距离，因为一天前他们的合作系列似乎已从这家运动服装巨头的网站上悄悄删除。 该页面现已恢复上线，彪马发言人告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，一些登陆页面“无意中离线”。 该事件引发了对 HYROX 健康和安全标准的强烈反对和批评，许多人想知道为什么 Wietrzyk...

reflection.en: The rapid spread of footage showing Joanna Wietrzyk's unfortunate incident in Beijing serves as a stark reminder of how quickly actions can become public and subject to immediate judgment in the digital age. Her apology and withdrawal demonstrate a willingness to take responsibility, even after the fact, for a choice made under pressure.
reflection.zh: 乔安娜·维特日克在北京比赛中发生的不幸事件的视频迅速传播，鲜明地提醒我们，在数字时代，行为可以多么迅速地公开并受到即时评判。她的道歉和退赛表明，即使事后，她也愿意为在压力下做出的选择承担责任。

verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: The US government is failing Americans on AI | Shakeel Hashim
title.zh: 人工智能对美国人的失败 | 塞凯尔·哈希姆

summary.en: The article criticizes the US government's approach to Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly the Republican stance favoring self-regulation by companies. It argues this is a dereliction of duty that increases AI risks. Prominent AI CEOs like Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Dario Amodei have called for a slowdown due...
summary.zh: 文章批评了美国政府在人工智能（AI）方面的做法，特别是共和党倾向于让公司进行自我监管。文章认为这是一种失职，会增加AI的风险。包括Sam Altman、Elon Musk和Dario...

body.en: Trump and Republicans want companies to regulate themselves. It’s a dereliction of duty that will make AI less safe It is hard to get Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Dario Amodei to agree on much. But over the weekend, all three AI company CEOs called for AI development to slow down in the face of growing, alarming risks. Their employees are sounding the siren too, with one researcher publicly quitting and accusing OpenAI and Anthropic of “gambling with our lives”. The combination of dire warnings from insiders and growing real-world evidence of rogue AIs should, in a sane world, lead to government action. Instead, Donald Trump and the Republican leadership have their heads in the sand. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特朗普和共和党人希望企业自我监管。失职会让人工智能变得不那么安全萨姆·奥尔特曼、埃隆·马斯克和达里奥·阿莫迪很难在很多方面达成一致。但上周末，三位人工智能公司首席执行官都呼吁，面对不断增长的令人震惊的风险，放慢人工智能的发展速度。他们的员工也拉响了警报，一名研究人员公开辞职，并指责 OpenAI 和 Anthropic “拿我们的生命进行赌博”。在一个理智的世界里，内部人士发出的可怕警告和现实世界中越来越多的流氓人工智能证据相结合，应该会导致政府采取行动。相反，唐纳德·特朗普和共和党领导层却把头埋在沙子里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as described in the article, presents a powerful new frontier. Like metals tested in a furnace, the leaders and companies driving this technology are being tested by its potential and the praise it garners. The calls for caution from within the industry itself suggest a recognition that unchecked progress can lead to unforeseen...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的人工智能的快速发展，呈现了一个强大的新领域。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，引领这项技术的领导者和公司正受到其潜力和所获赞誉的考验。行业内部发出的谨慎呼吁表明，人们认识到不受约束的进步可能导致无法预见的危险，这促使人们采取一种更审慎的方法，优先考虑安全和伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

Russia, meanwhile, "views space as a...
body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The ancient prophetic vision of Isaiah, that nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' speaks to our deepest hopes for peace. Yet, the news of weapons being deployed in space, a frontier long envisioned for peaceful exploration, raises concerns about a new arms race. May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...
reflection.zh: 以赛亚先知古老的预言，即列国将“把刀打成犁头”，触及我们对和平最深切的盼望。然而，太空这一曾被设想为和平探索之地的疆域，如今却传出部署武器的消息，这引发了对新军备竞赛的担忧。愿智慧引导列国，在广阔的太空疆域上，优先考虑合作与共同管理，而非冲突。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...

title.en: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback

summary.en: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position. A report by Jennifer Kavanagh of the Defense Priorities Foundation advocates for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense...
