body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，情报主管警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: China has rejected concerns about its AI industry, dismissing calls for the US to impede its progress as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief warned that artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the ruling Communist Party's authority.
summary.zh: 中国驳斥了对其人工智能产业的担忧，称阻止其发展的呼吁是“危言耸听”。与此同时，中国最高情报主管警告称，人工智能可能威胁到执政的共产党当局的统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in China's push for progress, echoes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach new heights, whether through technology or architecture, can lead to unforeseen consequences and challenges to established order. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation with humility and wisdom,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如中国在这一领域所展现的进步一样，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。人类追求更高成就的野心，无论是通过技术还是建筑，都可能带来意想不到的后果，并对既有秩序构成挑战。我们蒙召要以谦卑和智慧追求知识与创新，认识到自身的局限，并努力建设而非过度扩张。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: A sea of hands, a giant ‘lifesaver-saurus’ and a melting robot: Queensland’s SWELL sculpture festival 2026 – in pictures
title.zh: 海量的手、一只巨大的“救生员龙”和一只融化的机器人：昆士兰2026年SWELL雕塑节——图片集

summary.en: The SWELL Sculpture Festival in Currumbin, Queensland, is a 10-day outdoor exhibition featuring nearly 100 large-scale artworks, now in its 24th year. This year's invited artist, Patricia Piccinini, is showcasing a sculpture called 'Salute to the Sun,' described as a chimera blending various forms. The festival runs...
summary.zh: 昆士兰州东南部的卡兰宾每年都会举办为期10天的SWELL雕塑节，届时海滩将变成一个巨大的艺术画廊。这个已有24年历史的免费户外展览展出了近100件大型艺术品。今年的特邀艺术家是帕特里夏·皮奇尼尼，她的作品“向太阳致敬”被描述为融合了鹿、树、真菌、人类和摩托车形态的奇美拉。展览将持续至9月20日星期日。

body.en: The beach becomes a giant art gallery each year as SWELL sculpture festival takes over Currumbin in Queensland’s south-east. Almost 100 large-scale artworks are on display during the free, 10-day outdoor exhibition, now in its 24th year. Among the artists is invited guest Patricia Piccinini, whose bronze sculpture Salute to the Sun ‘is a chimera, seamlessly moving between deer, tree, fungus, human and motorcycle’. The works are on display until Sunday 20 September Sculpture by the Sea 2025: from troubled waters to Bondi beach – in pictures ‘They become part of people’s identity’: how Australia fell in love with the Skywhales Continue reading...
body.zh: 每年，随着 SWELL 雕塑节在昆士兰州东南部的可伦宾举办，海滩变成了一座巨大的艺术画廊。为期 10 天的免费户外展览将展出近 100 件大型艺术品，今年已是第 24 届了。受邀嘉宾帕特里夏·皮奇尼尼 (Patricia Piccinini) 就是其中一位艺术家，她的青铜雕塑《向太阳致敬》“是一个嵌合体，在鹿、树、真菌、人类和摩托车之间无缝移动”。这些作品展出至 9 月 20 日星期日 2025 年海边雕塑：从混乱的水域到邦迪海滩 - 在图片中“它们成为人们身份的一部分”：澳大利亚如何爱上天鲸 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The SWELL festival transforms a natural landscape into a vibrant gallery, showcasing human creativity in diverse forms, from the fantastical 'lifesaver-saurus' to a melting robot. These artistic expressions, in their variety and complexity, remind us of the intricate order that holds all creation together, a testament to the underlying wisdom and power that...
reflection.zh: SWELL雕塑节将自然景观转变为一个充满活力的画廊，展示了人类各种形式的创造力，从奇幻的“救生员龙”到融化的机器人。这些艺术表达，以其多样性和复杂性，提醒我们维系万物的精妙秩序，是支撑一切的根本智慧和力量的证明。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: The fight over immigration could decide the next election. Labor has to take the gloves off | Tom McIlroy
title.zh: 移民问题可能决定下一次选举。工党必须放下包袱

summary.en: The government needs a 'brawler mentality' to confront One Nation's flimsy proposal to drastically reduce the number of immigrants. After delays due to internal politics, Tony Burke presented a brief, note-heavy speech at the National Press Club outlining changes to lower net overseas migration without harming the...
summary.zh: 政府需要一种“斗士心态”来对抗“一人党”大幅削减移民人数的粗糙计划。在内部政治导致数周延迟后，托尼·伯克在国家新闻俱乐部发表了一次简短、笔记密集的演讲，概述了在不损害经济的情况下降低净海外移民人数的改变。

body.en: The government needs a brawler mentality to go after One Nation’s threadbare plan to slash overseas arrivals Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast After weeks of delay on his immigration announcement, Tony Burke appeared at the National Press Club with just a few pages of handwritten notes. Burke’s speech on Thursday – pushed back due to internal politics within the Albanese government – was short on rhetoric and stuck mostly to explaining the changes designed to bring down net overseas migration (Nom), without knee-capping the economy. Continue reading...
body.zh: 政府需要一种争吵心态来追随一国党削减海外入境人数的陈旧计划获取我们新的政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客在推迟了几周的移民公告后，托尼·伯克 (Tony Burke) 出现在国家新闻俱乐部，只带着几页手写笔记。伯克周四的讲话——由于阿尔巴尼亚政府内部政治而被推迟——缺乏言辞，主要是解释旨在减少净海外移民（Nom）的变化，而不会对经济造成膝盖限制。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the political arena, the pursuit of policy goals can sometimes feel like a battle, demanding a 'brawler mentality' as described in the story. Yet, the prophet Micah reminds us that true leadership is found not in aggression, but in acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh. The challenge is to advocate for one's vision with conviction...
reflection.zh: 在政治舞台上，追求政策目标有时会让人感觉像一场战斗，需要一种像故事中所说的“斗士心态”。然而，先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的领导力并非来自好斗，而是体现在秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。挑战在于，要在坚定地倡导自己愿景的同时，坚守这些核心原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Alleged underworld supporters and unfounded health claims: One Nation rolls out more Victorian election candidates
title.zh: 所谓黑帮支持者和毫无根据的健康声明：一国党推出更多维州选举候选人

summary.en: The One Nation party has been steadily introducing candidates for the Victorian state election. These include a former Liberal who allegedly has ties to underworld figures, a naturopath who promoted unfounded claims about paracetamol and autism, and a former councillor disqualified for drunk driving.
summary.zh: 一国党一直在稳步推出维州州议会选举的候选人。其中包括一位据称与黑帮人物有关联的前自由党人士，一位推广了关于扑热息痛与自闭症之间毫无根据的联系的自然疗法师，以及一位因酒驾被吊销驾照的前议员。

body.en: Party has unveiled a steady stream of contenders for state election, including a former councillor who lost his licence for drink-driving Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Candidates contesting the Victorian state election for One Nation include a former Liberal who has won support from alleged underworld figures, a naturopath who has endorsed Donald Trump’s unfounded claim that paracetamol is linked to autism and a former shire councillor who lost his licence for drink-driving. Pauline Hanson announced who would be her party’s upper house candidates and Victorian leader, Warren Pickering, at a press conference last month . Since then One Nation has used social media to unveil a steady stream of candidates, with 51 of the 88 lower house spots now filled. Continue reading...
body.zh: 党已经公布了州选举的源源不断的竞争者，其中包括一名因酒后驾驶而被吊销驾照的前议员 获取我们新的政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 为一国党竞选维多利亚州选举的候选人包括一位赢得了所谓黑社会人物支持的前自由党人士、一位支持唐纳德·特朗普毫无根据地声称扑热息痛与自闭症有关的说法的自然疗法师，以及一位因酒后驾车而被吊销驾照的前郡议员。宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 在上个月的新闻发布会上宣布谁将成为她所在政党的上议院候选人和维多利亚州领导人沃伦·皮克林 (Warren Pickering)。此后，一国党利用社交媒体源源不断地公布候选人名单，众议院 88 个席位中的 51 个席位现已填补。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The introduction of candidates with alleged underworld connections and baseless health claims raises concerns about the integrity of those seeking to represent the public. Proverbs 29:2 warns that when rulers are wicked, the people groan. This situation calls for discernment from voters and accountability from political parties.
reflection.zh: 推出有黑帮背景和毫无根据的健康声明的候选人，引发了人们对寻求代表公众者诚信的担忧。《箴言》29章2节警告说，恶人掌权，百姓就叹息。这种情况呼唤选民的辨别力和政党的问责制。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Australia claims it is a global pioneer in preventing online harm - should other countries follow suit?
title.zh: 澳大利亚声称是防止网络危害的全球先驱——其他国家应该效仿吗？

summary.en: As Prime Minister Anthony Albanese heads to the US to discuss social media reform, he has demonstrated a level of leadership not always expected from a smaller nation. The article explores whether other countries should follow Australia's lead in addressing online harms.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯正前往美国讨论社交媒体改革，他展现了从小国家身上不常有的领导力。文章探讨了其他国家是否应该效仿澳大利亚在解决网络危害方面的做法。

body.en: As Anthony Albanese heads to the US to discuss social media reform, he has shown a level of leadership not always expected from a smaller country Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Statesmen, shysters, dictators. Over the years, the United Nations has seen all kinds of world leaders. But when he arrives in New York on Monday for the annual general assembly, Anthony Albanese will be looking for collaborators. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯前往美国讨论社交媒体改革时，他表现出了小国家所不具备的领导力水平。获取我们新的政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客政治家、狡猾的人、独裁者。多年来，联合国见过各种各样的世界领导人。但当安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一抵达纽约参加年度大会时，他将寻找合作者。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world grappling with the complexities of online spaces, Australia, under Prime Minister Albanese, is stepping forward to champion reform. This proactive stance on social media regulation highlights a commitment to addressing societal challenges, a principle echoed in Jeremiah's call for leaders to 'execute justice and righteousness.' May leaders...
reflection.zh: 在一个努力应对网络空间复杂性的世界里，澳大利亚在阿尔巴尼斯总理的领导下，正挺身而出倡导改革。这种在社交媒体监管方面的积极姿态，体现了对解决社会挑战的承诺，这一原则在耶利米呼吁领袖“施行公平和公义”的经文中得到了呼应。愿各地的领袖都受到启发，为共同利益采取勇敢的行动。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Swedish teenager jailed for attempted murder, rape and assault committed online, with victims in Germany and Australia
title.zh: 瑞典少年因网上实施的谋杀未遂、强奸和袭击罪被判刑，受害者在德国和澳大利亚

summary.en: An 18-year-old, known as Chai, was active in networks notorious for the sadistic exploitation of young people. Chai has been sentenced to over 10 years in jail for attempted murder, rape, and aggravated assault committed via the internet, including against a teenage girl in Australia. The court found Chai was involved...
summary.zh: 一名被称为Chai的18岁瑞典少年活跃于以残忍剥削年轻人而臭名昭著的网络。他因通过互联网实施谋杀未遂、强奸和严重袭击罪被判处10年以上监禁，受害者包括一名澳大利亚少女。法院认定Chai参与了网络组织，这些组织勒索年轻弱势群体，强迫他们制作露骨内容或参与暴力行为。

body.en: Eighteen-year-old known as Chai was active in networks notorious for their sadistic exploitation of young people A Swedish teenager known as Chai has been sentenced to more than 10 years in jail for attempted murder, rape and aggravated assault – crimes committed via the internet, including against a teenage girl in Australia . The district court found that Chai, 18, was active in online networks notorious for their sadistic extortion of young and vulnerable people, coercing them to create sexually explicit material or engage in acts of violence – and for the youth of those involved. In Australia, support is available at Beyond Blue on 1300 22 4636, Lifeline on 13 11 14, and at MensLine on 1300 789 978. In the UK, the charity Mind is available on 0300 123 3393 and Childline on 0800 1111. In the US, call or text Mental Health America at 988 or chat 988lifeline.org. Continue reading...
body.zh: 18 岁的 Chai 活跃于因虐待年轻人而臭名昭著的网络中。瑞典一名名叫 Chai 的青少年因谋杀未遂、强奸和严重攻击罪被判处 10 多年监禁，罪名是通过互联网实施的犯罪行为，其中包括针对澳大利亚一名少女的犯罪行为。地区法院发现，18 岁的 Chai 活跃于网络网络，该网络因对年轻人和弱势群体进行虐待勒索而臭名昭著，强迫他们制作露骨的色情内容或参与暴力行为——以及参与其中的年轻人。在澳大利亚，您可以通过 Beyond Blue（1300 22 4636）、Lifeline（13 11 14）和 MensLine（1300 789 978）获得支持。在英国，慈善机构 Mind（慈善机构）的电话号码为 0300 123 3393，Childline（儿童热线）的电话号码为 0800 1111。在美国，请拨打 Mental Health America（988）或发短信或聊天。 988lifeline.org。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The internet can be a space where vulnerability is preyed upon, and young people are coerced into horrific acts. This case underscores the urgent need to speak up for those who are exploited and silenced, ensuring their plight is not ignored. We are called to be a voice for the voiceless, protecting the vulnerable from such predatory networks.
reflection.zh: 互联网可能成为剥削弱势群体的空间，年轻人被胁迫从事可怕的行为。此案凸显了为那些被剥削和噤声者发声的紧迫性，确保他们的困境不被忽视。我们蒙召为无声者发声，保护弱势群体免受此类掠夺性网络的侵害。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Beaches closed after man dies in shark attack near Perth
title.zh: 珀斯附近发生鲨鱼袭击事件，一名男子死亡，海滩关闭

summary.en: Authorities have confirmed a male swimmer is dead after being attacked by a shark at Perth's Sorrento Beach. The incident led to the closure of local beaches.
summary.zh: 当局证实，一名男性游泳者在珀斯索伦托海滩遭到鲨鱼袭击后死亡。事件导致当地海滩关闭。

body.en:
A swimmer is dead after being attacked by a shark off a popular Western Australian beach.

Emergency services attended Perth's Sorrento Beach about 10.30am on Friday after reports a male had been bitten by a shark while swimming along the coast.

Authorities searched for the swimmer from the air and sea, but he died from the attack, with his remains found in the water, WA Police said.

The Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development is investigating the incident, the second shark attack off WA's coast in five days.

A witness told ABC News she was alerted to the attack when she was walking along the beach and saw a pool of blood in the water.

Patrol flights in WA's southwest between Bunbury and Hamelin Bay will run daily during school holidays and peak summer periods, and on weekends and public holidays at other times.

body.zh: 一名游泳者在西澳大利亚一个受欢迎的海滩上被鲨鱼袭击后死亡。 周五上午 10 点 30 分左右，紧急服务人员赶到了珀斯的索伦托海滩，此前有报道称，一名男子在海岸游泳时被鲨鱼咬伤。 西澳警方表示，当局从空中和海上搜寻了这名游泳者，但他在袭击中死亡，他的遗体在水中被发现。 第一产业和区域发展部正在调查这起事件，这是西澳海岸五天内发生的第二起鲨鱼袭击事件。 一名目击者告诉美国广播公司新闻，当她沿着海滩散步并看到水中有一滩血时，她意识到了袭击事件。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 作为预防措施，君达乐市已关闭该地区的所有海滩，从北部的伯恩斯海滩到南部的马米恩，直至周六中午。 该男子在该州中西部杰拉尔顿以北的格伦菲尔德海滩受重伤。 他被送往附近的杰拉尔顿健康校区，目前情况稳定。 这些航班最初将在周末运营，然后从 9 月 26 日至 4 月底，增加至曼哲拉 (Mandurah) 和扬切普 (Yanchep) 以及西部罗特内斯特岛 (Rottnest Island) 之间的每日班次。 西澳西南部班伯里和哈梅林湾之间的巡逻航班将在学校假期和夏季高峰期以及周末和公共假期期间每天运行。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The suddenness of death, even in a place of leisure like Sorrento Beach, can be a stark reminder of life's fragility. We mourn with those who grieve this loss, holding onto the hope that Yahweh promises a future where death and suffering will cease entirely.
reflection.zh: 死亡的突然降临，即使是在索伦托海滩这样的休闲场所，也可能成为生命脆弱性的一个严峻提醒。我们与那些为此悲伤的人一同哀悼，并坚守雅伟所应许的未来——一个死亡和痛苦将完全消失的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers affected by data breach
title.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户受数据泄露事件影响

summary.en: Nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers have had their personal information compromised in a data breach, with experts questioning the length of time companies retain such data.
summary.zh: 近两百万Quest Apartment Hotels客户的个人信息在一场数据泄露事件中遭到泄露，专家们质疑公司保留此类数据的时长。

body.en:
Personal information of nearly two million Quest Apartment Hotels customers has been compromised in a data breach, including credit card, passport and Medicare numbers.

Last month, the accommodation provider identified a cyberattack on a database system via a vulnerability in a third-party technology provider.

David Mansfield, the managing director of The Ascott Limited, which owns Quest Apartment Hotels, provided an update this week, saying a forensic data analysis revealed information relating to approximately 1,991,613 customers was affected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Mansfield said the company was contacting those affected directly to inform them of which category they were in, the steps they could take, and available support.

"I recognise the concern this incident has caused. On behalf of Quest, I sincerely apologise to those who have been affected," he said.

Quest said it first identified an outage on its website on 17 August, with investigation revealing "a malicious attack" had exploited a vulnerability in a third-party service provider's software.

The company is advising customers to remain alert for suspicious emails, text messages and telephone calls, particularly communications requesting personal, financial or account information.

Quest said it was cooperating with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, the Australian Signals Directorate, the Australian Cyber Security Centre and Victoria Police.

Last year's Annual Cyber Threat Report warned cyberattacks were a growing problem in Australia, with financial losses, ransomware attack frequency, and the number of reported data breaches all increasing.

After a major data breach involving millions of Optus customers in 2022 , the federal government overhauled privacy laws, requiring companies to destroy or actively de-identify personal information as soon as it was no longer needed.

Paul Watters, chief executive of Cyberstronomy, which provides cyber risk expertise, said all businesses needed to have a clear understanding of the personal data they hold and why.

"Quest says all of the affected information came from records dating from before June 2025. That immediately raises a governance question: for each category of information, why was it still being retained?"

"Audit your data holdings. Know what you have, where it is, why you are retaining it, how long you need it, and when it should be deleted or de-identified. Data you no longer hold cannot be stolen in a breach," he said.

Belinda Barnet, a Swinburne University data privacy expert, told SBS News the latest incident raised concerns about the type of data some companies were still...
body.zh: 近 200 万 Quest Apartment Hotels 客户的个人信息在数据泄露中遭到泄露，其中包括信用卡、护照和医疗保险号码。 上个月，住宿提供商发现通过第三方技术提供商的漏洞对数据库系统进行了网络攻击。 Quest Apartment Hotels 旗下的雅诗阁有限公司 (The Ascott Limited) 董事总经理戴维·曼斯菲尔德 (David Mansfield) 本周提供了最新情况，称法证数据分析显示，与大约 1,991,613 名客户相关的信息受到了影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 曼斯菲尔德表示，该公司正在直接联系那些受影响的人，告知他们属于哪一类、可以采取的步骤以及可以获得的支持。 “我认识到这一事件引起的关注。我代表 Quest 向那些受到影响的人真诚地道歉，”他说。 Quest 表示，它于 8 月 17 日首次发现其网站出现故障，调查显示“恶意攻击”利用了第三方服务提供商软件中的漏洞。 该公司建议客户对可疑电子邮件、短信和电话保持警惕，特别是要求个人、财务或帐户信息的通信。 Quest 表示正在与澳大利亚信息专员办公室、澳大利亚信号局、澳大利亚网络安全中心和维多利亚警方合作。 去年的年度网络威胁报告警告称，网络攻击在澳大利亚是一个日益严重的问题，经济损失、勒索软件攻击频率以及报告的数据泄露数量都在增加。 2022 年发生涉及数百万 Optus 客户的重大数据泄露事件后，联邦政府彻底修改了隐私法，要求公司在不再需要个人信息时立即销毁或主动去识别化。 提供网络风险专业知识的 Cyber​​stronomy 首席执行官保罗·沃特斯 (Paul Watters) 表示，所有企业都需要清楚地了解他们所持有的个人数据及其原因。 “Quest 表示，所有受影响的信息都来自 2025 年 6 月之前的记录。这立即引发了一个治理问题：对于每一类信息，为什么仍然保留它？” “审计你持有的数据。了解你拥有什么、它在哪里、为什么保留它、你需要它多长时间以及何时应该删除它或去识别化。你不再持有的数据不会在泄露中被窃取，”他说。 斯威本大学数据隐私专家贝琳达·巴尼特 (Belinda Barnet) 告诉 SBS 新闻，最新事件引发了人们对一些公司仍在保留的数据类型的担忧……

reflection.en: The compromise of sensitive data like credit card and passport numbers for nearly two million customers underscores the risks inherent in storing vast amounts of personal information. This incident serves as a stark reminder of the potential for misuse and the deep-seated human desire for wealth and control that can drive illicit activities.
reflection.zh: 近两百万客户的信用卡和护照号码等敏感数据遭到泄露，凸显了存储大量个人信息所固有的风险。此次事件警示我们，这些信息可能被滥用，也反映了人类对财富和控制的深层渴望可能驱动非法活动。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: ICE enforcement in Australia? Burke quizzed over US-style detention concerns
title.zh: 澳大利亚的移民执法？伯克被问及对美国式拘留的担忧

summary.en: Australia's Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected claims that the country is adopting a US-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over new migration reforms. The reforms include tougher measures for visa overstayers, with plans to add detention beds and compliance officers.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚内政部长托尼·伯克否认了该国正在效仿美国式移民执法模式的说法，此前政府的移民改革引发了强烈反对。改革包括对签证逾期居留者采取更严厉的措施，并计划增加拘留床位和合规官员。

body.en:
Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke has rejected suggestions that Australia is moving towards a United States-style immigration enforcement model following backlash over the government's migration reforms .

Burke announced the new policy settings on Thursday, with the most consequential changes targeting "visa-hoppers", overstayers, students and backpackers in a bid to bring down net overseas migration figures.

People who overstay their visas, a cohort of roughly 77,000 people, would face tougher enforcement measures under the government's plans, including the prospect of detention. To discourage overstaying, the government will add 250 beds and 100 compliance officers, restoring capacity Burke said existed before 2015.

Under the pre-2015 approach, Burke said overstayers were detained and generally organised their own flights home within a matter of weeks. "This is not the sort of operation that some people have seen on TV happening in other countries," he said in his address.

The announcement nonetheless drew comparisons to US President Donald Trump's hardline immigration crackdown, carried out by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency since he took office last year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The agency has taken an aggressive approach to enforcement, detention and deportation, triggering mass protests, legal challenges and fierce debate over the treatment of migrants.

He reiterated that the policy is simply a return to Australia's approach before 2015, when visa overstayers, such as students, were routinely contacted, encouraged to leave, and, if necessary, detained briefly before arranging their own departure.

He said the practice ended when detention centres became dominated by criminals, forcing resources to be redirected. Burke described the proposed expansion to 250 detention beds as a modest restoration of a system that had operated for years.

"Australia stopped doing it for the very simple reason that our detention centres filled up with criminals," he told SBS News.

"That's what happened, and there's no way — in a block that's got a whole lot of people who've done some horrific things and have come straight from prison — that I'm going to put an international student who's overstayed in the same place. I'm just not going to do that."

He said it meant that for the past 11 years, Australia had "stopped doing what is the normal thing to do", referring to the use of detention as a deterrent for people who remain in the country after their visas expire.

"It's a very modest program. It used to be 250 beds, it'll be 250 beds again. It's nothing other than something that used to happen all the time, and...
body.zh: 在政府移民改革遭到强烈反对后，内政部长托尼·伯克拒绝了有关澳大利亚正在转向美国式移民执法模式的说法。 伯克周四宣布了新的政策设置，其中最重要的变化针对“签证跳跃者”、逾期居留者、学生和背包客，以降低海外净移民人数。 根据政府的计划，逾期居留的人约有 77,000 人，将面临更严厉的执法措施，包括可能被拘留。为了防止逾期居留，政府将增加 250 个床位和 100 名合规官员，恢复伯克所说的 2015 年之前的能力。 伯克表示，根据 2015 年之前的做法，逾期居留者会被拘留，并且通常会在几周内自行安排航班回家。他在讲话中说：“这不是一些人在电视上看到的其他国家发生的那种行动。” 尽管如此，这一声明还是与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)去年上任以来移民和海关执法局(ICE)实施的强硬移民镇压相提并论。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该机构在执法、拘留和驱逐方面采取了激进的做法，引发了大规模抗议、法律挑战以及关于移民待遇的激烈辩论。 他重申，这项政策只是回到了2015年之前澳大利亚的做法，当时，签证逾期居留者（例如学生）会被例行联系，鼓励他们离开，如果有必要，在安排他们自己离开之前会被短暂拘留。 他说，当拘留中心被犯罪分子控制时，这种做法就结束了，迫使资源重新分配。伯克称，拟议将拘留床位扩建至 250 个，是对已运行多年的系统的一次适度修复。 “澳大利亚停止这样做的原因很简单，因为我们的拘留中心挤满了罪犯，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “事情就是这样发生的，在一个有很多人做过一些可怕的事情并且刚从监狱出来的街区里，我不可能把一个逾期居留的国际学生放在同一个地方。我只是不会这样做。” 他说，这意味着在过去11年里，澳大利亚“不再做正常的事情”，指的是利用拘留作为对签证到期后留在澳大利亚的人的威慑。 “这是一个非常温和的计划。以前有 250 个床位，将来还会有 250 个床位。这只不过是过去经常发生的事情，而且......

reflection.en: The Australian government is implementing stricter measures for visa overstayers, including potential detention. This raises questions about how nations balance border security with humane treatment. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to 'do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' May leaders always seek to...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚政府正在对签证逾期居留者实施更严格的措施，包括可能的拘留。这引发了关于国家如何在边境安全与人道待遇之间取得平衡的问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁领导人“要施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。愿领导人永远寻求以公平和怜悯来治理。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: The competing visions for Australia's migration system
title.zh: 澳大利亚移民体系的竞争愿景

summary.en: Australia's federal government has introduced long-awaited migration reforms, including changes to migration caps and visa regulations. Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke presented the policy as a result of year-long planning, distinct from recent political pressures, though analysts suggest it responds to the rise of...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦政府已推出期待已久的移民改革，包括调整移民上限和签证规定。内政部长托尼·伯克将该政策呈现为一年规划的结果，与近期的政治压力无关，尽管分析人士认为这是对优先控制移民的政党崛起的反应。

body.en:
After weeks of headlines dominated by One Nation, the federal government has unveiled its long-awaited migration reforms.

Notably, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke did not name Pauline Hanson's party during his 35-minute National Press Club speech on Thursday, and he was quick to point out the policy had been in the works since last year.

"It's simply demonstrably wrong to suspect that somehow this is a recent bit of work done to deal with a political climate; it's not," he said.

Yet some analysts say it's difficult not to see the government as responding to the rise of One Nation, which has overtaken Labor on the primary vote and is the favoured party on immigration, according to some polls.

Nine newspapers reported Prime Minister Anthony Albanese was concerned about the optics of using a forum like the Press Club to draw more attention to an issue being dominated by One Nation — a claim Burke rejected on Thursday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

One Nation announced its migration policy earlier this week, promising to end "mass migration" by cutting temporary visas by 750,000 over three years and delivering net negative migration to ease pressure on housing, healthcare and infrastructure.

That follows the Coalition's plan announced in April, while the Greens' policy platform is the same one it took to the 2025 federal election.

With the political battle lines drawn on one of the most major issues facing Australia, where do these parties stand on migration?

The government wants to reduce Australia's net overseas migration (NOM) figure from its current level of 292,100.

It has forecast figures of 245,000 for 2026-27 and 225,000 each year thereafter.

Burke acknowledged in his address there were housing pressures, but rejected claims Australia was experiencing mass migration.

"We need immigration to soften enough that housing has a chance to catch up," he said.

Among the most consequential changes are those affecting students, backpackers, visa overstayers and "visa hoppers".

International students will no longer be able to bring their family members to Australia, though there are some exceptions, including for PhD students.

To extend their visas, a student will now have to transfer to a higher course, such as from a bachelor's degree to a master's.

A ballot system and cap will be introduced for second and third-year working holiday-makers. There will be 45,000 second-year places and 5,000 third-year — down from the current 57,000 and 31,000 respectively.

Visa overstayers, estimated at 77,000, will be detained, reviving a policy in place before 2015. The government is now chasing more facilities, compliance officers...
body.zh: 在一国党占据头条新闻数周后，联邦政府公布了期待已久的移民改革。 值得注意的是，内政部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）在周四 35 分钟的全国新闻俱乐部演讲中没有点出宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）所在政党的名字，他很快指出这项政策自去年以来就一直在酝酿之中。 “怀疑这是最近为应对政治气候所做的一些工作，这显然是错误的；事实并非如此，”他说。 然而一些分析人士表示，很难不认为政府是对一国党崛起的回应，根据一些民意调查，一国党在初选中超过了工党，并且是移民问题上最受欢迎的政党。 九家报纸报道称，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese）对利用新闻俱乐部等论坛吸引更多人关注一国党主导的问题的做法感到担忧——伯克周四否认了这一说法。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一国党本周早些时候宣布了其移民政策，承诺通过在三年内削减 75 万个临时签证并实现净负移民来结束“大规模移民”，以缓解住房、医疗保健和基础设施方面的压力。 这是继联盟党 4 月份宣布的计划之后，绿党的政策纲领与 2025 年联邦选举时的政策纲领相同。 由于政治战线围绕澳大利亚面临的最重大问题之一，这些政党在移民问题上的立场如何？ 政府希望将澳大利亚的净海外移民 (NOM) 人数从目前的 292,100 人减少。 预计 2026-27 年的数字为 245,000 人，此后每年为 225,000 人。 伯克在讲话中承认存在住房压力，但否认澳大利亚正在经历大规模移民的说法。 “我们需要移民足够软化，以便住房市场有机会迎头赶上，”他说。 最重要的变化包括影响学生、背包客、签证逾期居留者和“签证跳跃者”的变化。 国际学生将无法再将家人带到澳大利亚，但也有一些例外，包括博士生。 为了延长签证，学生现在必须转学到更高的课程，例如从学士学位转到硕士学位。 将为第二年和第三年的工作度假者引入抽签制度和上限。二年级和三年级将有 45,000 个名额和 5,000 个名额，分别低于目前的 57,000 个和 31,000 个。 估计有 77,000 名签证逾期居留者将被拘留，恢复 2015 年之前实施的政策。政府目前正在寻求更多设施，合规官员……

reflection.en: As Australia grapples with its migration policies, the ancient call to welcome the foreigner resonates. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us that Yahweh loves the foreigner, providing for them and urging us to do the same. May leaders and citizens alike consider the humanity of those seeking a new home, extending compassion and justice in policy and practice.
reflection.zh: 在澳大利亚就其移民政策进行辩论之际，古老的欢迎外国人的呼吁依然响亮。申命记10:19提醒我们，雅伟喜爱寄居的，顾念他，使我们也要如此。愿领导人和公民都能在政策和实践中，以同情心和公正对待那些寻求新家园的人的境况。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: The forces turning Australia's inflation fears into a reality
title.zh: 将澳大利亚的通胀担忧变为现实的因素

summary.en: While growth in the Australian economy is slowing, the RBA governor said, the bank's concerns about inflation are materialising. This could lead to further interest rate hikes.
summary.zh: 尽管澳大利亚经济增长放缓，但澳大利亚储备银行行长表示，该银行对通胀的担忧正在成为现实。这可能导致进一步加息。

body.en:
The Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) fears about inflation have materialised, its governor Michele Bullock says, which could force it to raise interest rates again .

Her comments during a parliamentary hearing on Friday morning reaffirmed expectations that the central bank would hike rates for a fourth time this year at its upcoming board meeting in late September.

Inflation was too high, but the key question for the RBA at that meeting would be whether the bank's three rate rises to date were enough to bring inflation back to target in a reasonable time, Bullock said.

At its last meeting in August , the RBA forecast that inflation would return to the middle of its target range of 2-3 per cent by the end of 2027.

Even that was not assured, with inflation more likely to overshoot the bank's forecasts than undershoot it.

If that proved to be the case, more rate hikes might be warranted, the RBA board said at the time.

"Developments since then suggest that, although growth in the Australian economy is slowing, some of these upside risks to inflation appear to be materialising," Bullock said on Friday.

The Middle East conflict , the AI boom, and extreme weather events have added to pressure on energy, food, and tech prices, she said.

"There is little sign of resolution in the Middle East conflict. Oil and related prices have increased sharply again and will add directly to inflation."

The benchmark Brent crude price remained above US$104 ($146) a barrel, despite a modest sell-off in oil overnight on news that Saudi Arabia plans to bring its East-West pipeline back online in a reduced capacity following attacks by Iran-backed Houthi forces.

But as businesses increasingly saw no end in sight to the war and price increases, they were growing more inclined to pass on costs to consumers, which risked making inflation more persistent, Bullock said.

After inflation came in hotter than expected in July , money markets have raised the chance for a September rate rise above 80 per cent, with two hikes fully priced in by March.

Higher-for-longer interest rates and fuel prices would hit economic growth, but that has been swamped by the AI boom, which has pushed up demand in a way the RBA did not foresee.

"Just back from the US and in addition to ... the upside risk of inflation from the Middle East, what is also very striking is how strong the AI and tech boom is and has been," RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser said.

"That's not just true in the US; it's true in the Asia Pacific region as well, who are of course our closest trading partners, and our forecasts for global growth have been repeatedly surprised on the...
body.zh: 澳大利亚储备银行 (RBA) 行长米歇尔·布洛克 (Michele Bullock) 表示，其对通胀的担忧已经成为现实，这可能迫使其再次加息。 她在周五上午的议会听证会上发表的言论重申了人们的预期，即央行将在 9 月底召开的董事会会议上进行今年第四次加息。 布洛克表示，通胀过高，但澳联储在这次会议上的关键问题是，该行迄今为止的三次加息是否足以在合理的时间内使通胀回到目标水平。 在 8 月份的最后一次会议上，澳大利亚央行预测，到 2027 年底，通胀将回到 2-3% 目标区间的中间位置。 即便如此，也不能保证这一点，因为通胀更有可能超出央行的预测，而不是低于央行的预测。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 澳洲联储董事会当时表示，如果事实果真如此，可能需要进一步加息。 布洛克周五表示：“此后的事态发展表明，尽管澳大利亚经济增长正在放缓，但通胀上行风险似乎正在显现。” 她表示，中东冲突、人工智能繁荣和极端天气事件加大了能源、食品和科技价格的压力。 “中东冲突几乎没有解决的迹象。石油和相关价格再次大幅上涨，将直接加剧通胀。” 尽管有消息称沙特阿拉伯计划在受到伊朗支持的胡塞武装袭击后减少其东西向管道的运力，导致隔夜石油小幅抛售，但基准布伦特原油价格仍高于每桶 104 美元（146 美元）。 但布洛克表示，随着企业越来越多地看到战争和价格上涨没有结束的迹象，他们越来越倾向于将成本转嫁给消费者，这有可能使通货膨胀更加持久。 7 月份通胀高于预期后，货币市场将 9 月份加息的可能性提高到 80% 以上，到 3 月份的两次加息已完全反映在市场中。 长期较高的利率和燃料价格将打击经济增长，但这已被人工智能的繁荣所淹没，人工智能以澳大利亚央行没有预见到的方式推高了需求。 澳洲联储副行长安德鲁·豪瑟表示：“刚从美国回来，除了……中东通胀的上行风险之外，人工智能和科技繁荣的强劲程度也非常引人注目。” “这不仅在美国如此，在亚太地区也是如此，他们当然是我们最亲密的贸易伙伴，我们对全球增长的预测一再令人惊讶......

A report, along with recommendations for improvement measures, is expected in eight weeks. The 54-year-old male patient was admitted to hospital on Wednesday morning “due to deteriorated mental...

title.en: Lam lays down law on potential AI misues, breakouts
title.zh: 林郑月娥就潜在的AI滥用、泄露事件制定法律

summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam stated that while specific laws for governing artificial intelligence may not yet exist, this does not create a legal vacuum for addressing the misuse of the technology. In his Policy Address on Wednesday, Chief Executive John Lee emphasized that ensuring the safe use of AI is as vital...
summary.zh: 律政司司長林定表示，雖然可能尚未有專門規管人工智能的法律，但這並不意味著在處理該技術的濫用方面存在法律真空。在周三的施政報告中，行政長官李家超強調，確保人工智能的安全使用與其發展同等重要。李家超提出了七項關鍵策略，包括成立由律政司領導的專責小組，評估規管未成年人社交媒體使用及其與人工智能互動的必要性，並審查人工智能產品...

body.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said laws dedicated to the governance of artificial intelligence might not yet be in place but that did not mean there was a legal vacuum to tackle misuse of the technology. In his Policy Address on Wednesday, Chief Executive John Lee stressed that ensuring the safe use of AI is just as crucial as using it for development. Lee laid out seven key strategies in this regard, including establishing a dedicated task force led by the Department of Justice to evaluate the need to regulate minors' social media use and their interactions with AI, as well as reviewing the legal liability for accidents caused by AI products. The Law Reform Commission is studying whether new legislation is required to combat deepfake-generated pornographic images and deepfake-driven online scams with a view to submitting a report to the government. Lam said on Friday the administration was deeply concerned about the potential harm that might ensue from AI misuse and pledged to expedite legislation if intervention was deemed necessary. The justice minister stressed that existing technology-neutral laws were capable of being used to prosecute those who used technology as a tool for criminal activities. “Say deception, the whole idea is that somebody used some sort of instrument or tool to facilitate his or her commission of deceptive conduct," he said. "So in this context, it doesn't matter what the tool is, how primitive, how advanced, so long as you're using some sort of instrument to facilitate the commission of a crime, that would constitute criminal conduct. “I hope that people would not be under a misapprehension that at the moment there is nothing at all to regulate the misuse of AI technology to commit criminal activities.” Lam said the task force on minors' social media use and AI interactions would be set up as soon as possible. It will collaborate with other bureaus and departments as well as study overseas practices to formulate the most suitable approach for Hong Kong in tackling this issue. “What I wish to emphasise is that legislative intervention is only one of the options, and definitely has to be coupled with other measures,” Lam said. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 律政司司长林郑月娥表示，专门针对人工智能治理的法律可能尚未到位，但这并不意味着解决该技术滥用问题存在法律真空。行政长官李家超在周三的施政报告中强调，确保人工智能的安全使用与利用人工智能进行发展同样重要。李就此提出了七项关键策略，包括成立由司法部领导的专门工作组，评估规范未成年人社交媒体使用及其与人工智能互动的必要性，以及审查人工智能产品造成事故的法律责任。法律改革委员会正在研究是否需要制定新的立法来打击深度造假产生的色情图片和深度造假驱动的网络诈骗，以便向政府提交报告。林郑月娥周五表示，政府对人工智能滥用可能带来的潜在危害深感担忧，并承诺如果认为有必要进行干预，将加快立法速度。司法部长强调，现有的技术中立法律能够用来起诉那些利用技术作为犯罪活动工具的人。 “说到欺骗，整个想法就是有人使用某种工具或工具来促进他或她的欺骗行为，”他说。 “因此，在这种情况下，无论工具是什么，多么原始，多么先进，只要你使用某种工具来便利实施犯罪，那就构成犯罪行为。“我希望人们不要误认为，目前没有任何东西可以规范滥用人工智能技术进行犯罪活动。林郑月娥表示，将尽快成立未成年人社交媒体使用和人工智能互动专责小组。我们会与其他决策局和部门合作，并研究海外做法，制定最适合香港的解决办法。林郑月娥表示：“我想强调的是，立法干预只是其中一种选择，肯定必须配合其他措施。”埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented knowledge and capabilities. As Hong Kong's justice secretary notes, the challenge lies not in a lack of laws, but in applying existing principles to new technologies. This echoes Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times, urging us to seek wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速發展為人類帶來了前所未有的知識和能力。正如香港律政司司長所指出的，挑戰不在於法律的匱乏，而在於如何將現有原則應用於新興技術。這呼應了但以理關於末世知識增長的預言，敦促我們在駕馭這些強大工具時，尋求智慧和道德指引。

title.en: 'QEH move to Kai Tak will be seamless'
title.zh: 伊利沙伯醫院遷往啟德將無縫進行

summary.en: Health minister Lo Chung-mau stated that the relocation of Queen Elizabeth Hospital to Kai Tak Hospital will be conducted in phases to ensure a smooth transition for patients. Kai Tak Hospital, the largest under the Hospital Authority, will commence services in two phases, with the first phase next month, gradually...
summary.zh: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，將軍澳醫院的伊利沙伯醫院搬遷工作將分階段進行，以確保病人順利過渡。啟德醫院是醫院管理局轄下最大的醫院，將分兩階段投入服務，第一階段將於下月展開，逐步接管伊利沙伯醫院的臨床服務。伊利沙伯醫院的京士柏現址將改建為本港首間綜合診所醫院。

body.en: Health minister Lo Chung-mau said the relocation of Queen Elizabeth Hospital to Kai Tak Hospital will be carried out in phases to ensure a seamless transition for patients. Kai Tak Hospital, the largest hospital under the Hospital Authority, will begin services in two phases as planned, with the first phase next month. It will gradually absorb clinical services from Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Meanwhile, officials said the Queen Elizabeth Hospital site in King’s Park will be redeveloped into the city’s first integrated ambulatory care hospital. Speaking at a press conference on Friday on initiatives in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the Policy Address, Lo said the phased relocation is designed to avoid disruptions. "We understand that there may be some patients who may not be used to that and so be assured that we will ensure that all those patients who have follow-up or new appointments at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital will be seamlessly relocated to Kai Tak," he said. "And even if they forgot about the appointment and end up in the wrong place in Queen Elizabeth Hospital, we will provide the service for them at the spot." On manpower, Lo said that of nearly 30,000 nurses in public healthcare, only about 0.6 percent – or 180 – are non-locally trained. The secretary for health also said no non-locally trained psychiatric nurses have been recruited by the Hospital Authority. He stressed that health officials give priority to recruiting locally graduated nurses. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 卫生部长罗仲茂表示，伊利沙伯医院迁往启德医院的计划将分阶段进行，以确保病人无缝过渡。医院管理局辖下最大的医院启德医院将按计划分两期开始服务，第一期将于下月开始。它将逐步吸收伊利沙伯医院的临床服务。与此同时，官员们表示，位于国王公园的伊丽莎白女王医院将被重新开发为该市第一家综合流动护理医院。罗在周五就香港第一个五年计划和施政报告中的举措举行的新闻发布会上表示，分阶段搬迁的目的是为了避免干扰。他说：“我们明白有些病人可能不习惯，所以请放心，我们将确保所有在伊利沙伯医院有后续或新预约的病人将无缝转移到启德。” “即使他们忘记了预约，最终来到了伊丽莎白女王医院的错误地点，我们也会当场为他们提供服务。”在人力方面，Lo表示，在公共医疗保健领域近3万名护士中，只有约0.6%（即180名）接受过非本地培训。卫生局局长还表示，医院管理局没有聘用非本地培训的精神科护士。他强调，卫生官员优先招聘当地毕业的护士。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The redevelopment of Queen Elizabeth Hospital into a new ambulatory care facility signifies a commitment to public health infrastructure. This undertaking, like any significant public service, carries a moral weight to serve the people justly and effectively. May those in leadership remember their duty to provide care and resources that truly benefit the...
reflection.zh: 伊利沙伯醫院重建為新的綜合診所醫院，體現了對公共衛生基礎設施的承諾。這項工程，如同任何重要的公共服務一樣，承載著公正有效地服務民眾的道德責任。願領導者們銘記他們的職責，提供真正惠及社區的照護和資源，確保這些轉變不僅高效，而且公平和充滿同情心。

title.en: CUHK instructor triggers backlash over WeChat attendance registration policy

summary.en: An instructor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) faced criticism for a policy requiring students to use the WeChat app for attendance registration with location services enabled. The instructor later clarified that the arrangement was optional, after the policy was shared online and sparked backlash.
summary.zh: 香港中文大学的一名讲师因要求学生使用微信应用程序进行考勤登记并开启定位服务而受到批评。在相关政策被分享到网上并引发争议后，该讲师澄清该安排是可选的。

body.en: An instructor at Hong Kong’s second-oldest university has faced a backlash over asking students to use mainland Chinese messaging app WeChat to register their attendance and keep its location services enabled, before later saying the arrangement was optional. The policy was revealed after a screenshot of an email from a teaching staff member in the information engineering department at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) was posted to the social media platform Threads on Friday. “Starting...
body.zh: 香港第二古老大学的一名教师因要求学生使用中国大陆的通讯应用程序微信来登记出勤并保持其定位服务启用而遭到强烈反对，后来又表示这种安排是可选的。周五，香港中文大学（中大）信息工程系一名教学人员的一封电子邮件截图被发布到社交媒体平台 Threads 后，该政策被披露。 “开始...

reflection.en: The rapid spread of information online can quickly amplify disagreements. This situation at CUHK shows how a policy, even if later clarified as optional, can cause significant backlash when initially perceived as mandatory and intrusive. It underscores the importance of clear communication and considering how policies will be received, especially when they...
reflection.zh: 网络信息的快速传播会迅速放大分歧。香港中文大学的这一情况表明，一项政策即使后来被澄清为可选，一旦被初次视为强制性且侵入性，也可能引发强烈反对。这突显了清晰沟通以及在政策涉及个人数据和技术时，考虑其接收方式的重要性。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: US lawmakers hold hearing on plight of jailed media tycoon Jimmy Lai, as Hong Kong slams ‘hypocrisy’
title.zh: 美议员就黎智英案举行听证会，香港斥其‘虚伪’

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have condemned US lawmakers for holding a hearing on jailed pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai, accusing them of colluding with "anti-China and destabilising elements" to demand his release. The government stated it "firmly rejected" the Congressional-Executive Commission on China's actions,...
summary.zh: 香港当局谴责美国议员就黎智英案举行听证会，指责他们与“反华和破坏稳定分子”勾结，要求释放他。政府声明“坚决反对”美国政府机构“国会-行政部门中国委员会”的行动，该委员会已提出一项旨在确保黎智英获释的法案。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities have condemned US lawmakers for holding a hearing on jailed pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai and colluding with “anti-China and destabilising elements” to demand his release ahead of a planned summit between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. Jimmy Lai in 2020. Photo: HKFP. The government said in a statement on Thursday that it “firmly rejected” members of the Congressional-Executive Commission on China (CECC), a US government agency that monitors human rights in China. After a hearing with Lai’s son Sebastien on Wednesday, CECC leaders introduced a bill aimed at securing the release of Lai and other “democracy advocates, journalists, former legislators, and civil society leaders” imprisoned in Hong Kong. Claire Lai was also scheduled to testify alongside her brother but pulled out due to a recent cancer diagnosis. “Jimmy Lai was sentenced to an appalling 20-year prison sentence simply for exercising his God-given rights and standing up for the people of Hong Kong,” CECC chair Senator Dan Sullivan said. “He should be released immediately.” Co-chair Representative Chris Smith called Lai’s sentence “unjust, politically motivated [and] an affront to free speech and human dignity.” ‘Nothing to do with freedom of the press’ Lai was sentenced in February to 20 years in jail, following his conviction on foreign collusion and sedition charges under the Beijing-imposed national security law. The 78-year-old was accused of using his newspaper, Apple Daily, to lobby foreign nations to impose sanctions, blockades, or other hostile activities upon China and Hong Kong. He was also accused of inciting hatred against the authorities with op-eds published in the now-shuttered tabloid. “The [Jimmy] Lai Chee-ying case has nothing to do with freedom of the press at all,” the Hong Kong government statement read, adding that “defendants have used journalism as a guise to wantonly create social conflicts, incite social antagonism, incite hatred and glorify violence, bringing harm to our country and Hong Kong.” “These countries and their politicians, including the so-called CECC, display their hypocrisy and double standards by pointing fingers at the HKSAR for our work in safeguarding national security,” it said. Ninety legislators were sworn in for the eighth term of Hong Kong’s Legislative Council on January 1, 2026 as the new term begins on the same day. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a separate statement , Hong Kong’s Legislative Council also condemned what a spokesperson called “maliciously provocative political maneuvering and alarmist talk by some politicians.”...
body.zh: 香港当局谴责美国议员就被监禁的亲民主媒体大亨黎智英举行听证会，并与“反中乱港分子”勾结，要求在中国领导人习近平与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普计划举行峰会之前释放他。黎智英，2020 年。照片：HKFP。美国政府在周四的一份声明中表示，“坚决拒绝”美国国会及行政部门中国委员会（CECC）的成员，该委员会是一个监督中国人权的美国政府机构。周三，在与黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安举行听证会后，CECC领导人提出了一项法案，旨在确保黎智英和其他在香港被监禁的“民主倡导者、记者、前立法会议员和民间社会领袖”获释。克莱尔·赖(Claire Lai)原计划与她的兄弟一起作证，但由于最近诊断出癌症而退出。 CECC 主席、参议员丹·沙利文 (Dan Sullivan) 表示：“黎智英仅仅因为行使了上帝赋予的权利并为香港人民挺身而出，就被判处了令人震惊的 20 年监禁。” “他应该立即被释放。”联合主席众议员克里斯·史密斯 (Chris Smith) 称黎智英的判决“不公正、出于政治动机，是对言论自由和人类尊严的侮辱”。 “与新闻自由无关” 黎智英根据北京实施的国家安全法被判犯有与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪，并于 2 月被判处 20 年监禁。这位78岁的老人被指控利用他的报纸《苹果日报》游说外国对中国和香港实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对活动。他还被指控在现已关闭的小报上发表专栏文章，煽动对当局的仇恨。香港政府声明称：“黎智英案与新闻自由毫无关系。”并补充说，“被告人以新闻为幌子，肆意制造社会矛盾，煽动社会对立，煽动仇恨，美化暴力，给国家和香港带来危害。”报告称，这些国家及其政客，包括所谓的“CECC”，对香港特别行政区维护国家安全的工作指手画脚，暴露了他们的虚伪和双重标准。 2026年1月1日，香港第八届立法会九十名立法会议员宣誓就职，新一届任期同日开始。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港立法会在另一份声明中还谴责了发言人所说的“一些政客恶意挑衅的政治操弄和危言耸听的言论”。

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's strong reaction to a US hearing on Jimmy Lai's imprisonment highlights a clash of governance narratives. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders that their mandate is to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This principle calls for rulers to prioritize the well-being and...
reflection.zh: 香港政府对美国就黎智英案举行的听证会做出强烈反应，凸显了治理叙事的冲突。《耶利米书》22:3 提醒领导者，他们的职责是“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这一原则呼吁统治者优先考虑个人的福祉和权利，特别是那些面临困境的人。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Advocates call for stronger consent laws as Hong Kong to criminalise persistent child sexual abuse and ‘cyberflashing’
title.zh: 倡导者呼吁加强同意法，香港将儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为犯罪

summary.en: A campaign group is pushing the government to limit a defense that allows sexual assault suspects to claim mistaken belief in consent, following authorities' announcement of enhanced protections in upcoming sexual offense reforms. The group, We Are X, welcomes the Security Bureau's move to criminalize persistent child...
summary.zh: 一个倡导团体继续敦促政府限制允许性侵犯嫌疑人声称误认为已获得同意的辩护，此前当局宣布将在即将进行的性犯罪改革中加强保护。该团体名为“我们是X”，欢迎保安局提议将持续的儿童性虐待和发送生殖器图片定为犯罪。

body.en: A campaign group has continued to urge the government to impose limits on a defence allowing a sexual assault suspect to claim they mistakenly believed they had been given consent, after authorities announced stronger protections under upcoming sexual offences reforms. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The group, which calls itself We Are X , after the placeholder name assigned to sexual assault survivors in court, said that it welcomed the Security Bureau’s move to propose the criminalisation of persistent child sexual abuse and sending digital pictures of one’s genitals without consent, known as “cyberflashing.” Hong Kong authorities are seeking to introduce dozens of new offences to Hong Kong’s archaic sex laws, including provisions to protect mentally impaired people, expand the scope of rape, and redefine consent during sexual activity. We Are X’s Friday statement read: “We would like to remind the public that the purpose of creating this offence is to provide children who endure persistent sexual abuse with an avenue to seek legal recourse and receive comprehensive protection.” The campaign group called on the government to make meaningful changes regarding what they called the stringent and unreasonable burden of proof placed on survivors. Loopholes The group had previously expressed concerns that defendants could still be acquitted by arguing that they had an “honest but mistaken belief” that consent was provided. “We are X” and the Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women jointly host a press conference on July 8, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It “remains concerned” that the government has maintained it is up to the courts to decide whether a defendant’s “mistaken belief” is reasonable, the statement said. That approach fails to address situations where a defendant relies on the “mistaken belief” defence even in cases where “vitiating factors” — such as force, fear, unconsciousness, or deception — are involved, the group said. “We earnestly hope the Government will… ensure the law accurately reflects the reality of sexual violence and establishes an objective and effective legal framework for assessing ‘sexual consent’ within the judicial system,” the statement read. The Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women (ACSVAW) had a similar response, saying in a statement that the current approach contains “severe legal loopholes,” adding that defendants have been acquitted after claiming they believed consent was given based on “absurd or unreasonable grounds.” The association said that the defendant must be barred from raising the “mistaken belief” defence if they failed to take steps to ascertain the...
body.zh: 在当局宣布在即将实施的性犯罪改革中提供更强有力的保护后，一个竞选团体继续敦促政府对允许性侵犯嫌疑人声称他们错误地认为自己已获得同意的辩护施加限制。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该组织自称为“We Are X”（以法庭上性侵犯幸存者的占位符名称命名），表示欢迎安全局提议将持续性儿童性虐待和未经同意发送生殖器数码照片（称为“网络闪光”）定为刑事犯罪的举措。香港当局正在寻求在香港陈旧的性法律中引入数十项新的罪行，包括保护精神障碍者、扩大强奸范围以及重新定义性活动期间同意的条款。 We Are X 周五的声明中写道：“我们想提醒公众，设立这一罪行的目的是为遭受持续性虐待的儿童提供寻求法律追索和获得全面保护的途径。”该活动组织呼吁政府对幸存者所面临的严格且不合理的举证责任做出有意义的改变。漏洞该组织此前曾表示担心，如果被告“诚实但错误地相信”已获得同意，仍可能被无罪释放。 “我们是X”与妇女性暴力协会于2026年7月8日联合举办新闻发布会。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。声明称，政府仍然坚持认为应由法院来决定被告的“错误信念”是否合理，这一点“仍然令人担忧”。该组织表示，这种方法无法解决被告依赖“错误信念”辩护的情况，即使涉及“无效因素”（例如武力、恐惧、无意识或欺骗）。声明中写道：“我们热切希望政府……确保法律准确反映性暴力的现实，并在司法系统内建立客观有效的法律框架来评估‘性同意’。”针对妇女的性暴力协会（ACSVAW）也做出了类似的回应，在一份声明中表示，目前的做法存在“严重的法律漏洞”，并补充说，被告在声称他们相信同意是基于“荒谬或不合理的理由”后已被无罪释放。该协会表示，如果被告未能采取措施查明事实，则必须禁止被告提出“错误信念”抗辩。

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong speaks to the deep human need for protection, especially for the most vulnerable. The call for stronger laws against child sexual abuse and 'cyberflashing' echoes the ancient prophetic cry for justice. It reminds us that true safety is built on laws that defend the oppressed and ensure accountability.
reflection.zh: 香港的这则新闻触及了人类对保护的深层需求，尤其是对最弱势群体的保护。呼吁加强反对儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”的法律，呼应了古代先知对公义的呼喊。它提醒我们，真正的安全建立在保护受压迫者和确保问责制的法律之上。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。
