title.en: Time is running out to catch a giant planet's strange orbit
title.zh: 时间所剩无几，快来捕捉巨行星的奇异轨道

summary.en: A team of researchers, including those from the University of Tokyo, has identified a rare type of planet that is unusually hot and eccentric. The planet, TOI-1355 b, orbits its star, TOI-1355, which is much hotter than our sun, in a peculiar and extremely rapid manner, completing a full orbit in approximately two...
summary.zh: 一个由包括东京大学在内的研究人员组成的团队发现了一种罕见的行星，这种行星异常炽热且轨道偏心。这颗行星TOI-1355...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A team of researchers, including those from the University of Tokyo, spotted a rare kind of planet that's unusually hot and eccentric. TOI-1355 b orbits its star, TOI-1355, which is also much hotter than our sun, in a strange way and incredibly quickly, completing an orbit in about two Earth days. The work is published in the journal Publications of the Astronomical Society of Japan .

This unusual orbit could provide a rare opportunity to study this class of planet and how such planets move and evolve. But the planet's evolving orbit means it won't be possible to observe it after about 2033.

Project Researcher Noriharu Watanabe and Professor Norio Narita from the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences at the University of Tokyo and their international team explore exoplanets and are especially interested in those unlike anything we find in our own solar system.

They've recently discovered TOI-1355 b, a so-called hot Jupiter, which, as the name of the class suggests, is a Jupiter-like planet that orbits very close to its host star. In this case, the star is much hotter than our own, at 8,400°C (15,100°F), compared with 5,500°C (9,900°F) at the surface of our sun. TOI-1355 b also orbits in a peculiar elliptical way that has enticed the team.

"Planet surveys around stars as hot as or cooler than the sun are flourishing, and thousands of planets have been discovered around such stars. But planet surveys around hotter stars are still not advanced," said Watanabe. "In this project, we hunted for planets around hot stars to examine the diversity of exoplanets more broadly.

"When we investigated the change in brightness of TOI-1355 from prior data, we found that the secondary eclipse, a phenomenon in which a planet passes behind a star, occurred earlier than the timing assumed for a circular orbit. This was unusual for hot Jupiters around hot stars, and this is why we began to research this planet in detail."

NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) space telescope recently found periodic dimming of the star TOI-1355, and Narita's team determined this was due to a planetary transit. They measured the planetary mass and orbital eccentricity — the degree of deviation from a circular orbit — from changes in stellar and planetary brightness observed by TESS.

The discovery of a hot Jupiter with a highly eccentric orbit is important because it supports a theory that hot Jupiters around hot stars can have dramatic histories involving dynamic migration, perhaps due to planets interacting through gravity and altering each other's orbits. This kind of interaction is...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 包括东京大学在内的一组研究人员发现了一种罕见的行星，它异常炎热且古怪。 TOI-1355 b 绕其恒星 TOI-1355 运行，该恒星也比太阳热得多，以一种奇怪的方式和令人难以置信的速度，在大约两个地球日内完成绕行一周。该成果发表在《日本天文学会刊物》杂志上。 这种不寻常的轨道可以为研究此类行星以及此类行星如何移动和演化提供难得的机会。但这颗行星不断变化的轨道意味着大约 2033 年之后将无法对其进行观测。 东京大学艺术与科学研究生院的项目研究员 Noriharu Watanabe 和 Norio Narita 教授及其国际团队探索系外行星，并对那些与我们在太阳系中发现的任何行星都不同的行星特别感兴趣。 他们最近发现了 TOI-1355 b，一颗所谓的热木星，顾名思义，它是一颗类木星行星，其轨道非常靠近其主恒星。在这种情况下，这颗恒星比我们的恒星要热得多，达到 8,400°C (15,100°F)，而太阳表面的温度为 5,500°C (9,900°F)。 TOI-1355 b 也以一种特殊的椭圆形轨道运行，这吸引了团队。 “围绕与太阳一样热或比太阳冷的恒星的行星调查正在蓬勃发展，并且在这些恒星周围发现了数千颗行星。但围绕较热恒星的行星调查仍然没有进展，”渡边说。 “在这个项目中，我们寻找炽热恒星周围的行星，以更广泛地研究系外行星的多样性。 “当我们根据之前的数据调查 TOI-1355 的亮度变化时，我们发现二次食（行星经过恒星后面的现象）发生的时间早于圆形轨道假设的时间。这对于热恒星周围的热木星来说是不寻常的，这就是我们开始详细研究这颗行星的原因。” 美国宇航局的凌日系外行星勘测卫星 (TESS) 太空望远镜最近发现 TOI-1355 恒星周期性变暗，成田的团队确定这是由于行星凌日造成的。他们根据 TESS 观测到的恒星和行星亮度的变化，测量了行星质量和轨道偏心率（偏离圆形轨道的程度）。 发现具有高度偏心轨道的热木星非常重要，因为它支持了一种理论，即热恒星周围的热木星可能具有涉及动态迁移的戏剧性历史，这可能是由于行星通过重力相互作用并改变彼此的轨道所致。这种互动是...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the intricate dance of celestial bodies, like the rapidly orbiting TOI-1355 b, inspire awe. The heavens themselves bear witness to a grand design, a testament to the Creator's power and artistry. As we study these distant worlds, we are reminded of the profound mystery and beauty that surrounds us, a silent declaration of...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚和天体的精密运行，如同TOI-1355 b的快速绕转，激发着我们的敬畏之心。诸天本身就是宏伟设计的见证，是造物主大能与艺术的明证。当我们研究这些遥远的星球时，我们被提醒，周围环绕着深刻的奥秘和美丽，这是雅伟荣耀的无声宣告。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Black moms and pregnant women forced out of their homes in metro Detroit face health and safety threats
title.zh: 底特律都会区黑人母亲和孕妇面临健康与安全威胁，她们的家园被强制迁离

summary.en: Black mothers and pregnant women in metro Detroit are facing significant health and safety risks as they are being forced out of their homes, often without proper legal process, leading to severe consequences.
summary.zh: 底特律都会区的一些黑人母亲和孕妇在被迫离开家园时，面临着严峻的健康和安全风险，她们往往在未经过正当法律程序的情况下被驱离，导致了严重的后果。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The state of Michigan says "yes," but the reality is often very different, and the consequences are severe. In Michigan, landlords need a court order to evict a tenant.

The formal eviction process includes several steps and concludes only when a judge signs an order saying a tenant has to move.

A landlord who wants to remove a tenant must work through the court system. This is true even if the tenant fails to pay rent, plays music too loud—or even if the landlord wants to do renovations. If a landlord chooses not to renew a lease at the end of its term, a 30-day notice to the tenant is required.

Landlords are not legally allowed to retaliate against tenants who request repairs by not renewing their leases.

Detroit had 20,370 eviction cases filed in 2025. But my research shows that official counts underestimate the real number of evictions in metro Detroit by half because many landlords ignore the law and skip the formal court process.

I am a tenured social epidemiology professor, native and resident Detroiter, and leader of the first and most comprehensive research study on court-ordered and illegal evictions among Black women in the U.S.

My study includes numbers and stories from nearly 1,500 Black women ages 18–46 from metro Detroit, including nearly 800 women who experienced a court-ordered or illegal eviction in their lifetimes. Black women and children are the groups most affected by evictions because of the intersection between structural racism and sexism.

I lead the SECURE Study in partnership with a community advisory board of Black women who are local, national and international leaders in fields such as human rights and social justice, advocacy, education, health care and journalism. Some have been evicted themselves.

In our most recent study, my research team and I used participant stories to show, for the first time, how illegal evictions can undermine the reproductive justice rights of Black women . Reproductive justice is focused on a set of interconnected human rights. It includes the rights to bodily autonomy, to choose whether to have children and to raise children in safe and sustainable communities.

Our research found that an illegal eviction caused more than 1 in 3 pregnant or postpartum participants to have nowhere to live.

We also learned renters' protections are strongest for those with a formal lease agreement. Twenty-six percent of women who were pregnant or postpartum when they were illegally evicted lacked a lease, and 21% of all interview participants who were illegally evicted had a month-to-month tenancy.

Discover the latest in...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 密歇根州说“是”，但现实往往大不相同，而且后果很严重。在密歇根州，房东需要法院命令才能驱逐房客。 正式的驱逐程序包括几个步骤，只有在法官签署命令称租户必须搬走时才结束。 想要驱逐租客的房东必须通过法院系统。即使房客不付房租、音乐音量太大，或者即使房东想要装修，情况也是如此。如果房东选择在租期结束时不再续租，则需要提前 30 天通知租户。 法律不允许房东通过不续租的方式对要求维修的租户进行报复。 2025 年，底特律共收到 20,370 起驱逐案件。但我的研究表明，官方统计数字低估了底特律都会区实际驱逐数量的一半，因为许多房东无视法律并跳过正式的法庭程序。 我是一位终身社会流行病学教授，土生土长的底特律人，也是第一个也是最全面的关于美国黑人妇女法院下令驱逐和非法驱逐的研究的领导者。 我的研究包括底特律都会区近 1,500 名 18 至 46 岁的黑人女性的数据和故事，其中包括近 800 名一生中经历过法院命令或非法驱逐的女性。由于结构性种族主义和性别歧视的交叉，黑人妇女和儿童是受驱逐影响最严重的群体。 我与黑人妇女社区咨询委员会合作领导了“安全研究”，这些黑人妇女是人权和社会正义、宣传、教育、医疗保健和新闻等领域的地方、国家和国际领导者。有些人自己也被驱逐了。 在我们最近的研究中，我和我的研究团队利用参与者的故事首次展示了非法驱逐如何损害黑人妇女的生殖正义权利。生殖正义关注的是一系列相互关联的人权。它包括身体自主权、选择是否生育孩子的权利以及在安全和可持续社区中抚养孩子的权利。 我们的研究发现，非法驱逐导致超过三分之一的怀孕或产后参与者无处可住。 我们还了解到，对于那些拥有正式租赁协议的租户来说，他们的保护最为有力。被非法驱逐的怀孕或产后妇女中，有 26% 没有租约，而在所有被非法驱逐的受访者中，有 21% 的人有按月租约。 发现最新的...

reflection.en: The news from metro Detroit paints a stark picture of injustice, where vulnerable populations like Black mothers and pregnant women are displaced from their homes, facing dire health and safety threats. This situation cries out for the justice and mercy that Micah the prophet proclaimed, reminding us that true righteousness is found in acting justly, loving...
reflection.zh: 底特律都会区的这则新闻描绘了一幅严峻的不公画面，黑人母亲和孕妇等弱势群体被迫离开家园，面临着严峻的健康与安全威胁。这种情况令人呼唤先知弥迦所宣告的公义与怜悯，提醒我们真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

He plans to discuss solutions to the 'arrow of time' problem in his upcoming lectures. The article mentions Bryan Johnson's attempt to inject plasma from his son for anti-aging purposes, which he...

The ancient wisdom of Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a fixed point in human life, a truth...
reflection.zh: 一些最富有的人对永生的不懈追求，凸显了人类面对有限存在的深刻挣扎。然而，正如物理学家吉姆·阿尔-哈利利所言，这种追求可能分散了我们对生命终将逝去的根本现实的注意力。希伯来书9:27中的古老智慧提醒我们，死亡是人类生命中一个确定的节点，这一事实可以让我们珍惜当下拥有的时光。

title.en: 'Lost' medieval castle found hiding inside university building in Dublin
title.zh: 都柏林一处大学建筑内发现“失落”的中世纪城堡

summary.en: Substantial remains of the Norman castle of Roebuck, an important medieval fortress, have been discovered within University College Dublin's Roebuck Castle building. Professor Tadhg O'Keeffe identified surviving medieval walls and features, revealing the castle's presence hidden in plain sight.
summary.zh: 都柏林一处“失落”的诺曼城堡——鲁克堡（Roebuck Castle）——的遗迹，被发现在其现代建筑——都柏林大学学院（University College Dublin）的鲁克堡建筑内。Tadhg O'Keeffe教授识别出了城堡现存的中世纪墙体和其他特征，揭示了这座重要的中世纪堡垒就隐藏在人们眼前。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

One of Dublin's "lost" medieval castles has been found hiding in plain sight inside University College Dublin's Roebuck Castle. New research reveals that substantial remains of the Norman castle of Roebuck, an important fortress on one of the approach roads into the medieval city of Dublin, are preserved within the modern-day building.

Professor Tadhg O'Keeffe, a specialist in medieval architectural history at UCD School of Archaeology, identified the surviving walls and other medieval features of the castle, long believed to have been demolished, beneath the plaster of the present building.

Published in Archaeology Ireland magazine, the research indicates that the oldest parts of the castle date to the early 13th century—this would likely make Roebuck Castle the oldest standing building on an Irish university campus.

"From the outside, the present building looks to be entirely Victorian. Inside, though, the walls of the old castle are preserved," O'Keeffe said. "The medieval features are still there. They're hidden under plaster but they can be made out.

"We are incredibly lucky that the Georgian and Victorian modernizers of the property simply built around the medieval castle rather than demolish it. And we are also lucky that they built very little else on the site. The courtyard at the back of the house today is actually the medieval castle courtyard!"

He added, "UCD can now claim to have the oldest standing building on any university campus in Ireland."

Historical sources suggest the old castle was built within living memory of the Norman invasion of Ireland in 1169 and was altered several times during the Middle Ages.

Its occupants included a medieval Lord High Chancellor of Ireland and, according to tradition, James II, the then-deposed king of England and Ireland (and Scotland as James VII), who is reputed to have stayed there in 1689 after he lost his throne.

By the 18th century, the castle had fallen into ruin and was believed to have been cleared away during subsequent redevelopment of the site. However, clues to its survival were captured by artist Gabriel Beranger, who visited the ruins around 1765 and recorded them in a series of watercolors.

"Beranger's depictions of the ruined castle are really fascinating," O'Keeffe said. "He captured the basic form of the building, as you would expect, but thankfully he also captured some of those small details, which are the clues needed to work out the building's structural history."

The discovery is significant because few medieval castles have survived in south Dublin, as many were demolished in the 17th...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 都柏林“失落”的中世纪城堡之一被发现隐藏在都柏林大学学院的罗巴克城堡内。新的研究表明，诺曼罗巴克城堡的大量遗迹被保留在现代建筑内，罗巴克城堡是通往中世纪城市都柏林的一条道路上的重要堡垒。 都柏林大学考古学院中世纪建筑史专家塔赫·奥基夫（Tadhg O'Keeffe）教授在目前建筑的灰泥下发现了城堡幸存的墙壁和其他中世纪特征，长期以来人们认为这些特征已被拆除。 发表在《爱尔兰考古学》杂志上的研究表明，城堡最古老的部分可以追溯到 13 世纪初，这可能使罗巴克城堡成为爱尔兰大学校园中最古老的直立建筑。 “从外面看，现在的建筑看起来完全是维多利亚时代的。但在里面，老城堡的城墙却被保留了下来，”奥基夫说。 “中世纪的特征仍然存在。它们隐藏在石膏下面，但可以辨认出来。 “我们非常幸运，乔治亚和维多利亚时期的现代化改造者只是围绕中世纪城堡建造而不是拆除它。我们也很幸运，他们在该网站上几乎没有建造任何其他东西。今天房子后面的庭院实际上是中世纪城堡的庭院！” 他补充说，“都柏林大学现在可以声称拥有爱尔兰所有大学校园中最古老的站立建筑。” 历史资料表明，这座古老的城堡是在人们对 1169 年诺曼人入侵爱尔兰的记忆中建造的，并在中世纪期间经过了多次改建。 它的居住者包括一位中世纪的爱尔兰大法官，以及根据传统，当时被废黜的英格兰和爱尔兰国王詹姆斯二世（苏格兰称为詹姆斯七世），据说他在 1689 年失去王位后曾住在那里。 到了 18 世纪，这座城堡已成为废墟，据信在随后的重建过程中已被清除。然而，艺术家加布里埃尔·贝朗格 (Gabriel Beranger) 在 1765 年左右参观了这座废墟，并用一系列水彩画记录了其幸存的线索。 “贝朗格对这座被毁的城堡的描绘确实令人着迷，”奥基夫说。 “正如你所期望的那样，他捕捉到了建筑物的基本形式，但值得庆幸的是，他还捕捉到了一些小细节，这些细节是了解建筑物结构历史所需的线索。” 这一发现意义重大，因为都柏林南部几乎没有中世纪城堡幸存下来，许多城堡在 17 世纪被拆除......

reflection.en: Sometimes, the most significant discoveries are found not in remote wildernesses, but in familiar places, hidden in plain sight. This finding reminds us that careful study and observation can uncover layers of history and meaning that we might otherwise overlook. Just as the ancient castle was revealed through dedicated research, the natural world around us...
reflection.zh: 有时，最重大的发现并非来自偏远荒野，而是隐藏在熟悉的地方，就在我们眼前。这一发现提醒我们，细致的研究和观察可以揭示我们可能忽略的历史和意义的层层叠叠。 正如古代城堡通过不懈的研究得以显现一样，我们周围的自然世界也蕴含着丰富的启示。圣经鼓励我们从创造中寻求智慧，认识到雅伟已将其精妙的设计和深刻的真理蕴藏其中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists discover cells that cheat death and rebuild damaged tissue
title.zh: 科学家发现能“欺骗”死亡并重建受损组织的细胞

summary.en: Scientists have identified a type of cell that can initiate programmed cell death, survive it, and then facilitate rapid rebuilding of damaged tissue. These cells become more resistant to future damage, offering potential improvements for healing but also raising concerns about cancer recurrence.
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一类细胞，它们能够启动程序性细胞死亡，并在存活后迅速重建受损组织。这些细胞对未来损伤的抵抗力会增强，这可能有助于改善愈合过程，但也可能引发癌症复发的担忧。

body.en:
Scientists uncover a cellular survival mechanism that helps severely damaged tissue regenerate and may also reveal why some cancers return after treatment.

Tissues such as skin, along with the epithelial layers that cover and line many organs, have a remarkable ability to rebuild themselves after extensive damage. Scientists have known about this response, called compensatory proliferation, for roughly half a century. Yet exactly how cells manage to trigger such dramatic regrowth has remained a mystery.

The phenomenon was first documented in the 1970s, when researchers exposed fly larvae to high doses of radiation. Despite major damage to epithelial tissue, the larvae were able to regenerate fully functional wings. Similar regenerative responses have since been observed across many species, including humans.

Now, researchers at the Weizmann Institute of Science say they have identified a molecular mechanism that helps explain how this process works. Their study, published in Nature Communications , points to a surprising role for caspases, enzymes best known for helping destroy cells.

Instead of simply promoting cell death, caspases can apparently help certain cells become resistant to death. Those survivors can then participate in rebuilding damaged tissue and may even become better equipped to withstand future injury. The same ability, however, could have a dangerous downside. Cancer cells may exploit this survival mechanism, potentially contributing to tumors that return in a more aggressive and treatment-resistant form.

The discovery could eventually help researchers develop approaches that encourage healthy tissue repair while also reducing the risk of cancer recurrence.

One of the main ways the body eliminates unwanted cells is through apoptosis, a carefully controlled form of cellular "suicide." Cells can enter apoptosis when they become old, damaged, or receive molecular signals telling them that their time is up.

The process involves several caspase enzymes. An initiator caspase first activates the pathway, followed by effector caspases that break apart proteins inside the doomed cell.

During the past two decades, however, researchers have discovered that apoptotic caspases are not limited to killing cells. Work by scientists around the world, including the laboratory of Prof. Eli Arama in Weizmann's Molecular Genetics Department, has shown that these enzymes can also participate in biological processes that are essential for life.

Arama, an early researcher of these nonlethal caspase functions, suspected that they might also help drive compensatory proliferation.

To investigate, a team led by Dr. Tslil Braun from Arama's lab recreated the classic experiment that originally revealed compensatory proliferation. The researchers...
body.zh: 科学家发现了一种细胞生存机制，可以帮助严重受损的组织再生，也可能揭示为什么某些癌症在治疗后会复发。 皮肤等组织以及覆盖和排列许多器官的上皮层在严重损伤后具有非凡的自我重建能力。大约半个世纪以来，科学家们就知道这种称为补偿性增殖的反应。然而，细胞究竟是如何引发如此戏剧性的再生仍然是一个谜。 这种现象首次被记录在 20 世纪 70 年代，当时研究人员将苍蝇幼虫暴露在高剂量的辐射下。尽管上皮组织受到严重损害，幼虫仍能够再生出功能齐全的翅膀。此后，在包括人类在内的许多物种中都观察到了类似的再生反应。 现在，魏茨曼科学研究所的研究人员表示，他们已经确定了一种分子机制，有助于解释这一过程是如何运作的。他们的研究发表在《自然通讯》上，指出了半胱天冬酶的惊人作用，半胱天冬酶是一种以帮助破坏细胞而闻名的酶。 半胱天冬酶显然可以帮助某些细胞抵抗死亡，而不是简单地促进细胞死亡。然后，这些幸存者可以参与重建受损组织，甚至可能变得更好，以承受未来的伤害。然而，同样的能力可能有一个危险的缺点。癌细胞可能会利用这种生存机制，从而可能导致肿瘤以更具侵袭性和耐药性的形式复发。 这一发现最终可以帮助研究人员开发出鼓励健康组织修复同时降低癌症复发风险的方法。 身体消除不需要的细胞的主要方式之一是通过细胞凋亡，这是一种精心控制的细胞“自杀”形式。当细胞变老、受损或收到分子信号告诉它们生命已到时，它们就会进入凋亡状态。 该过程涉及几种半胱天冬酶。起始半胱天冬酶首先激活该通路，随后是效应半胱天冬酶，其分解注定细胞内的蛋白质。 然而，在过去的二十年中，研究人员发现凋亡半胱天冬酶不仅限于杀死细胞。包括魏茨曼分子遗传学系 Eli Arama 教授实验室在内的世界各地科学家的工作表明，这些酶还可以参与生命所必需的生物过程。 Arama 是这些非致命性半胱天冬酶功能的早期研究者，他怀疑它们也可能有助于驱动代偿性增殖。 为了进行调查，Arama 实验室的 Tslil Braun 博士领导的团队重新创建了最初揭示代偿性增殖的经典实验。研究人员...

reflection.en: The discovery of cells that can seemingly cheat death to rebuild damaged tissue is a testament to the intricate wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. It reminds us that even in biological processes that appear to involve 'death,' there is a profound capacity for renewal and resilience, reflecting a deeper order we are still uncovering.
reflection.zh: 发现能够“欺骗”死亡并重建受损组织的细胞，是造物主雅伟所创造的精妙智慧的明证。它提醒我们，即使在看似涉及“死亡”的生物过程中，也蕴含着深刻的更新和韧性，这反映了我们仍在探索的更深层秩序。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists just named a new snake after Guns N’ Roses legend Slash
title.zh: 科学家以枪炮与玫瑰传奇人物斯莱什的名字命名了一种新蛇

summary.en: A new snake species discovered in New Guinea has been named Lielaphis slashi, or Slash's groundsnake, after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash, who has a lifelong fascination with reptiles and has supported natural history institutions. Genetic testing and physical differences confirmed it as a previously unknown species.
summary.zh: 一种在新几内亚发现的新蛇被命名为Lielaphis slashi，或称斯莱什地蛇，以致敬枪炮与玫瑰乐队吉他手斯莱什，他对爬行动物有着毕生的兴趣，并一直支持自然历史机构。基因检测和物理差异证实了它是一个此前未知的物种。

body.en:
Slash, also known as Saul Hudson, is famous worldwide as the guitarist for Guns N' Roses. But music is only part of his story. He has also been fascinated by reptiles for most of his life and has long supported zoos, museums, and natural history.

Now that passion has earned him an unusual scientific honor. Researchers have named a newly identified snake species from New Guinea Lielaphis slashi , or Slash's groundsnake.

"As a long time herpephile, I am extremely honored and humbled to have Lielaphis slashi from New Guinea named after me. It is really exciting, I never would have imagined this moment would arrive," says Slash.

For Sara Ruane, the Field Museum's Associate Curator of Herpetology and senior author of a paper in Zootaxa describing the species, the name also has a personal connection.

"Guns N' Roses has been one of my favorite bands since I was in first grade, and by fifth grade, I had already told my teacher that I wanted to be a herpetologist -- a scientist who studies reptiles -- when I grew up," says Sara Ruane, the Field Museum's Associate Curator of Herpetology and senior author of a paper in Zootaxa describing the new species. "So when I was twelve years old and got my copy of Reptiles Magazine in the mail and it had a picture of Slash holding his pet reticulated python on the cover, I thought, 'This guy is so cool.'"

Years later, after Ruane became a scientist who sometimes has the opportunity to assign official names to newly recognized reptile species, she returned to that old magazine interview.

"I reread his interview, and he talked about how much he loves museums and zoos and natural history, and about how when he was a kid, he'd go outside and look for snakes -- it was all stuff that I really related to, and it made me think that he'd be a great person to name a new species after," says Ruane.

Her opportunity eventually came in the form of a reddish-brown snake measuring 28 inches long that had been collected in the forests of New Guinea.

New Guinea is the world's second-largest island, behind Greenland. Located just north of Australia, the island is divided between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea. Its tropical forests support enormous biological diversity, much of which remains poorly documented by scientists.

During fieldwork one night in 2006, Chris Austin, a professor and curator of herpetology at the Louisiana State University Museum of Natural Science, encountered a snake in New Guinea that he did not recognize.

"These New Guinea groundsnakes are nocturnal, so the best way to find them is at night. They are typically found just after sunset at the base of large trees where they are looking for something to eat," says Austin, a co-author of the paper describing the new species. "When working at night in New...
body.zh: Slash，又名 Saul Hudson，作为 Guns N' Roses 乐队的吉他手而闻名于世。但音乐只是他故事的一部分。他一生的大部分时间都对爬行动物着迷，并长期支持动物园、博物馆和自然历史。 现在，这种热情为他赢得了不同寻常的科学荣誉。研究人员将一种新发现的来自新几内亚的蛇种命名为 Lielaphislashi 或 Slash 地蛇。 “作为一名长期的疱疹病毒感染者，我感到非常荣幸和谦卑，来自新几内亚的 Lielaphislashi 以我的名字命名。这真的很令人兴奋，我从来没有想到这一刻会到来，”Slash 说。 对于菲尔德博物馆爬行动物学副馆长、Zootaxa 上描述该物种的论文的资深作者萨拉·鲁恩 (Sara Ruane) 来说，这个名字也有着个人联系。 “从我一年级起，枪与玫瑰乐队就一直是我最喜欢的乐队之一，到五年级时，我已经告诉老师，我长大后想成为一名爬行动物学家——一名研究爬行动物的科学家，”菲尔德博物馆爬行动物学副馆长、《Zootaxa》上一篇描述新物种的论文的资深作者萨拉·鲁恩 (Sara Ruane) 说道。 “所以当我十二岁的时候，我收到了一份《爬行动物杂志》，封面上有一张斯莱什抱着他的宠物网纹蟒的照片，我想，‘这家伙太酷了。’” 多年后，当鲁安成为一名科学家，有时有机会为新认识的爬行动物物种指定正式名称后，她又回到了旧杂志的采访中。 “我重读了他的采访，他谈到了他多么喜欢博物馆、动物园和自然历史，以及他小时候如何出去寻找蛇——这些都是我真正感兴趣的东西，这让我觉得他会是一个伟大的人，可以用他的名字来命名一个新物种，”鲁恩说。 她的机会最终出现在一条 28 英寸长的红棕色蛇身上，这条蛇是在新几内亚的森林里采集到的。 新几内亚是世界第二大岛屿，仅次于格陵兰岛。该岛位于澳大利亚北部，分为印度尼西亚和巴布亚新几内亚。它的热带森林孕育着巨大的生物多样性，但科学家对其中大部分的记录仍然很少。 2006 年的一个晚上，路易斯安那州立大学自然科学博物馆爬行动物学教授兼馆长克里斯·奥斯汀 (Chris Austin) 在进行实地考察时，在新几内亚遇到了一条他不认识的蛇。 “这些新几内亚地蛇是夜间活动的，所以找到它们的最好方法是在晚上。它们通常在日落后被发现在大树下寻找食物，”描述该新物种的论文的合著者奥斯汀说。 “晚上在新城工作时...

reflection.en: The discovery of Lielaphis slashi, a new groundsnake species named after guitarist Slash, reminds us of the incredible diversity Yahweh has woven into the fabric of creation. Even in remote New Guinea, new wonders await discovery, reflecting the boundless creativity and intricate design of the Creator. This naming honors a passion for the natural world, a...
reflection.zh: 新发现的斯莱什地蛇Lielaphis slashi，以吉他手斯莱什的名字命名，提醒我们雅伟已将令人难以置信的多样性编织进创造的肌理中。即使在新几内亚的偏远地区，新的奇迹也在等待被发现，这反映了创造者无限的创造力和精妙的设计。...

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Michael Sheen's 'constructive' meeting with first minister over toxic dumping claims
title.zh: 迈克尔·辛的“建设性”会议，涉及有毒倾倒指控

summary.en: Hollywood actor Michael Sheen stated that his meeting with the First Minister was "early days but that's really encouraging" regarding toxic dumping claims featured in his BBC documentary. The documentary, "Buried with Michael Sheen," investigates 14 sites in Wales and England suspected of toxic chemical dumping....
summary.zh: 好莱坞演员迈克尔·辛表示，他与第一部长就其BBC纪录片中提出的有毒倾倒指控进行的会议“尚处早期，但这确实令人鼓舞”。纪录片《迈克尔·辛的埋藏》调查了威尔士和英格兰的14个疑似有毒化学品倾倒地点。辛此前曾指出，在纪录片播出前，第一部长的办公室最初并未作出回应，但在他们最近就如何推进问题进行讨论后，他表示乐观。

body.en:
Hollywood actor Michael Sheen said he had a "constructive" meeting with First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth over toxic dumping claims raised in his BBC documentary.

Buried with Michael Sheen explores toxic chemical dumping in 14 sites in Wales and England.

Sheen initially said an offer to meet the first minister "was not taken up" before the documentary was broadcast in August.

On Thursday, the Welsh actor said he met the first minister, speaking about how they could move forward adding it was "early days but that's really encouraging".

Speaking on Instagram , external , he said "I've just come from a meeting with the first minister.

"Talking about how we can move forward and address all the issues that Buried [the documentary] raised around the toxic dumping, and that was really constructive.

In the UK Parliament last week, Sheen urged MPs to back a national testing programme for historic toxic dumps to make sure sites were safe, after high levels of cancer-causing chemicals - known as PCBs - were found in soil samples and in the blood of people living near sites linked to chemical giant Monsanto.

Sheen interviewed farming consultant turned campaigner Douglas Gowan shortly before his death, who had spent decades warning that communities were at risk of toxic chemicals.

The actor later teamed up with investigative journalists Lucy Taylor and Dan Ashby who had inherited all of the campaigner's documents and research.

They set about testing 14 sites in Wales and north west England where it was thought Monsanto had been dumping PCBs, and found elevated levels at all but one.

Susan Smith, who worked at Monsanto in Wrexham, said her happy memories of working there have been replaced with fears following the documentary.

Susan and her husband Geraint's home, which they have lived in for 53 years, is separated from the decommissioned Ruabon chemical works by a thin tree line.

Geraint was diagnosed with prostate cancer 13 years ago before more recently developing skin cancer, while Susan developed breast cancer when she was 38.

While they admit they are not certain that Monsanto was responsible, the documentary has made them question the possible impact of the factory on their family's health.

Susan worked as a secretary for four years when she was 19, then returned once for temporary cover and another time to overhaul a failing system.

"Most of my time was spent in the telex office next to the warehouse. We used to send delivery notes, instructions, requests on little pieces of ticker tape through a machine to other Monsanto offices," she said.

"We had a small glass hatch that the instructions would be passed through and it was never closed because people were passing things through so often. As a result dust and powders and all sorts would...
body.zh: 好莱坞演员迈克尔·辛 (Michael Sheen) 表示，他与首席部长 Rhun ap Iorwerth 就 BBC 纪录片中提出的有毒倾倒指控进行了“建设性”会面。 迈克尔·辛 (Michael Sheen) 与埋葬者一起探索威尔士和英格兰 14 个地点的有毒化学品倾倒情况。 辛最初表示，在这部纪录片于八月播出之前，与首席部长会面的提议“没有被接受”。 周四，这位威尔士演员表示，他会见了首席部长，谈到了他们如何向前迈进，并补充说“现在还为时过早，但这确实令人鼓舞”。 他在 Instagram 上对外表示：“我刚刚与首席部长开完会。 “谈论我们如何前进并解决埋藏[纪录片]围绕有毒倾倒问题提出的所有问题，这确实具有建设性。 上周在英国议会，在化学巨头孟山都公司相关地点附近的土壤样本和人们的血液中发现了高含量的致癌化学物质（称为多氯联苯）后，希恩敦促国会议员支持一项针对历史性有毒物质倾倒场的国家测试计划，以确保场地安全。 辛在去世前不久采访了农业顾问、后来成为活动家的道格拉斯·高恩(Douglas Gowan)，他几十年来一直警告社区面临有毒化学品的风险。 这位演员后来与调查记者露西·泰勒和丹·阿什比合作，他们继承了这位活动家的所有文件和研究。 他们开始对威尔士和英格兰西北部的 14 个地点进行测试，据信孟山都曾在这些地点倾倒多氯联苯，结果发现，除了一处之外，其他地点的含量均有所升高。 在雷克瑟姆的孟山都公司工作的苏珊·史密斯表示，这部纪录片之后，她在那里工作的快乐记忆已经被恐惧所取代。 苏珊和她丈夫杰兰特的家已经居住了 53 年，与已退役的鲁邦化工厂仅隔着一条细细的树线。 Geraint 13 年前被诊断出患有前列腺癌，最近又患上了皮肤癌，而 Susan 在 38 岁时患上了乳腺癌。 虽然他们承认不确定孟山都是否对此负责，但这部纪录片让他们质疑该工厂对他们家人的健康可能产生的影响。 苏珊 19 岁时担任了四年的秘书，然后回来一次是为了临时工作，另一次是为了彻底改革一个失败的系统。 “我的大部分时间都花在仓库旁边的电报办公室里。我们过去常常通过机器向孟山都的其他办事处发送送货单、指示和小纸条上的请求，”她说。 “我们有一个小玻璃舱口，指令可以通过它，但它永远不会关闭，因为人们经常传递东西。因此，灰尘和粉末以及各种各样的东西会......

reflection.en: The pursuit of truth and justice often requires persistent advocacy. Michael Sheen's documentary brought attention to toxic dumping sites, and his subsequent engagement with the First Minister demonstrates a commitment to speaking for those who may be harmed and for the environment itself. This echoes the call to 'open your mouth for the speechless, in the...
reflection.zh: 追求真理和正义往往需要不懈的倡导。迈克尔·辛的纪录片揭露了有毒倾倒地点，随后他与第一部长的接触，展现了他为可能受害者和环境发声的决心。这呼应了‘你要开口为贫寒的、为一切将亡的人辩屈’的教导，敦促我们为弱势群体发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Move faster to solve climate challenges, Prince William says
title.zh: 威廉王子呼吁加快应对气候挑战

summary.en: The Prince of Wales has urged for a faster pace in developing solutions to pressing climate issues, emphasizing the need for increased business and investor involvement to scale up effective strategies. This call comes as the nominees for the Earthshot Prize, an initiative he founded, are announced.
summary.zh: 威尔士亲王敦促加快制定应对紧迫气候问题的解决方案，并强调需要增加企业和投资者的参与，以扩大有效策略的规模。此番呼吁是在他创立的地球创想奖（Earthshot Prize）公布本年度提名者之际发出的。

body.en:
The Prince of Wales has warned that the world needs to move faster to solve the biggest climate challenges.

Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Prince William called for a greater sense of urgency around ways to repair the planet.

"We're not moving fast enough," William said. "We need more businesses, investors and leaders to step up, back what works and help bring these solutions to scale."

His warning came as this year's nominees for the Earthshot Prize , the global environmental award he launched six years ago, were unveiled.

"Around the world, people are proving every day that we can restore nature and tackle climate challenges. Our 2026 finalists are an incredible example of that."

Among the 15 finalists is the entire city of Barcelona, recognised for its efforts to safeguard its Mediterranean coastline.

The city's architects were praised for "turning one of Europe's most intensively used urban coastlines into a global blueprint for climate adaptation".

The Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan was also selected, with the prize recognising how the country has embedded environmental protection into its national identity and constitution. The prize said that Bhutan had demonstrated "how a small nation's forests can safeguard water security across an entire region".

The finalists also include a range of community-led initiatives tackling environmental challenges such as waste reduction, nature restoration, and clean energy.

They include Indigenous ranger teams in Australia and an Argentinian artificial intelligence-powered wildfire detection and alert platform.

Two finalists are from India, which will host this year's Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai.

They are Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, a leading manufacturer of electric three-wheelers, and the Mahila Housing Trust, a grassroots organisation pioneering climate resilience initiatives for low-income women.

The finalists were selected from nearly 7,000 nominations submitted across 169 countries.

Five winners, one from each of the five Earthshot categories - protect and restore nature, revive our oceans, clean our air, build a waste-free world and fix our climate - will be announced at the ceremony in November.

The Earthshot Prize Council, which selects the winners, includes Prince William, alongside Queen Rania al-Abdullah of Jordan, actress Cate Blanchett, and chef José Andrés.

"The solutions are here. The challenge now is scale," Prince William told the BBC.

"The progress is real. Now we need to accelerate it. That's exactly why The Earthshot Prize exists."

It has been a torrid week for the royals with allegations from Prince William's uncle, Earl Spencer about his parents.

Neither Prince William nor his brother, the Duke of Sussex, have made any public comment on the book nor the...
body.zh: 威尔士亲王警告说，世界需要更快地采取行动来解决最大的气候挑战。 威廉王子在接受英国广播公司独家采访时呼吁，对于修复地球的方法要有更大的紧迫感。 “我们进展不够快，”威廉说。 “我们需要更多的企业、投资者和领导者挺身而出，支持行之有效的做法，并帮助扩大这些解决方案的规模。” 他发出这一警告之际，正值今年“地球挑战奖”的提名者揭晓之际，该奖项是他六年前发起的全球环境奖。 “世界各地的人们每天都在证明我们可以恢复自然并应对气候挑战。我们的 2026 年决赛入围者就是一个令人难以置信的例子。” 15 个决赛入围者包括整个巴塞罗那市，该市因其保护地中海海岸线的努力而受到认可。 该市的建筑师因“将欧洲使用最频繁的城市海岸线之一转变为全球气候适应蓝图”而受到赞扬。 喜马拉雅山王国不丹也入选，该奖项表彰了该国如何将环境保护纳入其国家认同和宪法。该奖项称，不丹展示了“一个小国的森林如何能够保障整个地区的水安全”。 决赛入围者还包括一系列社区主导的应对环境挑战的举措，例如减少废物、自然恢复和清洁能源。 其中包括澳大利亚的土著护林员团队和阿根廷人工智能驱动的野火检测和警报平台。 两名决赛入围者来自印度，今年的 Earthshot 奖颁奖典礼将在印度孟买举行。 它们是领先的电动三轮车制造商 Mahindra Last Mile Mobility 和为低收入女性倡导气候适应计划的草根组织 Mahila Housing Trust。 决赛入围者是从 169 个国家/地区提交的近 7,000 份提名中选出的。 五位获奖者将在 11 月的颁奖典礼上公布，其中来自“地球行动”五个类别（保护和恢复自然、复兴我们的海洋、清洁我们的空气、建设一个无废物的世界以及改善我们的气候）中的每一个类别。 负责评选获奖者的 Earthshot 奖委员会成员包括威廉王子、约旦王后拉尼娅·阿卜杜拉、女演员凯特·布兰切特和厨师何塞·安德烈斯。 威廉王子告诉英国广播公司：“解决方案就在这里。现在的挑战是规模。” “进步是真实的。现在我们需要加速它。这正是‘地球奋斗奖’存在的原因。” 对于威廉王子的叔叔斯宾塞伯爵对其父母的指控，王室成员度过了艰难的一周。 威廉王子和他的兄弟苏塞克斯公爵都没有对这本书或……发表任何公开评论。

reflection.en: Prince William's plea for urgency in addressing climate change highlights humanity's growing capacity to understand and innovate. The rapid advancement of knowledge, as described in Daniel 12:4, presents both immense opportunities and profound responsibilities for stewardship of creation. May we use this expanding knowledge with wisdom and a deep sense of...
reflection.zh: 威廉王子呼吁在应对气候变化方面加快步伐，这凸显了人类日益增长的理解和创新能力。但以理书12:4所描述的知识的快速增长，既带来了巨大的机遇，也带来了管理受造界的深重责任。愿我们以智慧和对地球深切的关怀来运用这些不断增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ‘A map is never neutral’: meet the cartographers who took on centuries of western bias
title.zh: “地图永远不是中立的”：认识那些挑战了几个世纪西方偏见的制图师

summary.en: The Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, offers an alternative to the 16th-century Mercator map. Three cartographers created it to more accurately represent the sizes of continents like Africa and Europe, countering the Mercator map's tendency to exaggerate the size of northern hemisphere nations and...
summary.zh: 平等地球投影图在上周被联合国采纳，为16世纪的麦卡托投影图提供了一个替代方案。三位制图师创建了该地图，旨在更准确地展示非洲和欧洲等大陆的实际大小，以对抗麦卡托投影图夸大北半球国家面积并以此微妙地强化全球力量认知的倾向。尽管收到了一些外交官的投诉，但联合国近乎普遍地采纳这一新地图被视为一个重大转变。

body.en: Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, provides an alternative to 16th-century Mercator display Three cartographers have spoken of their astonishment at the UN’s near-universal adoption of a map they created to more accurately show the sizes of Africa and Europe, even though they have received a few complaints from some disgruntled diplomats. The creators of the Equal Earth projection aimed to provide an alternative to the dominant 16th-century Mercator display, which critics have long faulted for giving the impression that northern hemisphere nations are larger than they are – and therefore subtly reinforcing perceptions of where global strength lies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联合国上周采用的平等地球投影提供了 16 世纪墨卡托显示的替代方案。三位制图师表示，他们对联合国几乎普遍采用他们为更准确地显示非洲和欧洲面积而制作的地图感到惊讶，尽管他们收到了一些心怀不满的外交官的抱怨。平等地球投影的创造者旨在为 16 世纪墨卡托投影提供一种替代方案，批评者长期以来一直批评这种投影给人一种北半球国家比实际面积更大的印象，从而巧妙地强化了人们对全球实力所在的看法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: For centuries, the Mercator projection subtly shaped how the world perceived the relative sizes of nations, often overemphasizing the North and diminishing the South. The adoption of the Equal Earth map by the UN signifies a move towards greater accuracy and a correction of historical bias. This reminds us that how we represent reality, even in seemingly...
reflection.zh: 几个世纪以来，麦卡托投影图在潜移默化中塑造了世界对各国相对大小的认知，常常夸大北方而缩小南方。联合国采纳平等地球地图标志着朝着更准确的方向迈进，并纠正了历史偏见。这提醒我们，即使是我们呈现现实的方式，即使是像地图这样看似中立的工具，也可能带有隐藏的假设，并影响我们对公平和比例的理解。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Improved air quality linked to better mental development in toddlers, study finds
title.zh: 改善空气质量与幼儿心智发展更好相关，研究发现

summary.en: Long-term research in New York indicates that efforts to reduce air pollution are associated with higher cognitive test scores in toddlers. A study by Columbia University, following over 1,100 children for more than two decades, measured pollution exposure of pregnant women and their children's development in...
summary.zh: 纽约一项长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与幼儿更高的认知测试分数相关。哥伦比亚大学的一项研究，在二十多年里跟踪了超过1100名儿童，测量了孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子在曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区的发展情况，发现空气更清洁与三岁时认知能力提高之间存在联系。

body.en: Long-term research in New York shows efforts to reduce air pollution associated with higher cognitive test scores Improvements in air pollution are leading to brighter, smarter toddlers, according to a new study from Columbia University in New York. For more than two decades, Prof Frederica Perera and a team from the Columbia Center for Children’s Environmental Health measured the air pollution exposure of pregnant women and the development of their children in the disadvantaged communities of northern Manhattan and the South Bronx. More than 1,100 children were assessed when they were one, two and three years old. Continue reading...
body.zh: 纽约的长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与较高的认知测试成绩有关。纽约哥伦比亚大学的一项新研究表明，空气污染的改善正在使幼儿变得更聪明、更聪明。二十多年来，弗雷德里卡·佩雷拉教授和哥伦比亚儿童环境健康中心的一个团队测量了曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子的发育情况。超过 1,100 名一岁、两岁和三岁的儿童接受了评估。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study from New York offers a hopeful glimpse into how environmental stewardship can directly benefit the youngest among us. The finding that cleaner air correlates with better cognitive development in toddlers underscores the intricate connection between the world we shape and the well-being of its inhabitants. It reminds us that caring for creation is...
reflection.zh: 这项来自纽约的研究为我们提供了希望的曙光，展示了环境管理如何能直接造福我们当中最年幼的生命。清洁空气与幼儿认知发展改善之间的相关性，突显了我们所塑造的世界与其居民福祉之间错综复杂的联系。它提醒我们，关爱受造界不仅仅是一个抽象的理念，更是对未来的切实投资。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Cognitive resilience helps to predict Alzheimer’s dementia
title.zh: 认知弹性有助于预测阿尔茨海默病

summary.en: Cognitive resilience, a trait that helps explain why symptoms of Alzheimer's dementia vary in severity among individuals with similar brain pathology, could be a key predictor of the disease.
summary.zh: 认知弹性是帮助解释为何在脑病理学相似的个体中，阿尔茨海默病痴呆症的症状严重程度各不相同的特征，它可能成为该疾病的关键预测指标。

body.zh: 研究人员已经确定了一种“认知弹性”测量方法，可以解释阿尔茨海默病病理水平相似的人中痴呆风险的一些显着差异 1 。 职位：Nature Communications（高分子材料）副主编或高级编辑地点：上海、北京、南京、新德里或浦那（混合）应用程序... 职位：Nature Portfolio 副主编或高级编辑（可持续材料化学）地点：上海、北京、南京、新德里或浦那（Hyb... 职称：副或高级编辑，通信物理地点：上海、北京、柏林、海德堡、浦那（混合）截止日期：9 月 3 日...

reflection.en: The discovery of cognitive resilience in the face of Alzheimer's pathology is a testament to the intricate design of the human mind. It reminds us that even in the face of decline, there are remarkable capacities at play, echoing the ancient wisdom that creation itself reveals profound truths about its Maker.
reflection.zh: 在面对阿尔茨海默病病理学时发现认知弹性，是人类心智复杂设计的明证。它提醒我们，即使在衰退面前，也有非凡的能力在起作用，这呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身揭示了其创造者的深刻真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How research funding took me out of the lab and into leadership
title.zh: 研究经费如何让我走出实验室，走向领导岗位

summary.en: Landing two large grants caused Anna Sandak to take on a managerial role in her team and made her reflect on what it means to contribute to research.
summary.zh: 获得两项大型资助使安娜·桑达克（Anna Sandak）承担起团队的管理职责，并促使她反思为研究做出贡献的意义。

reflection.en: Anna Sandak's transition from lab bench to leadership, prompted by securing significant research funding, illustrates how our roles can evolve. Whether in direct research or in managing its progress, every task can be an opportunity to serve, bringing dedication and integrity to our responsibilities as if serving a higher purpose. Colossians 3:23 reminds...
reflection.zh: 安娜·桑达克（Anna Sandak）在获得重要研究资助的推动下，从实验室工作转向管理岗位，这说明了我们的角色如何演变。无论是在直接研究还是管理其进展中，每一项任务都可以成为服务的机会，以奉献和诚信的态度对待我们的职责，如同为更高的目标服务。 歌罗西书3章23节提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Could AI really end humanity? Our tech experts are answering your questions now
title.zh: 人工智能真的会终结人类吗？现在就向我们的科技记者提问

summary.en: Following a week of dire warnings about artificial intelligence's potential to cause global destruction, expert tech reporters will address public questions about the reality of the AI threat in a live session. The session will cover disturbing claims about superintelligent AI and warnings from industry insiders about...
summary.zh: 在一周关于人工智能可能导致全球毁灭的严峻警告之后，专家科技记者将在直播中解答公众关于人工智能威胁现实性的问题。会议将讨论关于超级人工智能的令人不安的说法，以及来自行业内部人士关于试图滥用人工智能用于有害目的（如设计武器或制造病原体）的警告。

body.en: After a week of alarming warnings about artificial intelligence’s potential to destroy the world as we know it, our technology reporters are answering your questions on the reality of the AI threat live now IcommentthereforeIam asks: Given our senses, emotions, memory and moods, is it ever going to be accepted that humanly conscious AI is fantasy? Dan: This is a serious question that has even rattled Richard Dawkins, the evolutionary biologist. He may not believe that God is real but he does believe that AI is conscious - or at least the chatbot he was using, which he called Claudia. “You may not know you are conscious, but you bloody well are,” he wrote. And he’s not the first. In 2022 Google fired an engineer who went public with his belief that a company-developed AI had feelings. At the more troubling end of this belief, there are countless examples of people becoming overly attached to, and influenced by, AI chatbots – including cases of psychosis. Aisha: There’s certainly a theatrical – even “psy-op” - quality to the flurry of AI doomsaying over the past weeks. It’s hard to say entirely what concrete developments are at the root of it all. We know that the Hugging Face incident , where a “swarm” of AI agents hacked another company, has been one trigger of the drama. There have been other contributing incidents too – Dario Amodei suggests internal developments at Anthropic have prompted his latest round of blogging, and there’s been some X discourse and doomy muttering about bioweapons. We aren’t in the heads of Dario Amodei or Sam Altman, and so we cannot say how sincere they are, and how much they might have other goals in mind – such as, perhaps, delaying their IPOs until their finances look better. But any company of their size, and with their potential liabilities, would be angling hard to be regulated as favourably as possible. That’s what big companies do. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过一周有关该技术有可能毁灭我们所知的世界的警告之后，我们的专业技术记者将回答您有关人工智能威胁的现实的问题。请在英国夏令时下午 3 点（欧洲中部夏令时间下午 4 点，美国东部夏令时间上午 10 点）加入我们，他们将现场回答您的问题。 注册或登录以提出您的问题 上周左右，我们看到了关于超级智能人工智能有能力摧毁地球的令人不安的说法。它还看到了来自行业内部人士的警告，包括 Anthropic 的报告称犯罪分子、国家支持的团体、间谍软件供应商、科学家和宣传人员试图利用其模型“设计导弹和炸弹、制造致命病原体和监视持不同政见者”，以及埃隆·马斯克声称它可能“比核武器更危险”。我们的报告团队一直在努力弄清这些说法的规模。伟大的人工智能恐慌是否合理？他们将于英国夏令时下午 3 点（欧洲中部夏令时间下午 4 点，美国东部夏令时间上午 10 点）在此尝试回答您可能遇到的任何问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, with its potential for both immense good and catastrophic harm, brings to mind the ancient story of the Tower of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach the heavens, unchecked by wisdom or humility, led to confusion and scattering. As we grapple with the power of AI, we must ask if our pursuit of knowledge and capability is balanced...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，既有巨大的潜力，也可能带来灾难性的危害，这让人想起古代巴别塔的故事。人类那不受约束的、追求触及天堂的野心，最终导致了混乱和分散。当我们努力应对人工智能的力量时，我们必须扪心自问：我们对知识和能力的追求，是否与对后果和人类共同体的深刻考量相平衡？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Australia claims it is a global pioneer in preventing online harm - should other countries follow suit?
title.zh: 澳大利亚声称在防止网络伤害方面处于全球领先地位——其他国家应该效仿吗？

summary.en: As Prime Minister Anthony Albanese prepares to visit the US for discussions on social media reform, his proactive stance highlights a level of leadership often unexpected from a smaller nation. The article questions whether other countries should follow Australia's lead in addressing online harms.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯即将前往美国讨论社交媒体改革。他的积极姿态展现了来自一个小国身上不常有的领导力。文章探讨了其他国家是否应该效仿澳大利亚在解决网络伤害方面的做法。

body.en: As Anthony Albanese heads to the US to discuss social media reform, he has shown a level of leadership not always expected from a smaller country Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Statesmen, shysters, dictators. Over the years, the United Nations has seen all kinds of world leaders. But when he arrives in New York on Monday for the annual general assembly, Anthony Albanese will be looking for collaborators. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯前往美国讨论社交媒体改革时，他表现出了小国家所不具备的领导力水平。获取我们新的政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客政治家、狡猾的人、独裁者。多年来，联合国见过各种各样的世界领导人。但当安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一抵达纽约参加年度大会时，他将寻找合作者。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world grappling with the complexities of online spaces, Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is stepping forward to champion social media reform. This initiative reflects a commitment to responsible governance, urging leaders to actively pursue justice and protect citizens, as Jeremiah 22:3 calls for: "Do justice and righteousness, and deliver...
reflection.zh: 在一个努力应对网络空间复杂性的世界里，澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯正挺身而出，倡导社交媒体改革。这一举措体现了对负责任治理的承诺，敦促领导人积极追求公义，保护公民，正如耶利米书 22:3 所呼吁的：“你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被掠夺的脱离欺压者的手。”

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: ‘A critical moment’: concern UK is not up to speed in acting on AI risks
title.zh: “关键时刻”：担忧英国在应对人工智能风险方面不够敏锐

summary.en: Andy Burnham's focus on immediate domestic problems leads some to fear the issue has dropped off the government's radar. Towards the end of Keir Starmer's time in office, his senior ministers, alarmed by the latest developments in artificial intelligence, began drawing up plans for a new AI safety law. They ordered a...
summary.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆对眼前国内问题的关注，让一些人担心该问题已从政府的视野中消失。在基尔·斯塔默任期末期，他的高级部长们对人工智能的最新发展感到震惊，开始起草一项新的人工智能安全法。据知情人士透露，他们下令审查现有立法，以了解他们已拥有哪些权力，并正在探讨是否能迫使世界上最先进的技术公司在推出产品前提交其产品进行安全测试。

body.en: Andy Burnham’s focus on immediate domestic problems leads some to fear issue has dropped off government’s radar Towards the end of Keir Starmer’s time in office, his senior ministers, alarmed by the latest developments in artificial intelligence, began drawing up plans for a new AI safety law. They ordered a review of existing legislation to see what powers they already had, according to those briefed on the plans, and were exploring whether they could force the world’s most advanced technology companies to submit their products for safety testing before launching them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）对眼前的国内问题的关注导致一些人担心这个问题已经不再受到政府的关注。在凯尔·斯塔默（Keir Starmer）任期即将结束时，他的高级部长们对人工智能的最新发展感到震惊，开始制定新的人工智能安全法的计划。据了解该计划的人士透露，他们下令对现有立法进行审查，看看自己已经拥有哪些权力，并正在探索是否可以迫使世界上最先进的技术公司在推出产品之前提交其产品进行安全测试。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents a profound challenge, demanding careful consideration of its potential risks. Just as metals are tested by fire, the true character and safety of powerful new technologies are revealed through rigorous examination and foresight. This moment calls for wisdom and diligence to ensure that innovation...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展带来了严峻的挑战，需要我们审慎考量其潜在风险。正如金属需要烈火来淬炼，强大新技术真正的品格和安全性也需要在严格的审视和远见中显现。此刻，我们需要智慧和勤勉，以确保创新能服务于人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Meet the winner of Nikon's Small World in Motion video contest
title.zh: 认识尼康的微距摄影大赛获奖者

summary.en: Ning Xu of Tsinghua University won Nikon's Small World in Motion contest with a super-resolution video showing the abnormal beating of cilia in the airways of a child with a rare genetic respiratory disorder.
summary.zh: 清华大学的许宁凭借一段展示患有罕见遗传性呼吸系统疾病的儿童气道纤毛异常搏动的超高分辨率视频，赢得了尼康“微距摄影”大赛的奖项。

body.en: Abnormal beating of airway cilia from a child with Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia, a genetic disorder affecting respiratory function. Credit: Ning Xu, Tsinghua University Abnormal beating of airway cilia from a child with Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia, a genetic disorder affecting respiratory function. Credit: Ning Xu, Tsinghua University A Chinese optical engineer is the winner of this year's Small World in Motion competition, sponsored by Nikon. Ning Xu of Tsinghua University in Beijing beat out 346 other video entries from 40 different countries with his super-resolution video (above) of the abnormal beating of cilia in the airways of a child with a rare genetic respiratory disorder. Founded in 2011, the Nikon Small World in Motion competition is a spinoff of the company's Small World Photomicrography Competition, which has been around since 1974. Both are meant "to showcase the beauty and complexity of things seen through the light microscope"—one through still photographs, the other through photovideography, taking advantage of all the technological advances that now allow users to make movies or time-lapse images through the microscope. Primary ciliary dyskinesia ( PCD ) is a genetic disorder that adversely affects the tiny hairlike structures that line the lungs, among other areas. Their wavelike motion helps move around germs, mucus, dust, and other irritants so the body can dispel them via coughing or sneezing. In people born with PCD, there is something wrong with those cilia, so those irritants build up, causing respiratory infections, among other complications. The cilia might be the wrong size, the wrong shape, or missing altogether. They might move abnormally, or not move at all. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 患有原发性纤毛运动障碍（一种影响呼吸功能的遗传性疾病）的儿童气道纤毛异常跳动。图片来源：Ning Xu，清华大学 患有原发性纤毛运动障碍（一种影响呼吸功能的遗传性疾病）的儿童气道纤毛异常跳动。图片来源：Ning Xu，清华大学 一位中国光学工程师是今年由尼康赞助的“运动小世界”竞赛的获胜者。北京清华大学的徐宁凭借他的超分辨率视频（上图）击败了来自 40 个不同国家的 346 个其他视频作品，该视频显示了一名患有罕见遗传性呼吸系统疾病的儿童气道中纤毛的异常跳动。尼康动态小世界大赛创办于 2011 年，是该公司自 1974 年开始举办的小世界显微摄影大赛的衍生项目。两者的目的都是“展示通过光学显微镜看到的事物的美丽和复杂性”——一个通过静态照片，另一个通过摄影摄像，充分利用现在允许用户通过显微镜制作电影或延时图像的所有技术进步。原发性纤毛运动障碍 (PCD) 是一种遗传性疾病，会对肺部等区域的微小毛发状结构产生不利影响。它们的波浪状运动有助于移动细菌、粘液、灰尘和其他刺激物，这样身体就可以通过咳嗽或打喷嚏将它们驱散。在出生时患有 PCD 的人中，纤毛有问题，因此这些刺激物会积聚，导致呼吸道感染和其他并发症。纤毛可能大小错误、形状错误或完全缺失。它们可能会异常移动，或者根本不移动。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This award-winning video captures the intricate, microscopic world of human cilia, revealing the subtle mechanics of a rare respiratory disorder. It reminds us that even in the smallest, most complex biological systems, Yahweh's wisdom is displayed. Observing and understanding these details can lead to greater knowledge and potential healing.
reflection.zh: 这段获奖视频捕捉了人体纤毛复杂而微观的世界，揭示了一种罕见呼吸系统疾病的细微机制。它提醒我们，即使在最小、最复杂的生物系统中，雅伟的智慧也得以彰显。观察和理解这些细节可以带来更多的知识和潜在的治愈。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
title.zh: 研究人员使用 Claude 攻击了 OpenAI

summary.en: Cyber researchers successfully used Anthropic's AI tool, Claude, to gain access to an OpenAI employee's account, exposing sensitive GitHub data and raising concerns about the security practices of leading AI companies.
summary.zh: 网络研究人员成功利用了 Anthropic 的 AI 工具 Claude，访问了 OpenAI 员工的账户，暴露了敏感的 GitHub 数据，并引发了人们对领先 AI 公司安全措施的担忧。

body.en: Cyber researchers broke into OpenAI using its key rival Anthropic’s software, highlighting vulnerabilities in the ChatGPT maker’s security as leading AI companies face mounting scrutiny over safety. A small cyber security group gained access to an OpenAI employee’s ChatGPT account, which permitted them to read private software information and suggest changes. The researchers had been given access to an Anthropic tool specifically designed for security professionals, and were paid for the work as part of a program to find vulnerabilities before they could be exploited by bad actors. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 网络研究人员使用其主要竞争对手 Anthropic 的软件侵入 OpenAI，突显了 ChatGPT 制造商的安全漏洞，因为领先的人工智能公司面临着越来越严格的安全审查。一个小型网络安全小组获得了 OpenAI 员工 ChatGPT 帐户的访问权限，这使他们能够读取私人软件信息并提出更改建议。研究人员获得了专门为安全专业人员设计的 Anthropic 工具的访问权，并获得了报酬，作为在漏洞被不良行为者利用之前发现漏洞的计划的一部分。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents incredible opportunities, but this incident serves as a stark reminder that new technologies can also introduce unforeseen vulnerabilities. As we develop powerful tools like Claude and ChatGPT, we must diligently consider their potential for misuse and prioritize robust security measures to protect sensitive information...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展带来了巨大的机遇，但此次事件也警示我们，新技术可能带来意想不到的漏洞。在我们开发 Claude 和 ChatGPT 等强大工具的同时，必须认真考虑其被滥用的可能性，并优先考虑强大的安全措施，以保护敏感信息并防止损害。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: OpenAI ‘ethically hacked’ with help of Anthropic’s Claude chatbot
title.zh: OpenAI被“道德黑客”攻破，助手是Claude聊天机器人

summary.en: Cybersecurity researchers have successfully infiltrated OpenAI's systems by exploiting employee accounts, with the assistance of Anthropic's Claude chatbot. The researchers stated that the potential scope of access was vast, underscoring ongoing security vulnerabilities at the AI company.
summary.zh: 网络安全研究人员借助Anthropic的Claude聊天机器人，通过利用员工账户成功入侵了OpenAI的系统。研究人员表示，理论上可访问的范围非常广阔，凸显了该公司持续存在的安全漏洞。

body.en: US cybersecurity researchers who conducted hack say ‘scope of what we could theoretically access was huge’ Cybersecurity researchers have hacked into OpenAI with the help of Anthropic’s Claude chatbot, in the latest example of security issues at the company. A team at a US-based startup compromised a number of OpenAI employees’ ChatGPT accounts, starting a process that enabled them to access their target’s software cache – and potentially more. Continue reading...
body.zh: 进行黑客攻击的美国网络安全研究人员表示，“理论上我们可以访问的范围是巨大的”网络安全研究人员在 Anthropic 的 Claude 聊天机器人的帮助下侵入了 OpenAI，这是该公司安全问题的最新例子。一家美国初创公司的一个团队入侵了一些 OpenAI 员工的 ChatGPT 帐户，启动了一个进程，使他们能够访问目标的软件缓存，甚至可能访问更多内容。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as seen in this 'ethical hack,' presents a double-edged sword. While these tools can be used to identify vulnerabilities, they also highlight the immense power and potential for misuse. We are called to exercise discernment, ensuring that technological progress serves good and does not lead us into unforeseen dangers.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，正如这次“道德黑客”事件所示，是一把双刃剑。虽然这些工具可以用来识别漏洞，但它们也凸显了巨大的潜力和滥用的可能性。我们蒙召要运用分辨力，确保技术进步服务于善，而不是将我们引入未知的危险。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Rocket Report: China wants a Raptor 3 engine; SpaceX set for big Starship test
title.zh: 火箭报告：中国寻求猛禽3发动机；SpaceX准备进行大型星舰测试

summary.en: This edition of the Rocket Report focuses on the declining fortunes of United Launch Alliance (ULA), a joint venture of Boeing and Lockheed Martin, which once dominated the US launch industry but now faces challenges with its expendable rocket strategy. The report also notes China's interest in SpaceX's Raptor 3...
summary.zh: 本期《火箭报告》聚焦于波音和洛克希德·马丁合资企业联合发射联盟（ULA）日益衰落的命运，该公司曾主导美国发射产业，但现在正面临其一次性火箭策略的挑战。报告还提到中国对SpaceX猛禽3发动机的兴趣，并预告了SpaceX一次重要的星舰测试。

body.en: Welcome to Edition 9.11 of the Rocket Report! The most interesting story of the week, in our view, is a deep dive by Stephen Clark, linked below, into the dwindling fortunes of United Launch Alliance. As recently as a decade ago, the launch company, co-owned by Boeing and Lockheed Martin, could claim dominance over the US industry. But those glory days are fading fast. So what's next for a company that is tied to an expendable rocket? As always, we welcome reader submissions , and if you don't want to miss an issue, please subscribe using the box below (the form will not appear on AMP-enabled versions of the site). Each report will include information on small-, medium-, and heavy-lift rockets as well as a quick look ahead at the next three launches on the calendar. Avio seeks to cash in on Falcon 9 retreat . Italian launch services provider Avio has seen an influx of customers who were unable to secure launch opportunities with SpaceX, European Spaceflight reports . “I can tell you SpaceX has already gone captive because we have a whole bunch of customers coming to us and saying, 'Oh my God, can you fly us?'” Avio CEO Giulio Ranzo said during the company’s September 10 earnings call. In recent months, SpaceX told multiple prospective customers that it was no longer accepting new orders for commercial Falcon 9 launches. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 欢迎来到火箭报告 9.11 版！我们认为，本周最有趣的故事是斯蒂芬·克拉克（Stephen Clark）对联合发射联盟（United Launch Alliance）日益萎缩的财富的深入探讨（链接如下）。就在十年前，这家由波音公司和洛克希德·马丁公司共同拥有的发射公司还可能声称在美国工业界占据主导地位。但那些辉煌岁月正在迅速消逝。那么，对于一家与消耗性火箭息息相关的公司来说，下一步该何去何从呢？一如既往，我们欢迎读者提交意见，如果您不想错过任何一期，请使用下面的框订阅（该表单不会出现在启用 AMP 的网站版本上）。每份报告都将包括有关小型、中型和重型火箭的信息，以及对日历上接下来的三次发射的快速展望。 Avio 寻求从猎鹰 9 号撤退中获利。据欧洲航天公司报道，意大利发射服务提供商 Avio 发现大量无法获得 SpaceX 发射机会的客户涌入。 “我可以告诉你，SpaceX 已经被俘虏了，因为有一大群客户来找我们说，‘天哪，你能带我们飞吗？’”Avio 首席执行官朱利奥·兰佐 (Giulio Ranzo) 在该公司 9 月 10 日的财报电话会议上表示。近几个月来，SpaceX 告诉多名潜在客户，不再接受商业猎鹰 9 号发射的新订单。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, particularly in areas like aerospace, can feel dizzying. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase" (Daniel 12:4), a description that certainly fits our current era of rapid innovation. As we witness these leaps in capability, may we seek wisdom to guide their development and...
reflection.zh: 技术进步的无情步伐，尤其是在航空航天等领域，可能令人眼花缭乱。但以理书的预言谈到了一个“知识增长”（但以理书12:4）的时代，这无疑符合我们当前快速创新的时代。当我们见证这些能力的飞跃时，愿我们寻求智慧来指导其发展和应用，以造福所有人。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The virtual worlds where robots are trained
title.zh: 机器人训练的虚拟世界

summary.en: Training systems that allow robots to negotiate the real world are becoming more sophisticated, enabling rapid skill development and deployment.
summary.zh: 允许机器人应对现实世界的训练系统正变得越来越复杂，能够快速开发和部署技能。

body.en:
Freddo the robot walks across the office and takes a plastic bottled offered by a staff member.

Given that a robot recently beat Usain Bolt's 100m sprint record, it's not the most startling achievement.

But the speed by which Freddo has been trained to walk, recognise the bottle and grasp it is impressive. It took just a few minutes to develop those skills and upload them to Freddo. His developers say rival systems could take days to attain such skills.

I'm at Vsim, a British start-up based in Cambridge. Founders Michelle Lu and Kier Storey hope one day their software will control robots that can navigate and do useful tasks in the home and workplace.

"It's a weird situation with robotics because actually the stuff that we find as humans to be incredibly difficult, like gymnastics, you can get robots to do reasonably well. The stuff that humans are really good at, like fine dexterity, is really hard in robots," Storey says.

Freddo's skills were honed in a virtual environment, where a task can be performed in a computer simulation millions of times. Once the optimum solution (known as a policy) is found, it can be uploaded and used by the hardware - in this case Freddo.

Such virtual simulations are a common way to train robots. Tech giant Nvidia has a system called Isaac Sim which works that way - Lu and Storey both worked on an early version of it.

In 2022 they decided to set up Vsim, to build the their own training system environment and other tools.

As they were starting from scratch Lu and Storey could optimise the software to exploit the powerful computer chips used in AI, known as graphics processing units or GPUs.

"The underlying algorithms that we were using for most of these robotic simulations they hark back to the 1970s and 1980s, but those algorithms are not really brilliant fits for GPUs," Storey says.

Within months they realised their system could work much faster than anything they had seen before.

"Eighteen months in and we actually have a completely functional, super high-performance simulator," says Lu.

The software is so efficient that it can run on the hardware carried by Freddo. That means the robot can run tens of thousand of simulations while it is moving around.

"It can look about a second, or so, ahead into the future for 20,000 different kind of combinations of things that might happen," Storey explains.

And that would be vital for a robot moving around an unstructured environment like the average home.

"Things outside of the robot's control, like humans, animals or even other robots, could do things that require a change of strategy. These unexpected events could happen very quickly and the robot needs to be able to quickly adapt to ensure its actions remain safe and on-mission," Lu says.

Vsim is a start-up...
body.zh: 机器人弗雷多走过办公室，拿起工作人员提供的一个塑料瓶。 鉴于机器人最近打破了尤塞恩·博尔特 (Usain Bolt) 的 1 亿短跑纪录，这并不是最令人震惊的成就。 但弗雷多在行走、识别瓶子和抓握瓶子方面的训练速度令人印象深刻。只需几分钟即可开发这些技能并将其上传到 Freddo。他的开发人员表示，竞争对手的系统可能需要几天时间才能获得此类技能。 我在 Vsim，一家位于剑桥的英国初创公司。创始人 Michelle Lu 和 Kier Storey 希望有一天他们的软件能够控制能够在家庭和工作场所导航并执行有用任务的机器人。 “对于机器人来说，这是一个奇怪的情况，因为实际上我们发现人类非常困难的事情，比如体操，你可以让机器人做得相当好。人类真正擅长的事情，比如精细的灵活性，对机器人来说真的很难，”斯托里说。 Freddo 的技能是在虚拟环境中磨练的，在虚拟环境中，一项任务可以在计算机模拟中执行数百万次。一旦找到最佳解决方案（称为策略），它就可以上传并由硬件使用 - 在本例中为 Freddo。 这种虚拟模拟是训练机器人的常见方法。科技巨头 Nvidia 有一个名为 Isaac Sim 的系统，它就是这样工作的——Lu 和 Storey 都开发了它的早期版本。 2022年他们决定成立Vsim，构建自己的训练系统环境和其他工具。 由于他们从头开始，Lu 和 Storey 可以优化软件，以利用人工智能中使用的强大计算机芯片，即图形处理单元或 GPU。 “我们在大多数机器人模拟中使用的底层算法可以追溯到 20 世纪 70 年代和 80 年代，但这些算法并不是非常适合 GPU，”Storey 说。 几个月内，他们意识到他们的系统的运行速度比他们以前见过的任何系统都要快得多。 “十八个月后，我们实际上拥有了一个功能齐全、超高性能的模拟器，”卢说。 该软件非常高效，可以在Freddo携带的硬件上运行。这意味着机器人在移动时可以运行数万次模拟。 “它可以预测未来一秒左右可能发生的 20,000 种不同类型的事情组合，”斯托里解释道。 这对于在普通家庭等非结构化环境中移动的机器人来说至关重要。 “机器人控制之外的事物，比如人类、动物甚至其他机器人，可能会做一些需要改变策略的事情。这些意外事件可能会很快发生，机器人需要能够快速适应，以确保其行动保持安全并执行任务，”卢说。 Vsim 是一家初创公司...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement in training robots, like Freddo learning to grasp a bottle in minutes, showcases human ingenuity and the pursuit of efficiency. This drive to excel in our endeavors can be seen as a reflection of the call to 'do all your work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men' (Colossians 3:23). Whether in developing AI or performing daily tasks,...
reflection.zh: 像弗雷多（Freddo）那样在几分钟内学会抓取瓶子的机器人训练的快速发展，展示了人类的创造力和对效率的追求。这种在我们事业上追求卓越的动力，可以看作是对‘无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不是为人做的’（歌罗西书 3:23）这一呼召的反映。无论是开发人工智能还是完成日常任务，以勤奋和目标来对待我们的工作，都是对造物主的尊重。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: King Charles warns of 'existential danger' of AI falling into wrong hands
title.zh: 查尔斯国王警告人工智能落入不法之徒手中存在“生存危险”

summary.en: King Charles has convened a summit with AI leaders, including representatives from Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic, to discuss the potential "existential dangers" of artificial intelligence falling into the wrong hands. This meeting occurs amidst growing industry concerns about the rapid advancement of AI and the need...
summary.zh: 查尔斯国王召集了一次人工智能领导人峰会，与会者包括来自英伟达、OpenAI和Anthropic的代表，以讨论人工智能落入不法之徒手中可能带来的“生存危险”。此次会议正值业界对人工智能的快速发展以及监管必要性日益担忧之际。

body.en:
King Charles has warned AI executives of the "existential dangers" posed by the technology falling into the wrong hands.

He made the comments at a summit he had convened at Dumfries House in Ayrshire to discuss how the tech can be used to benefit society.

Those gathered at the meeting also included Kanishka Narayan, the UK's AI Minister, the Pope's advisor, and participants from AI giants such as Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic.

It comes amid a series of recent warnings from people inside the industry about the rapidly evolving capabilities of advanced or "frontier" AI models and the regulation needed to keep them in check.

"Those who have created these technologies are now increasingly warning that AI risks developing darker capacities - perhaps even to take life," the King told the executives.

He said there seemed to be an "urgency" in "adequately considering the existential dangers of such technologies falling into the wrong hands, and being used in potentially catastrophic ways".

"The task before you is not merely to advance technology, but to ensure that it remains firmly in the service of humanity, community and the natural world," he told the group.

The summit has been called to consider whether a "shared set of principles" can be developed to "help guide the future application" of AI.

Jensen Huang, chief executive of Nvidia, was among top industry leaders attending.

Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, supplying chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta.

It is also the world's most valuable company, with a stock market value of around $5.15tn.

Huang told the room he believed safety was "paramount", adding that companies should hold back a product and "keep engineering" if it was not safe enough.

The Nvidia boss also highlighted the value of open models - systems which give users direct access to the software - as a way to "ensure that people and countries are not left behind".

He said these systems must also be protected so "researchers, universities, start-ups and countries" can develop applications "none of us would have imagined alone".

"Let us lead with responsible optimism, build AI safely and securely, open it to more people, expand our ambition and solve the problems that matter to the world," Huang added.

Meanwhile Sir Demis Hassabis, who co-founded the UK AI lab DeepMind - later acquired by Google - offered a more cautious view on the pace of development.

He said artificial general intelligence - systems it is believed could be as good as or better than humans at multiple tasks - was "probably only a few short years away" and could have an impact "ten times that of the Industrial Revolution".

But he advocated for "a sensible middle way", saying humanity could address risks if...
body.zh: 查尔斯国王警告人工智能高管，该技术落入坏人之手将带来“生存危险”。 他在艾尔郡邓弗里斯大厦召开的峰会上发表了上述言论，讨论如何利用这项技术造福社会。 出席会议的还包括英国人工智能大臣、教皇顾问卡尼什卡·纳拉扬（Kanishka Narayan），以及来自 Nvidia、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等人工智能巨头的与会者。 与此同时，业内人士最近就先进或“前沿”人工智能模型快速发展的能力以及控制它们所需的监管发出了一系列警告。 “那些创造这些技术的人现在越来越多地警告说，人工智能有可能发展出更黑暗的能力——甚至可能夺走生命，”国王告诉高管们。 他表示，“充分考虑此类技术落入坏人之手并以潜在灾难性方式使用所带来的生存危险”似乎是“紧迫的”。 “你们面前的任务不仅仅是推进技术，还要确保它坚定地为人类、社区和自然世界服务，”他告诉该组织。 此次峰会被要求考虑是否可以制定一套“共享原则”来“帮助指导人工智能的未来应用”。 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 是出席会议的顶级行业领袖之一。 Nvidia 是人工智能基础设施领域的核心参与者，为 OpenAI 和 Meta 等领先的人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。 它也是世界上最有价值的公司，股票市值约为 5.15 兆美元。 黄告诉在场的人，他认为安全是“最重要的”，并补充说，如果产品不够安全，公司应该保留产品并“继续进行工程设计”。 这位英伟达老板还强调了开放模型（让用户直接访问软件的系统）的价值，作为“确保人民和国家不落后”的一种方式。 他表示，这些系统也必须受到保护，以便“研究人员、大学、初创企业和国家”能够开发“我们谁都无法单独想象的”应用程序。 黄补充道：“让我们以负责任的乐观态度引领，安全可靠地构建人工智能，向更多人开放，扩大我们的雄心，解决对世界至关重要的问题。” 与此同时，英国人工智能实验室 DeepMind（后来被谷歌收购）的联合创始人 Demis Hassabis 爵士对发展速度提出了更为谨慎的看法。 他表示，通用人工智能——人们相信在多项任务上可以与人类一样好甚至更好的系统——“可能只需要短短几年的时间”就会出现，并且可能产生“十倍于工业革命的影响”。 但他主张“明智的中间道路”，并表示人类可以应对风险，如果......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as discussed at King Charles's summit, brings both immense potential and significant risks. The warning about AI falling into the wrong hands echoes the biblical understanding that increased knowledge and technological prowess can be a double-edged sword, requiring careful ethical consideration and wisdom.
reflection.zh: 查尔斯国王峰会上讨论的人工智能的快速发展，带来了巨大的潜力和重大的风险。关于人工智能落入不法之徒手中的警告，呼应了圣经中关于知识和技术能力增长可能是一把双刃剑的理解，这需要仔细的伦理考量和智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why are there concerns AI could threaten humanity, and how real are they?
title.zh: 为什么担心人工智能会威胁人类，它们有多真实？

summary.en: Existential fears about AI have once again reared their head - here's what you need to know.
summary.zh: 关于人工智能的生存恐惧再次抬头——以下是您需要了解的信息。

body.en:
A slew of warnings about the potential dangers of AI have spurred calls for coordinated action to slow the technology's development.

Claims by current and former researchers that the tech will endanger humanity - with one suggesting there is a greater than 10% chance of it " killing all humans " - have raised alarm bells.

Major developers OpenAI and Anthropic are urging lawmakers to regulate AI, with Microsoft's AI boss the latest to say rules are needed to prevent a "silicon species" from eventually competing with humanity .

But some have dismissed the calls as an effort by big AI developers to cement their dominance over rivals.

Some AI researchers say there are worrying signs of systems developing in their capabilities and power too quickly.

Evan Hubinger, made headlines with his belief that there is a greater than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

He works in alignment, a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI - essentially keeping it on track with what humans value.

While he said the risk from current systems was "low", his comments came as another researcher quit Anthropic and warned those developing the tech were losing their grip on it.

Jacob Coxon told the BBC he and other staff were "genuinely frightened" about the speed of advancements and what it could mean for humanity.

These concerns are the latest in a long line of fears about AI's potential to threaten humanity should it grow to match or surpass human abilities.

Such worries date back decades, with Alan Turing writing in the 1950s that should intelligent machines become possible, they could take control.

In the last few years, major AI companies have been racing to develop increasingly capable systems, both for profit and in pursuit of creating what they call super intelligence - theoretical tech which is smarter than humans.

Unlike the systems and tools many people use daily to complete tasks like writing emails or generating videos, super intelligent AI systems should be able to handle far more complex tasks.

OpenAI and Anthropic say they aim to advance such tech in a way which benefits humans and protect them from its existential risks.

But some critics believe machines can never truly match humans. They say AI firms exaggerate the tech's abilities to boost their prominence or profit.

AI researchers, experts and bosses worried about the technology's potential to endanger humanity have outlined unsettling scenarios.

Dario Amodei wrote in September , external it had advanced "drastically faster" than expected, including in its "ability to build the next generation of AI".

This is the concern that AI, after it has reached a certain point, could theoretically begin improving itself without human...
body.zh: 关于人工智能潜在危险的一系列警告促使人们呼吁采取协调行动以减缓该技术的发展。 现任和前任研究人员声称这项技术将危及人类——其中一位研究人员表示它“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%——已经敲响了警钟。 主要开发商 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 正在敦促立法者监管人工智能，微软人工智能负责人最新表示，需要制定规则来防止“硅物种”最终与人类竞争。 但一些人驳斥了这些呼吁，认为这是大型人工智能开发商为巩固其对竞争对手的主导地位而做出的努力。 一些人工智能研究人员表示，有令人担忧的迹象表明系统的能力和能力发展得太快。 Evan Hubinger 因相信人工智能在未来十年内“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10% 而成为头条新闻。 他致力于将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能领域——本质上是让它与人类价值观保持一致。 虽然他表示当前系统的风险“很低”，但他发表此番言论之际，另一位研究人员退出了 Anthropic，并警告那些开发该技术的人正在失去对它的控制。 雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，他和其他工作人员对进步的速度及其对人类意味着什么感到“真正感到害怕”。 这些担忧是人们对人工智能可能会威胁人类的一系列担忧中的最新一个，如果它发展到与人类能力相匹配或超越的话。 这种担忧可以追溯到几十年前，阿兰·图灵在 20 世纪 50 年代写道，如果智能机器成为可能，它们就可以掌控一切。 在过去的几年里，主要的人工智能公司一直在竞相开发功能越来越强大的系统，既是为了利润，也是为了创造他们所谓的超级智能——比人类更聪明的理论技术。 与许多人日常用来完成撰写电子邮件或生成视频等任务的系统和工具不同，超级智能人工智能系统应该能够处理更复杂的任务。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 表示，他们的目标是以造福人类并保护他们免受生存风险的方式推进此类技术。 但一些批评家认为机器永远无法真正与人类相媲美。他们表示，人工智能公司夸大了该技术的能力，以提高其知名度或利润。 担心该技术可能危害人类的人工智能研究人员、专家和老板们概述了令人不安的场景。 达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 在 9 月份写道，从外部来看，它的进步比预期“快得多”，包括“构建下一代人工智能的能力”。 人们担心人工智能在达到一定程度后，理论上可以在没有人类的情况下开始自我改进......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings with it profound questions about humanity's future and our place in the world. Warnings from researchers about AI potentially endangering humanity echo the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition to reach the heavens led to confusion. As we develop powerful new technologies, we are reminded to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展带来了关于人类未来和我们在世界中的地位的深刻问题。研究人员关于人工智能可能危及人类的警告，呼应了古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类 करण्याचा天に達する野心は混乱をもたらしました。私たちは強力な新技術を開発するにつれて、謙虚さと知恵をもって進み、創造物の究極の目的と影響を考慮することを思い出させられます。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」
